title: Performance of intracortical microelectrode arrays in people with implanted brain–computer interfaces over a 20-year period
zh_title: 植入式脑机接口Utah阵列20年性能评估
summary: BrainGate临床试验20年数据评估Utah微电极阵列的长期记录与解码稳定性。
key_points: 涵盖2289次记录、20个阵列、14名参与者
平均35.6%电极可记录到神经脉冲，7年余下降约7个百分点
14个阵列中11个全程保持有效运动解码
reason: 20年多阵列大样本长期随访，含解码稳定性外部量化，属重要档
abstract: The silicon microelectrode ‘Utah’ array has enabled people with paralysis to control computer cursors, operate prosthetic limbs and communicate using high-performance brain–computer interfaces. However, reports so far have typically been limited to one or two individuals, with no systematic assessment of array longevity, decoding accuracy and day-to-day stability. Here we present a comprehensive 20-year evaluation of neural data from the BrainGate clinical trials, spanning 2,289 recording sessions, 20 arrays and 14 participants. On average, arrays successfully recorded neural spiking waveforms on 35.6% of electrodes, with a modest 7 percentage point decline over the recording period (up to 7.3 years). Using a ‘decoding signal-to-noise ratio’ (dSNR) metric, we found that 11 of 14 arrays provided meaningful movement decoding throughout participation (median dSNR >1), with three achieving >70% accuracy compared with able-bodied mouse control. We also found that dSNR increased approximately logarithmically with the number of electrodes, providing a pathway for scaling performance. While longevity exceeded previous nonhuman primate studies, achieving peak performance consistently may require further improvements.
zh_abstract: 硅微电极“Utah”阵列已使瘫痪患者能够控制计算机光标、操作假肢，并使用高性能脑机接口进行交流。然而，迄今的报道通常仅限于一两个人，且未对阵列寿命、解码准确性和逐日稳定性进行系统评估。在此，我们呈现对BrainGate临床试验神经数据的全面20年评估，涵盖2,289次记录会话、20个阵列和14名参与者。平均而言，阵列在35.6%的电极上成功记录到神经尖峰波形，在记录期内（最长7.3年）出现适度下降，降幅为7个百分点。使用“解码信噪比”（dSNR）指标，我们发现14个阵列中有11个在整个参与期间提供了有意义的运动解码（中位dSNR >1），其中3个达到>70%的准确率（与健全个体使用鼠标控制相比）。我们还发现，dSNR随电极数量近似对数增加，为性能扩展提供了路径。尽管其使用寿命超过了既往非人灵长类研究，但要持续达到峰值性能可能仍需进一步改进。

title: Artificial intelligence capacity in the rural United States: a national qualitative study.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: 美国农村医院AI应用能力的全国质性研究
summary: 对全美50家关键通道医院73名管理者的访谈，考察农村医院如何使用AI及安全有效应用的障碍。
key_points: 分层随机抽样覆盖全美四区域关键通道医院
访谈50家医院73名技术决策者
聚焦生成式AI应用与安全使用障碍
reason: 全国分层抽样质性研究，揭示农村部署障碍与公平议题，但无结局指标，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To understand how rural hospitals use artificial intelligence (AI) and identify ways to reduce the barriers to safe, effective use of high-quality tools that align with these hospitals' key priorities. Stratified random sample drawn from the full population of critical access hospitals (CAHs) in the United States in 2025 (n = 1377) to approximate proportional representation of the 4 census regions. We conducted in-depth qualitative interviews with hospital leadership (eg, CMIOs, CIOs, IT leads) tasked with decision-making about technology. Interviews were conducted between October 20, 2025, and January 23, 2026. Drawn from the full population of CAHs in the US in 2025, 256 hospitals were sampled and interviews were completed for a total of 50 CAHs represented by 73 interview participants. Generative AI applications were more common and seen as more valuable for CAH contexts than traditional predictive AI. Primary barriers included infrastructure limitations, cost, and lack of transparency on how AI tools worked. Despite a desire to implement robust governance, most CAHs did not have the ability to do so and reported a critical need for information, tools, and policies to build their AI governance capacity. Information (peer learning, information from non-commercial sources), tools (registries, model cards), and policy to support technical capacity were perceived as the most responsive ways to build capacity. To reduce structural barriers to safe and effective AI decision-making, resources and investment should focus on information sharing with and across rural organizations, AI governance support, and transparency efforts. This will support CAHs in judiciously leveraging available resources and prevent waste on low-quality or misaligned AI tools.
zh_abstract: 《美国医学信息学协会会刊：JAMIA》 旨在了解农村医院如何使用人工智能（AI），并识别减少障碍的方法，以促进安全、有效地使用与这些医院关键优先事项相一致的高质量工具。从2025年美国全部关键接入医院（critical access hospitals, CAHs）总体（n = 1377）中抽取分层随机样本，以近似按比例代表4个人口普查区域。我们对负责技术决策的医院领导层（如CMIO、CIO、IT负责人）进行了深入定性访谈。访谈于2025年10月20日至2026年1月23日进行。从2025年美国CAHs全总体中抽取256家医院，最终完成访谈，共代表50家CAHs，由73名访谈参与者代表。在CAH情境中，生成式AI应用比传统预测性AI更常见，也被认为更有价值。主要障碍包括基础设施限制、成本，以及AI工具运作方式缺乏透明度。尽管有意实施稳健治理，大多数CAHs没有能力这样做，并报告亟需信息、工具和政策来建设其AI治理能力。信息（同行学习、来自非商业来源的信息）、工具（登记库、模型卡）以及支持技术能力的政策，被认为是建设能力最切合需求的方式。为减少安全有效AI决策的结构性障碍，资源和投资应聚焦于与农村组织共享信息及农村组织之间的信息共享、AI治理支持和透明度工作。这将支持CAHs审慎利用可用资源，并防止在低质量或不匹配的AI工具上造成浪费。

title: AI-assisted chest CT scan analysis of body composition at ICU admission and 6-month mortality
zh_title: AI分析ICU入院胸部CT体成分与6月死亡率
summary: 单中心前瞻队列用开源AI分割胸CT体成分，构建评分关联ICU患者6月生存。
key_points: 509例中475例纳入最终分析

交叉验证AUC 0.73，嵌套校正后0.68
reason: 单中心前瞻队列但仅内部交叉验证，预后指标无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Abnormal body composition at intensive care unit (ICU) admission is associated with worse survival, but it is rarely measured in practice because manual CT analysis is labor-intensive. We conducted a secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 patients who underwent chest CT within 24 h of ICU admission, of whom 475 were included in the final analysis. Open-source AI segmentation was used to quantify body composition, and the resulting features were related to 6-month survival. Risk scores derived from body composition were significantly associated with 6-month survival (p < 0.001, log-rank test). In five-fold cross-validation, the AUC for discriminating survivors from non-survivors was 0.73; when feature selection was accounted for, the AUC was 0.68 by nested cross-validation and 0.69 by bootstrap optimism correction. The study shows that the automated AI-based analysis of admission chest CT yields body composition scores significantly associated with 6-month mortality after ICU admission.
zh_abstract: 重症监护病房（ICU）入院时异常的身体组成与更差的生存相关，但在实践中很少被测量，因为手动CT分析劳动强度大。我们对一个单中心前瞻性队列进行了二次分析，该队列包含509名在ICU入院后24小时内接受胸部CT的患者，其中475名被纳入最终分析。使用开源AI分割来量化身体组成，并将所得特征与6个月生存相关。由身体组成得出的风险评分与6个月生存显著相关（p < 0.001，log-rank检验）。在五折交叉验证中，区分生存者与非生存者的AUC为0.73；当考虑特征选择时，通过嵌套交叉验证得到的AUC为0.68，通过bootstrap乐观校正得到的AUC为0.69。该研究表明，基于AI的入院胸部CT自动化分析产生的身体组成评分与ICU入院后6个月死亡率显著相关。

title: Social work informatics: an equity framework for health informatics.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

key_points: 框架基于社工、信息学与健康公平文献综述
提出6个域：共同设计、SDOH数据整合等
强调AI输出的情境解释与社区领导
reason: 框架类观点文章，无实证数据，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Social work informatics (SWI) was proposed as a professional specialty in 2006, yet social work remains under-represented in health informatics governance, research, and system design even as artificial intelligence (AI) shapes high-stakes clinical decisions. This paper introduces the SWI Equity Framework, positioning social work as a leader in designing equitable health informatics systems. The framework was developed through a synthesis of social work, health informatics, and health equity literature. The framework identifies 6 domains: reflexive system co-design, social determinants of health data integration, training-data quality and representation, contextual interpretation of AI outputs, community leadership, and equitable accountability. The framework highlights opportunities to integrate social work expertise throughout the health informatics lifecycle, moving beyond consultation toward active participation in system design, implementation, and governance. It also outlines pathways for advancing social work informatics through education, interdisciplinary research, health systems, and professional infrastructure. Social work is particularly well positioned to advance the equity agenda of health informatics and offers profession-specific expertise that can strengthen equity, accountability, and implementation across the informatics lifecycle.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 社会工作信息学（SWI）于2006年被提出作为一个专业方向，然而即便人工智能（AI）正在塑造高利害临床决策，社会工作在健康信息学治理、研究和系统设计中的代表性仍然不足。本文介绍SWI公平框架，将社会工作定位为设计公平健康信息学系统的领导者。该框架通过综合社会工作、健康信息学和健康公平文献而制定。该框架确定了6个领域：反思性系统共同设计、健康社会决定因素的数据整合、训练数据质量与代表性、AI输出的情境化解读、社区领导以及公平问责。该框架强调了在整个健康信息学生命周期中整合社会工作专业知识的机会，从咨询转向积极参与系统设计、实施和治理。它还概述了通过教育、跨学科研究、卫生系统和专业基础设施推进社会工作信息学的路径。社会工作尤其适合推进健康信息学的公平议程，并提供专业特有的专业知识，可增强整个信息学生命周期中的公平、问责和实施。

title: Artificial Intelligence in the Multidisciplinary Tumor Board for Prostate Cancer: A Narrative Review.
zh_title: AI在前列腺癌多学科肿瘤委员会的应用综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI作为MDT输入（MRI读片、Gleason分级等）与决策支持两种角色。
key_points: 深度学习MRI读片达或超放射科医师水平
规则型工具复现标准建议86-99%
通用大模型与真实泌尿肿瘤board一致率56-93%
reason: 叙述性综述，汇总已有证据但无新数据，按综述上限评档
abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] Multidisciplinary tumor boards (MDTs) guide prostate cancer decisions but are strained by rising case volumes, evolving guidelines, and growing complexity. Artificial intelligence (AI) now enters the MDT at two levels. First, it generates inputs: deep-learning magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reading matches or exceeds radiologists' performance in the Prostate Imaging-Cancer Artificial Intelligence (PI-CAI) study; Gleason grading reaches expert-level agreement; PSMA PET quantification is automated; and multimodal pathology biomarkers predict ADT benefit. Second, decision-support systems act on MDT output: rule-based tools reproduce standard recommendations in 86-99% of cases, mostly in populations dominated by standard cases, whereas general-purpose large language models (LLMs) agree with real urological boards in 56-93% of cases, depending largely on input quality and case mix, and perform worse in metastatic disease; agreement does not establish clinical benefit. Of 33 appraised decision-support studies, 27 were at high risk of bias, 20 of them solely because the treating board served as an unblinded reference standard; explainability, regulation, and automation bias remain unresolved. We propose that AI currently serves as a supervised pre-reader, guideline checker, and triage tool. Prospective multicenter studies with patient outcomes are needed.
zh_abstract: [Current oncology (Toronto, Ont.)] 多学科肿瘤委员会（MDT）指导前列腺癌决策，但受病例量上升、指南不断演变和复杂性日益增加所制约。人工智能（AI）现在在两个层面进入MDT。首先，它生成输入：在前列腺影像-癌症人工智能（PI-CAI）研究中，深度学习磁共振成像（MRI）阅片达到或超过放射科医师的表现；Gleason分级达到专家级一致性；PSMA PET定量实现自动化；多模态病理生物标志物可预测ADT获益。其次，决策支持系统作用于MDT输出：基于规则的工具在86-99%的病例中重现标准建议，且主要是在以标准病例为主的人群中；而通用大语言模型（LLMs）在56-93%的病例中与真实泌尿外科肿瘤委员会一致，这很大程度上取决于输入质量和病例构成，并且在转移性疾病中表现更差；一致性并不能确立临床获益。在33项被评价的决策支持研究中，27项存在高偏倚风险，其中20项仅因为治疗委员会作为非盲参考标准；可解释性、监管和自动化偏倚仍未解决。我们提出，AI目前作为受监督的预读工具、指南核查工具和分诊工具。需要开展以患者结局为终点、前瞻性多中心研究。

title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
zh_title: JHealthBench-L：日本本土化医学大模型评分基准
summary: arXiv预印本发布经医师评审的日本本土化HealthBench-L，含79例咨询、1022条评分标准。
key_points: 79例面向患者的咨询，1022条评分标准
专家仅需完全重写4.4%的评分标准
93.6%二阶段标准经独立双医师审核通过
reason: 新发布的经临床医生评审的评测基准，但规模中等且为预印本
abstract: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline across 18 LLMs reveals that translation-only evaluation preserves coarse model rankings ($τ= 0.817$, mean shift +0.027) yet flips verdicts on 17.7% of modified criteria (vs. 7.3% re-grading noise) and reduces false penalties on Japan-adapted negative criteria by 7.1 percentage points, masking item-level clinical mismeasurement behind stable leaderboards. Axis-level and paired analyses further show that context awareness and Japan-specific clinical criteria remain primary bottlenecks, whereas Japanese continual pretraining and reasoning post-training substantially improve locally grounded performance. Datasets, physician revision logs, and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L.
zh_abstract: 诸如 HealthBench 这类基于评分细则的基准，使用病例特定的医生标准来评估大型语言模型（LLM）在开放式健康咨询中的表现，而其中许多标准预设了其来源地区的医疗机构、药物和照护路径。仅靠机器翻译时，这些地区性假设仍留在评分细则中，使在日本恰当的应答在外国临床规则下不被计分或被错误扣分。为在不从零编写评分细则的情况下，将既有临床评估视角适配到日本，我们通过带来源引用的 LLM 起草、单一专科医生筛选与修订、独立双医师审核以及元审核，构建了 JHealthBench-L（79 项面向患者的咨询，1,022 条标准）。专科医生仅从头改写了 4.4% 的标准，独立审核者无问题地批准了 93.6% 的第二阶段标准。在 18 个 LLM 上比较 JHealthBench-L 与机器翻译基线显示，仅翻译评估保留了粗粒度模型排名（$τ= 0.817$，平均偏移 +0.027），却对 17.7% 的修改标准翻转了判定（相比之下重新评分的噪声为 7.3%），并将对日本适配阴性标准的错误扣分减少了 7.1 个百分点，从而在稳定排行榜背后掩盖了条目级临床误测。轴级和配对分析进一步表明，上下文感知和日本特定临床标准仍是主要瓶颈，而日语持续预训练和推理后训练显著提升了本地化落地性能。数据集、医生修订日志和评估代码可在 https://github.com/horshohei/JHealthBench-L 获取。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Baqiyatallah Medical Sciences University; conditions: Post-Intensive Care Syndrome-Family (PICS-F), Post-Traumatic Stress, Psychological Distress; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The ASSIST trial evaluates whether an AI-assisted smartphone application can reduce post-traumatic stress symptoms and other psychological distress in family members of critically ill patients. Admission to an intensive care unit (ICU) places a severe psychological burden on families, often leading to post-intensive care syndrome-family (PICS-F). Current support is mostly reactive and rarely available after the patient is discharged. This study is a three-center randomized controlled trial involving 1000 family members. Participants will be randomly assigned to receive either standard care or standard care plus the ASSIST smartphone platform. During the ICU stay, the platform uses an artificial intelligence model to simplify clinical information (approved by a clinician) and helps families prepare questions for the medical team. After the patient is discharged, the platform monitors the family member's mood daily. If a risk of anxiety or depression is detected, it provides a brief digital cognitive behavioral therapy module. The main goal is to see if the ASSIST platform reduces post-traumatic stress over a 12-month period compared to standard care alone. Secondary goals include evaluating its effects on acute stress, decisional conflict, anxiety, depression, and caregiver burden. The study will also include qualitative interviews to understand the family members' lived experiences using the platform

title: Separating Measurement Failures from Defence Failures in Split Language-Model Privacy
zh_title: 拆分语言模型隐私评估的测量失败与防御失败
summary: 对拆分训练LLM隐私评估做回溯性再分析，区分测量无效与真实隐私泄露。
key_points: 跨四个拆分LLM实验再分析既有隐私主张
24项必要探测中仅4项合格
4项校准探测在13个配置中确认隐私泄露
reason: 与医疗场景无关的LLM隐私方法学预印本，应用关联弱
abstract: Split-training privacy evaluations fail through distinct mechanisms. Evaluators can overlook an exposed gradient channel, align reconstructions against shifted labels, or deploy uncalibrated probes before testing a candidate defence, while calibrated attacks can also refute real defences. Separating these failure modes alters which claims survive. We conduct a retrospective evidentiary reanalysis across four split-LLM campaigns and two cross-cutting scope checks covering host key custody and variational mutual-information bounds, mapping every recorded claim to one of five admissibility states (breach, non-detection, undetermined coverage, invalid measurement, or out-of-scope inference). Across a 19-configuration exploration, only four of 24 required probes qualified, yet those four calibrated probes still established qualified privacy breaches in 13 configurations, while utility or learning-gain failures eliminated the remaining 6. In a seven-cell defence-redesign pilot, 2 quantised configurations failed utility gates, calibrated next-byte structure probes breached the 0.02 gate on all 7 cells (0.097 to 0.112), and qualified punctuation-property probes reached 0.79 to 0.89, yielding 4 failed and 3 undetermined composite privacy assessments (the latter from marginal null-band excursions on punctuation bindings). Negative evidence against both defence families remains intact. Scope checks further show that shared-key orthogonal wrappers protect passive network captures without hiding activations from a compromised restoring host, and why near-zero variational lower bounds leave worst-case leakage unconstrained. Rerunnable scripts verify 1,522 checks across 122 SHA-256-pinned artifacts while preserving each campaign's native seed intervals and retrospective boundaries.
zh_abstract: 拆分训练隐私评估会通过不同机制失败。评估者可能忽略暴露的梯度通道、将重建结果与偏移后的标签对齐，或在测试候选防御之前部署未校准探针，而校准后的攻击也可能驳倒真实防御。将这些失败模式区分开来会改变哪些主张能够成立。我们对四项拆分 LLM（split-LLM）活动及两项跨领域范围检查（涵盖主机密钥保管与变分互信息界）进行了回顾性证据再分析，将每一项记录在案的主张映射到五种可采纳性状态之一（泄露、未检测到、覆盖范围未确定、测量无效或超出范围推断）。在 19 种配置的探索中，24 个所需探针中只有 4 个合格，但这 4 个校准探针仍在 13 种配置中确立了合格的隐私泄露，而效用或学习增益失败消除了其余 6 项。在一项七单元防御重新设计试点中，2 个量化配置未通过效用门槛，校准的下一字节结构探针在所有 7 个单元上突破 0.02 门槛（0.097 至 0.112），合格的标点属性探针达到 0.79 至 0.89，最终得到 4 项失败和 3 项未确定的综合隐私评估（后者源于标点绑定上的边缘零假设带偏移）。针对两类防御的负面证据仍然成立。范围检查进一步表明，共享密钥正交包装器可保护被动网络抓包，却不会向受损的恢复主机隐藏激活值，并说明为何接近零的变分下界无法约束最坏情况泄露。可重复运行的脚本在保留每项活动的原生种子区间和回顾性边界的同时，验证了 122 个以 SHA-256 固定的工件中的 1,522 项检查。

title: What Does an Agent-Run Clinic Cost? Protocol for a Prospective Observational Study of the Compute Cost of Completed Work in a Clinical Agent Fleet

abstract: Background: Decisions about deploying large language model (LLM) agents in health care require the cost of completed work in production. Published evidence reports benchmark accuracy, benchmark-level cost, and time or financial outcomes for ambient documentation, and list prices alone do not determine the cost of completed work. To our knowledge, no deployed clinical agent fleet has published a measurement method that ties compute cost, latency, failures and retries to completed work. Objective: This study aims to estimate the compute cost of completed work by the orchestrated clinical agents of a deployed LLM agent fleet over a 12-week window of production telemetry, using estimators, data-quality gates and an analysis plan fixed before any window data are extracted for the study. Methods: The setting is a private outpatient clinic in London, United Kingdom, where wai, a multi-agent system supporting clinic operations, is deployed. The population is every run of the 20 orchestrated clinical documentation and decision-support agents starting between September 21 and December 13, 2026. The run store writes 2 records for every run, a non-terminal record before the model call and a terminal record after it, and has no attempt counter or parent-run link. Estimators defined on that structure cover cost per resolved execution and per completed intention, retry and failed-intention shares of compute, error and failure rates, latency, cost per draft offered for clinician review and a latency-cost frontier, by agent, task class and acceptance stratum. Cost is recorded in GBP pence, converted from provider-returned US dollar cost at a fixed rate and rounded per model call. The plan fixes weekly aggregation, small-cell suppression, bootstrap intervals over weeks, 2 prespecified comparisons, 5 sensitivity analyses and 4 data-quality gates whose failure converts an estimate into a bound or an unmeasured stratum. Two staff-level measures proposed during planning were dropped. Revenue, pricing, margin and staffing inference are excluded. Results: The measurement window opened on September 21, 2026, and closes on December 13, 2026, and telemetry is being recorded in routine operation. Aggregate whole-table counts that include window records were extracted on November 19, 2026, for companion manuscripts and are disclosed. source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To evaluate ambient Artificial Intelligence (AI) scribe systems (AAS) across multiple domains using a rapid learning health system (LHS) approach, including provider satisfaction, efficiency, documentation quality, usability, and patient sentiment. This LHS evaluation compared 2 AAS systems (Abridge and Nabla) among 100 providers over 90 days. Evaluation incorporated a cluster randomized crossover comparison, analysis of use and EHR-based workflow outcomes, and standardized simulated encounters to assess documentation quality and safety. Outcomes included provider satisfaction, efficiency, note quality, usability, and patient sentiment. In standardized simulated encounters, both systems achieved 76% note element accuracy with minimal risk for harm. In the randomized crossover comparison, Abridge demonstrated higher usability scores (78.5 vs 73) and was preferred 3:1 over Nabla, which had higher automated speech recognition error rates. Across 16 479 clinical encounters, AAS was used in 35.7% of visits. Total EHR time decreased by approximately 5 minutes per day; same-day chart closure increased by approximately 5% during the initial crossover period, but this effect was attenuated. Provider experience was positive (Net Promoter Score [NPS] 53). Both systems demonstrated comparable documentation accuracy and modest efficiency gains while improving clinician satisfaction. Despite similar performance, clinicians reported differences in usability and preference. Adoption below 40% reflected the trade-off between documentation support and verification burden. Rapid, multidimensional evaluation within a LHS can assess AAS across domains of implementation, efficiency, clinician experience, and documentation quality and safety. Ongoing monitoring of efficiency, documentation quality, and use patterns is essential.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 采用快速学习型卫生系统（LHS）方法，在多个领域评估环境人工智能（AI）记录系统（AAS），包括医疗服务提供者满意度、效率、文档记录质量、可用性和患者感受。本LHS评估在90天内对100名医疗服务提供者比较了2种AAS系统（Abridge和Nabla）。评估包括整群随机交叉比较、使用情况与基于EHR的工作流程结局分析，以及标准化模拟诊疗场景以评估文档记录质量与安全性。结局包括医疗服务提供者满意度、效率、病历记录质量、可用性和患者感受。在标准化模拟诊疗场景中，两套系统均达到76%的病历要素准确率，且伤害风险极低。在随机交叉比较中，Abridge显示出更高的可用性评分（78.5 vs 73），并以3:1的比例较Nabla更受偏好，而Nabla的自动语音识别错误率更高。在16 479次临床诊疗中，35.7%的就诊使用了AAS。总EHR时间每天减少约5分钟；在初始交叉期间，当日病历关闭率增加约5%，但该效应随后减弱。医疗服务提供者体验为正面（净推荐值[NPS]为53）。两套系统均表现出相当的文档记录准确性和适度的效率提升，同时改善了临床医生满意度。尽管性能相似，临床医生报告了可用性和偏好方面的差异。低于40%的采用率反映了文档记录支持与核验负担之间的权衡。在LHS内进行快速、多维评估可以跨实施、效率、临床医生体验以及文档记录质量与安全性等领域评估AAS。持续监测效率、文档记录质量和使用模式至关重要。

title: Challenges in AI based tumor board case summarization and recommendations

summary: npj Digital Medicine 基于四家机构数据，用专家评估多款主流大模型完成肿瘤委员会病例摘要、方案生成与会议结局预测任务。

abstract: Tumor boards, recurring meetings at hospital institutions, assemble cancer specialists (e.g., medical oncology and pathology) to discuss patient care. In this work, we formally define tumor board case summarization, options generation, and meeting outcome prediction as AI tasks. We study datasets from four medical institutions and evaluate state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) from the DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen families using expert human assessment. Medical oncologists created ~9.6k reference texts and 16k human judgments across tasks. Clinicians rated LLM-generated case summaries 3.57–4.59 out of 5.0 across institutions, but recommendation generation remained more challenging, with average scores of 2.0–3.6. Clinical alignment analyses showed modest correlations of ~0.2 for case summarization subtasks and higher correlations of ~0.6 for recommendation generation using LLM-as-Judge metrics. Our proposed TBFact metrics were competitive with LLM-as-Judge approaches in longer prose free-text settings, suggesting a promising direction toward explainable evaluation. This study, to our knowledge the largest expert-grading study of tumor board tasks with both granular and direct assessments, found that criterion-level scores and overall judgments are related nonlinearly. Experts also frequently assigned high ratings to responses that differed substantially from their reference texts, challenging assumptions underlying reference-based automatic evaluation metrics.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤委员会是医院机构中定期召开的会议，汇集肿瘤专科医师（例如肿瘤内科和病理科）讨论患者照护。在本研究中，我们将肿瘤委员会病例摘要、治疗选项生成和会议结局预测正式定义为AI任务。我们研究了来自四家医疗机构的四组数据集，并使用专家人工评估来评价来自DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini和Qwen系列的最先进大语言模型（LLM）。肿瘤内科医生创建了约9.6k条参考文本和16k条跨任务的人工判断。临床医生对LLM生成的病例摘要评分在各机构为3.57–4.59分（满分5.0分），但推荐生成仍然更具挑战性，平均评分为2.0–3.6分。临床对齐分析显示，病例摘要子任务的相关系数约为0.2，较为有限；而使用LLM-as-Judge指标时，推荐生成的相关系数较高，约为0.6。我们提出的TBFact指标在较长的散文式自由文本设置中与LLM-as-Judge方法具有竞争力，提示了迈向可解释评估的一个有前景的方向。据我们所知，本研究是同时采用细粒度评估和直接评估的规模最大的肿瘤委员会任务专家评分研究；研究发现，标准级评分与总体判断之间呈非线性关系。专家还经常对与其参考文本存在显著差异的回答给予高评分，这挑战了基于参考文本的自动评估指标所依赖的假设。

abstract: Postoperative acute kidney injury (PO-AKI) risk estimates evolve as clinical information accumulates, yet many electronic health record (EHR) models use static or fixed-window representations. We developed STREAM, a perioperative event-stream Transformer that represents irregular EHR data as chronological clinical events and supports surgery-index prediction at surgery completion and event-by-event postoperative AKI prediction. In a retrospective cohort of 167,078 noncardiac surgical episodes, STREAM achieved surgery-index AUROC/AUPRC of 0.942/0.771, the Time-series Transformer 0.933/0.729, and GRU-D 0.926/0.695. Postoperative macro-AUPRC across 6-hour evaluation intervals was 0.589, 0.525, and 0.547, respectively. STREAM showed more consistent calibration across postoperative time points than the comparators. Event-arrival attribution and within-window permutation analysis enabled event-level interpretation of how newly arrived information and fine-grained event ordering shaped evolving risk estimates. These findings support event-stream modeling as an interpretable framework for dynamic, temporally resolved prediction from longitudinal EHR data as well as a potential risk-estimation component for future perioperative digital twins.
zh_abstract: 术后急性肾损伤（PO-AKI）风险估计会随着临床信息积累而演变，但许多电子健康记录（EHR）模型使用静态或固定窗口表示。我们开发了STREAM，这是一种围手术期事件流Transformer，将不规则EHR数据表示为按时间顺序排列的临床事件，并支持在手术完成时进行手术索引预测以及逐事件进行术后AKI预测。在一个包含167,078例非心脏手术病例的回顾性队列中，STREAM取得的手术索引AUROC/AUPRC为0.942/0.771，Time-series Transformer为0.933/0.729，GRU-D为0.926/0.695。在6小时评估间隔上的术后宏AUPRC分别为0.589、0.525和0.547。与对照模型相比，STREAM在术后各时间点表现出更一致的校准。事件到达归因和窗口内置换分析使得能够在事件层面解释新到达的信息和细粒度事件排序如何塑造不断演变的风险估计。这些发现支持将事件流建模作为一种可解释框架，用于从纵向EHR数据进行动态、时间分辨的预测，并作为未来围手术期数字孪生的潜在风险估计组件。

title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
zh_title: LingSante MedGuard 技术报告
summary: 预印本技术报告提出融合医疗护栏教师模型与六类能力专家的统一护栏模型，用于识别医疗 AI 回答中的安全、合规与伦理风险。
key_points: 融合护栏教师模型与六项医疗能力专家
覆盖医疗安全、合规、伦理风险判断与解释
含数值推理与多模态幻觉检测；未经同行评审

abstract: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calculations, and applying medical requirements under their intended conditions. We introduce LingSante MedGuard, a capability-enhanced guardrail that integrates supervision from a medical guardrail teacher model and six specialized medical capability experts into a unified model. The guardrail teacher supervises risk decisions and explanations across medical safety, compliance, and ethics, while the capability experts support medical rule understanding, numerical reasoning, multimodal hallucination detection, agentic safety verification, risk localization, and multimodal entity understanding. We consolidate these sources of supervision through offline supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated demonstrations, followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation using feedback on student-generated responses. We further introduce LingSante MedGuardBench, a benchmark comprising 11 risk-detection subsets spanning medical safety, compliance, and ethics. At 4B, 9B, and 27B scales, LingSante MedGuard achieves mean benchmark F1 scores of 82.3%, 82.4%, and 87.4%, respectively. The 4B model also achieves 73.9% mean accuracy across MedHallu and MedHALT-NOTA under retrieval-enabled evaluation. Additional evaluations of the verification components show improvements in evidence-supported consistency, source traceability, and rule-guided rationale quality across model scales. These results support the integration of specialized medical capabilities into a unified guardrail for medical risk assessment and evidence-based medical safety verification.
zh_abstract: 随着医疗AI越来越多地用于患者咨询和临床决策支持，识别有害、不合规或存在伦理问题的响应对于负责任地部署至关重要。评估这些风险需要对照相关证据检查临床主张、验证计算，并在预期条件下应用医疗要求。我们推出LingSante MedGuard，这是一种能力增强型护栏，将来自医疗护栏教师模型的监督和六个专业医疗能力专家整合到一个统一模型中。护栏教师负责监督跨医疗安全、合规和伦理的风险决策与解释，而能力专家支持医疗规则理解、数值推理、多模态幻觉检测、智能体安全验证、风险定位和多模态实体理解。我们通过对教师生成示范进行离线监督微调，随后利用对学生生成响应的反馈进行多教师同策略蒸馏，来整合这些监督来源。我们进一步推出LingSante MedGuardBench，这是一个包含11个风险检测子集的基准，涵盖医疗安全、合规和伦理。在4B、9B和27B规模下，LingSante MedGuard分别取得82.3%、82.4%和87.4%的基准平均F1分数。在启用检索的评估下，4B模型在MedHallu和MedHALT-NOTA上也取得73.9%的平均准确率。对验证组件的额外评估显示，在不同模型规模下，证据支持的一致性、来源可追溯性和规则引导的理由质量均有改善。这些结果支持将专业医疗能力整合到统一护栏中，以用于医疗风险评估和基于证据的医疗安全验证。

title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories

summary: 预印本提出交互式框架，用 LLM 解析临床需求，并以 CVAE、扩散模型生成表格病历与纵向轨迹。

abstract: Objective: To develop and validate InterGenEHR$^+$, an interactive framework for natural language-conditioned generation of synthetic tabular electronic health records (EHRs) and longitudinal trajectories for scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models. Methods: An optional large language model (LLM) parser converts clinical requests into structured constraints. Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records, while diffusion models generate longitudinal trajectories. We evaluate parsing, distributional fidelity, imputation, clinical-constraint adherence, mortality prediction, and clinical plausibility using a multi-institutional cohort of 874 patients receiving venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO). Results: Gemma 3 4B with few-shot prompting achieves the highest parsing performance with a low spurious slot rate. IGE-TabDDPM and IGE-PMVAE perform well in single-time-point generation; IGE-CSDI, IGE-FGTI, and IGE-MTSCI lead on different longitudinal fidelity metrics. Across five random seeds and three classifiers, synthetic cohorts retain predictive utility for mortality prediction on real test data. Clinician ratings support trajectory plausibility and alignment with requested scenarios. Conclusion: InterGenEHR$^+$ supports clinician-specified generation of EHR trajectories with statistical fidelity and downstream predictive utility in the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort. Extension to other clinical settings requires further validation. Significance: The framework supports scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in data-sparse critical care settings.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并验证InterGenEHR$^+$，这是一个交互式框架，用于以自然语言为条件生成合成表格电子健康记录（EHR）和纵向轨迹，以支持机器学习模型基于场景的评估。【方法】一个可选的大语言模型（LLM）解析器将临床请求转换为结构化约束。条件变分自编码器和扩散模型生成单时间点记录，而扩散模型生成纵向轨迹。我们使用一个多机构队列评估解析、分布保真度、插补、临床约束依从性、死亡预测和临床合理性，该队列包含874例接受静脉-静脉体外膜肺氧合（VV-ECMO）的患者。【结果】使用少样本提示的Gemma 3 4B取得最高解析性能，且虚假槽位率低。IGE-TabDDPM和IGE-PMVAE在单时间点生成中表现良好；IGE-CSDI、IGE-FGTI和IGE-MTSCI在不同纵向保真度指标上领先。在五个随机种子和三个分类器下，合成队列在真实测试数据上保留了对死亡预测的预测效用。临床医生评分支持轨迹合理性及其与所请求场景的一致性。【结论】在评估的VV-ECMO队列中，InterGenEHR$^+$支持由临床医生指定生成具有统计保真度和下游预测效用的EHR轨迹。扩展到其他临床环境需要进一步验证。【意义】该框架支持在数据稀疏的重症监护环境中对机器学习模型进行基于场景的评估。

title: XenoType: Decoding cellular identity in breast cancer histology through molecular supervision
zh_title: XenoType：分子监督解码乳腺癌组织学中的细胞身份
summary: 预印本提出 XenoType，借助同切片空间分子数据监督，从常规 H&E 图像直接分类七类分子定义的细胞类型。
key_points: 无需人工标注即可获得分子层面细胞分型
使用同一切片配对数据训练，避免染色改变
目标是刻画肿瘤微环境细胞组成
reason: 方法有新意，但为预印本且条目未显示外部验证与临床结局
abstract: Characterizing the cellular composition of the tumor microenvironment from histological images is fundamental to understanding cancer biology and informing treatment decisions. Deep learning has enabled automated nuclear detection and classification from hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images, yet cell classifiers remain largely confined to broad morphological categories owing to a reliance on manual annotations. Recent efforts have used spatial molecular measurements to supervise histological classification, but these approaches often require separate tissue sections or produce altered H&E staining, and the resulting cell-type annotations depend on subjective choices such as marker selection and clustering parameters. Here we develop XenoType, a framework that classifies cells into seven molecularly informed categories directly from routine histology, trained using paired same-section Xenium spatial transcriptomics. Cell-type annotations are reconciled from four single-cell RNA-sequencing references, reducing dependence on marker choices. Across eight held-out breast tissue sections, XenoType outperformed commonly used CellViT++ retrained on the same molecular annotations under both four-class (macro-F1: 0.703 vs. 0.569) and seven-class (macro-F1: 0.571 vs. 0.403) taxonomies, with the largest gains for myoepithelial (F1: 0.175 to 0.572) and endothelial cells (F1: 0.395 to 0.682). Molecular measurements are required only during training; at inference, XenoType uses the H&E image alone. Model-reference agreement increased consistently with annotation confidence, and XenoType generalized to an independently profiled breast tissue section from a different spatial transcriptomics platform, supporting scalable cell-type mapping from routine histology without per-specimen molecular profiling.
zh_abstract: 从组织学图像刻画肿瘤微环境的细胞组成，是理解癌症生物学并为治疗决策提供信息的基础。深度学习已使从苏木精-伊红（H&E）图像中进行自动化细胞核检测和分类成为可能，但细胞分类器仍主要局限于宽泛的形态学类别，原因在于其依赖人工注释。近期研究利用空间分子测量来监督组织学分类，但这些方法通常需要单独的组织切片或产生改变了的H&E染色，且所得细胞类型注释依赖于主观选择，如标记物选择和聚类参数。在此，我们开发了XenoType，一种可直接从常规组织学将细胞分类为七种分子信息指导类别的框架，并使用配对的同一切片Xenium空间转录组学进行训练。细胞类型注释由四个单细胞RNA测序参考数据集协调得到，减少了对标记物选择的依赖。在八个留出的乳腺组织切片上，XenoType在四分类（macro-F1：0.703 对 0.569）和七分类（macro-F1：0.571 对 0.403）分类体系下均优于在相同分子注释上重新训练的常用CellViT++，其中对肌上皮细胞（F1：0.175 至 0.572）和内皮细胞（F1：0.395 至 0.682）的提升最大。分子测量仅在训练期间需要；在推理时，XenoType仅使用H&E图像。模型与参考之间的一致性随着注释置信度提高而持续增加，且XenoType可泛化到来自不同空间转录组学平台的、独立进行分子谱分析的乳腺组织切片，支持在无需每个样本分子谱分析的情况下从常规组织学进行可扩展的细胞类型映射。

title: Artificial intelligence and machine learning: Shaping the future of venous thromboembolism diagnosis and prognosis.

abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Venous thromboembolism (VTE) continues to pose a substantial health issue worldwide, characterized by high rates of mortality and morbidity. The field of artificial intelligence (AI) has shown potential as a valuable asset for enhancing the detection and prediction of complex diseases, such as VTE. This review explores the role of AI in VTE prediction and diagnosis, analyzing various machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches, including natural language processing (NLP), support vector machines (SVM), random forests (RF), logistic regression (LR), gradient boosting methods, and deep learning frameworks such as ClotCatcher. Among the artificial intelligence models, those based on natural language processing algorithms, particularly ClotCatcher, demonstrated strong performance in analyzing unstructured clinical data. ClotCatcher achieved exceptional Area under the Curve (AUC) values of 0.980 and 0.995 for venous thromboembolism (VTE) adjudication from radiology reports. AI-driven methodologies facilitate early detection, personalized risk assessment, and enhanced patient outcomes. AI holds great potential for improving VTE diagnosis and risk assessment, offering greater accuracy and efficiency than traditional methods. However, further studies are required to validate these models across diverse populations and clinical environments. The integration of AI in VTE management represents a promising frontier in personalized medicine, potentially leading to improved outcomes and more efficient healthcare delivery.
zh_abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] 静脉血栓栓塞症（VTE）在全球范围内仍是一个重大健康问题，其特征是死亡率和发病率较高。人工智能（AI）领域已显示出作为宝贵工具的潜力，可增强对VTE等复杂疾病的检测和预测。本综述探讨AI在VTE预测和诊断中的作用，分析各种机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）方法，包括自然语言处理（NLP）、支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（RF）、逻辑回归（LR）、梯度提升方法，以及ClotCatcher等深度学习框架。在人工智能模型中，基于自然语言处理算法的模型，尤其是ClotCatcher，在分析非结构化临床数据方面表现出很强的性能。ClotCatcher在从放射学报告中进行静脉血栓栓塞症（VTE）判定方面取得了优异的曲线下面积（AUC）值，分别为0.980和0.995。AI驱动的方法有助于早期检测、个性化风险评估和改善患者结局。AI在改善VTE诊断和风险评估方面具有巨大潜力，比传统方法提供更高的准确性和效率。然而，还需要进一步研究以在不同人群和临床环境中验证这些模型。将AI整合到VTE管理中代表了个性化医学的一个有前景的前沿方向，可能带来结局改善和更高效的医疗服务提供。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Pennsylvania; conditions: Population Health Management, Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS), Chronic Lung Diseases, Artificial Intelligence (AI); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 45; status: RECRUITING] Patients living with chronic lung diseases (CLD) are at high risk of frailty, malnutrition, and depression. However, many of the interventions targeting these conditions are underutilized. Thus, artificial intelligence-based clinical decision support systems (AI-CDSS) offer a promising approach to guide targeted interventions for this population and reduce risk of hospitalization. The purpose of this study is to assess the acceptability and feasibility of a new AI-CDSS for community-dwelling patients with CLD. The goal of this AI-CDSS is to predict the probability that patients would benefit from 5 frailty- and depression-focused interventions (pulmonary rehabilitation, physical therapy, fall-risk assessment, nutrition consultation, and depression consultation). In this study, pulmonologists will review the AI-CDSS's predictions and have the option to recommend referrals for their patients. If a referral is recommended, the study team will contact the patient to discuss the referral and start the referral process. All participants will then complete a semi-structured interview and feedback survey asking their opinions about the AI-CDSS and the study referral process.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：宾夕法尼亚大学；疾病/状况：人群健康管理、临床决策支持系统（CDSS）、慢性肺部疾病、人工智能（AI）；类型：干预性；阶段：不适用（NA）；入组人数：45；状态：招募中] 患有慢性肺部疾病（CLD）的患者面临衰弱、营养不良和抑郁的高风险。然而，针对这些状况的许多干预措施利用不足。因此，基于人工智能的临床决策支持系统（AI-CDSS）为指导针对该人群的针对性干预并降低住院风险提供了一种有前景的方法。本研究的目的是评估一种新型AI-CDSS对居住在社区的CLD患者的可接受性和可行性。该AI-CDSS的目标是预测患者从5项聚焦衰弱和抑郁的干预措施（肺康复、物理治疗、跌倒风险评估、营养咨询和抑郁咨询）中获益的概率。在本研究中，肺科医生将审查AI-CDSS的预测，并可以选择为其患者推荐转诊。如果推荐转诊，研究团队将联系患者讨论转诊并启动转诊流程。随后，所有参与者将完成半结构化访谈和反馈调查，询问他们对AI-CDSS和研究转诊流程的看法。

title: Artificial intelligence model for pancreatic cancer risk prediction in patients with pancreatic cystic lesions
zh_title: 胰腺囊性病变患者胰腺癌风险的 AI 预测模型
summary: npj Digital Medicine 用放射报告与临床数据构建 AI 模型预测胰腺囊性病变患者未来胰腺癌风险，多中心回顾队列 8707 例。
key_points: 13 年回顾队列，23,398 份腹部 CT/MRI 报告
430 例（1.8%）后续发生胰腺癌
XGBoost 最优，AUC 0.960/0.945/0.944
reason: 大样本多中心回顾研究，但摘要未显示独立外部验证，按回顾性内部验证档上限计
abstract: Pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) are prevalent and potential precursors of pancreatic cancer. Cancer risk assessment is a crucial step in PCL management, but the complexity and limited accuracy of existing approaches contribute to suboptimal patient care. We developed and validated an artificial intelligence (AI) model that uses radiology reports and clinical data to predict the future risk of pancreatic cancer in patients with PCLs. The model was developed and tested in a 13-year retrospective cohort comprising 23,398 abdominal CT/MRI examination reports from 8707 patients with PCLs across a multisite healthcare system. Of these, 430 (1.8%) corresponded to patients who later developed pancreatic cancer, defined as adenocarcinoma, invasive mucinous neoplasm, or high-grade dysplasia. Among the models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest performance, with AUCs of 0.960, 0.945, and 0.944 for predicting pancreatic cancer incidence at 1, 3, and 5 years after imaging, respectively. The model outperformed guideline-based risk stratification, with AUC improvements of 0.161 to 0.235 (P < 0.001). For examinations conducted within a year before cancer diagnosis, radiologists identified potential cancer in 51.5% of cases, while the AI model flagged 82.3%. These findings support the potential of AI to complement existing approaches for individualized pancreatic cancer risk stratification in patients with PCLs.
zh_abstract: 胰腺囊性病变（PCLs）很常见，并且是胰腺癌的潜在前驱病变。癌症风险评估是 PCL 管理中的关键步骤，但现有方法的复杂性和有限准确性导致患者照护欠佳。我们开发并验证了一种人工智能（AI）模型，该模型使用放射学报告和临床数据来预测 PCL 患者未来发生胰腺癌的风险。该模型在一个为期13年的回顾性队列中开发并测试，该队列包含来自多站点医疗系统8707例 PCL 患者的23,398份腹部 CT/MRI 检查报告。其中，430份（1.8%）对应后来发生胰腺癌的患者，胰腺癌定义为腺癌、浸润性黏液性肿瘤或高级别异型增生。在评估的模型中，XGBoost 取得了最高性能，在预测影像检查后1年、3年和5年胰腺癌发病风险方面的 AUC 分别为0.960、0.945和0.944。该模型优于基于指南的风险分层，AUC 提升为0.161至0.235（P < 0.001）。对于癌症诊断前一年内进行的检查，放射科医生在51.5%的病例中识别出潜在癌症，而 AI 模型提示了82.3%。这些发现支持 AI 在 PCL 患者个体化胰腺癌风险分层中补充现有方法的潜力。

title: VoxelSlicer: Adaptive Voxel-wise Slicer for Deformable Image Registration.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: VoxelSlicer：面向可变形图像配准的自适应体素切片模块
summary: IEEE TMI 提出 VoxelSlicer 神经模块，通过可学习自适应滤波实现体素级滤波，改善形变配准中的局部不连续与消息传递效率。
key_points: 针对腹部跨受试者与心脏等高度形变场景
以双边网格为灵感，做可学习自适应滤波
指出现有各向同性成对正则导致边界过平滑
reason: 同行评审方法创新，摘要未提外部验证、临床结局或开源，属值得一看档
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Recent progress in neural networks has accelerated deformable image registration (DIR) by amortizing iterative optimization, offering faster results and potential accuracy gains with label supervision. However, existing methods struggle with highly deformed structures (e.g., inter-subject abdominal or intra-subject cardiac scans) and fail to handle complex motions like sliding or respiratory dynamics. This limitation arises from isotropic diffusive pair-wise regularization, which leads to inefficient message passing and oversmoothed boundaries. We propose VoxelSlicer, a novel neural network module inspired by the traditional bilateral grid but enhanced with learnable adaptive filtering. VoxelSlicer enables voxel-wise adaptive filtering, addressing local discontinuities in displacement fields and performs more efficient message passing. This design enables adaptive displacement-cost propagation with a compact parameter footprint and a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off. Experiments on four realistic datasets and two synthetic datasets with different modalities and input constraints demonstrate VoxelSlicer's competitive registration performance together with favorable accuracy-complexity and accuracy-smoothness trade-offs.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 神经网络的最新进展通过分摊迭代优化过程，加速了可变形图像配准（DIR），提供了更快的结果，并有可能在标签监督下获得精度提升。然而，现有方法难以处理高度变形的结构（例如受试者间腹部扫描或受试者内心脏扫描），并且无法处理诸如滑动或呼吸动力学等复杂运动。这一局限源于各向同性扩散成对正则化，其导致低效的消息传递和边界过平滑。我们提出 VoxelSlicer，这是一种受传统双边网格启发但通过可学习自适应滤波增强的新型神经网络模块。VoxelSlicer 能够实现体素级自适应滤波，处理位移场中的局部不连续，并执行更高效的消息传递。该设计以紧凑的参数占用和有利的精度-复杂度权衡，实现自适应位移-代价传播。在四个真实数据集和两个具有不同模态和输入约束的合成数据集上的实验表明，VoxelSlicer 具有有竞争力的配准性能，并呈现有利的精度-复杂度和精度-平滑度权衡。

title: Continually pretrained open-weight language models can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based clinical prediction
zh_title: 持续预训练开放权重模型用于EHR临床预测
summary: 扩展12B开放权重模型词表并继续预训练单中心17万患者病历，三项预测任务AUROC均优于梯度提升树与CEHR-BERT。
key_points: 加入17601个临床与审计日志编码，续训47亿token
出院、再入院、ICU AKI三项AUROC为0.917/0.715/0.847
续训带来0.031-0.053提升；10%标签即超基线全标签
reason: 大样本单中心内部验证预印本，对比充分但无外部验证，封顶6分
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompted with electronic health record (EHR) data have predicted clinical outcomes less accurately than locally trained machine-learning models. We developed VEX-EHR by extending the vocabulary of a 12-billion-parameter open-weight LLM (weights publicly available) with 17,601 clinical and audit-log codes from 170,483 patients' records at one academic medical center, continuing its pretraining on those 2019-2024 records (4.7 billion tokens) and fine-tuning it per task. AUROCs were 0.917 for next-24-hour discharge, 0.715 for 30-day readmission and 0.847 for intensive care unit acute kidney injury, against 0.868, 0.677 and 0.828 for gradient-boosted trees and 0.848, 0.650 and 0.791 for CEHR-BERT, an EHR foundation model. Continued pretraining added 0.031-0.053 AUROC on every task. With 10% of the labels, VEX-EHR exceeded both comparators using all labels for discharge, and CEHR-BERT for readmission, valuable where labels are costly. Adapted by continued pretraining, open-weight LLMs can outperform traditional machine learning in EHR-based prediction.
zh_abstract: 以电子健康记录（EHR）数据为提示的大语言模型（LLM）在预测临床结局方面不如本地训练的机器学习模型准确。我们开发了VEX-EHR：将一个120亿参数开放权重LLM（权重公开可用）的词汇表扩展为来自一家学术医学中心170,483名患者记录中的17,601个临床和审计日志代码，在这些2019-2024年记录（47亿个token）上继续预训练，并按任务进行微调。AUROC为：未来24小时内出院0.917、30天再入院0.715、重症监护病房急性肾损伤0.847；相比之下，梯度提升树分别为0.868、0.677和0.828，EHR基础模型CEHR-BERT分别为0.848、0.650和0.791。继续预训练在每个任务上增加了0.031-0.053 AUROC。仅使用10%的标签时，VEX-EHR在出院任务上超过了使用全部标签的两个对照模型，在再入院任务上超过了CEHR-BERT，这在标签成本高昂时很有价值。通过继续预训练进行适配后，开放权重LLM在基于EHR的预测中可以优于传统机器学习。

title: KMed-31B Technical Report
zh_title: KMed-31B医疗大模型技术报告
summary: 基于开放权重模型后训练的医疗大模型，按任务反馈类型分四类专家训练，再用多教师策略蒸馏合并，面向低算力本地部署。
key_points: 按参考答案/评分标准两类属性划分四类医疗任务
每类训练专家模型，用MOPD²多教师蒸馏合并为单模型
构建合成健康对话语料用于临床问询类任务
reason: 有新意的多专家蒸馏方法预印本，但缺外部评测与公开结果细节
abstract: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD^2). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.
zh_abstract: 我们提出KMed-31B，这是一种基于开放权重模型后训练的医学大语言模型，可在硬件有限的条件下本地部署。针对多样医学任务对模型进行后训练仍然困难，因为改善一类任务可能会降低另一类任务的性能。我们将此归因于任务之间在预期输出和可用反馈方面的差异。医学问答和诊断预测有参考答案，而临床询问没有唯一正确答案，并使用评分细则进行评判。因此，我们按这两个属性将医学训练任务分为四类，为每个类别训练一个专家模型，并使用其反馈所支持的奖励，然后通过多教师同策略增量蒸馏（Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation，MOPD^2）将各专家整合到单个学生模型中。针对临床询问，我们构建了Synthetic Health Dialogue，这是一个与普通用户和临床医生进行咨询的模拟语料库，其患者病例涵盖初级保健中的常见临床表现。相对于其基础模型，KMed-31B在非思考模式下将HealthBench Hard从22.95提高到41.87，将HealthBench Professional从37.92提高到50.20；在思考模式下分别从23.80提高到51.48、从41.97提高到59.18，同时其在四个多项选择医学基准上的得分保持不变或略有提高。在比较的模型中，包括专有模型，KMed-31B具有最高的未调整HealthBench Hard得分，并且在我们比较的所有开放权重模型中，包括总参数量超过其十倍的模型，其在HealthBench Professional上的得分更高。将相同的训练方案应用于另一个基础模型Qwen3.8-27B，也提高了两个HealthBench得分。我们详细描述了训练方案、数据构建和设置，以便需要本地部署的机构能够从开放权重基础模型开发医学模型。

title: Targeted Artificial Intelligence Language mOdel Recommendations for Chronic Kidney Disease
zh_title: AI向临床医生推送慢性肾病用药建议的试验
summary: 一项注册的干预性研究，在Epic Huddle笔记中向内分泌/心内科医生推送患者个体化用药建议，采用前后对照设计，计划入组300例。
key_points: 干预：AI审阅病历并生成个体化用药推荐
非随机前后对照，同一批医生实施前后各3-6个月

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Brigham and Women's Hospital; conditions: Chronic Kidney Disease Due to Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 300; status: RECRUITING] This study tests whether artificial intelligence messages to clinicians improve the use of recommended medicines in adults with diabetes and chronic kidney disease. The tool reviews existing medical records and places patient-specific recommendations in internal Epic Huddle notes before endocrinology or cardiology visits at Mass General Brigham. Eligible visits during approximately 3-6 months before implementation are compared with visits during approximately 3-6 months afterward among the same clinicians, without randomization. Outcomes include medication optimization within 30 days, message delivery, and short-term safety. Patients are not contacted, and all treatment decisions remain with clinicians and patients.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Brigham and Women's Hospital；疾病：2型糖尿病所致慢性肾脏病；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组人数：300；状态：招募中] 本研究检验向临床医生发送人工智能消息是否能改善糖尿病合并慢性肾脏病成人患者对推荐药物的使用。该工具审查现有病历，并在Mass General Brigham的内分泌科或心内科就诊前，将针对患者的建议放入内部Epic Huddle记录中。研究将实施前约3-6个月内的合格就诊与实施后约3-6个月内同一批临床医生的就诊进行比较，不进行随机化。结局包括30天内用药优化、消息送达和短期安全性。不会联系患者，所有治疗决定仍由临床医生和患者作出。

title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study
zh_title: LLM评审能否识别不安全临床操作
summary: 在MedAgentBench中注入受控临床错误，用416条错误轨迹测试六个开放权重模型评审者能否识别危险操作。
key_points: 416条故障轨迹、8类错误、6个开放权重评审模型
与正确轨迹配对，区分真实识别与泛化性误报
提供临床证据可显著提升评审可靠性
reason: 智能体安全评测方法有新意，属基准研究预印本，证据范围有限
abstract: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.
zh_abstract: 随着临床AI智能体开始与电子健康记录（EHR）交互，大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于评估其行为。但这些评判模型识别临床危险错误的可靠性如何，尤其是当智能体看起来已成功完成任务时？我们利用MedAgentBench研究这一问题，将受控临床错误引入经核验的智能体轨迹中。实验包括416条错误轨迹、八个错误类别和六个开放权重LLM评判模型。通过将每条错误轨迹与其正确对应轨迹进行比较，我们衡量评判模型是真正识别错误，还是仅仅将更多行为标记为不安全。研究发现，获取临床证据显著提高评判模型的可靠性。仅展示最终答案时，评判模型无法区分不改变最终答案的错误，同时会将56%的正确轨迹标记为不安全。提供完整轨迹信息时，区分不安全行为与正确行为的能力达到0.75分，而提供实际EHR响应使区分能力提高0.39。令人惊讶的是，纳入智能体的推理并未提高总体性能，反而使对错误报告的临床数值的检出率降低0.18，而这些仍是最难检测的错误。MedGemma的表现劣于通用模型，并且是唯一漏掉可能危险药物过量的评判模型。我们还发现，该基准的原始评分器接受了所有38条故意跳过实验室检查的轨迹，而将LLM评判模型与基于完整EHR记录构建的规则检查器相结合，可检测出97%的注入错误。

abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma is a highly heterogeneous disease, highlighting the need for more accurate prognosis prediction. We developed a multimodal deep learning model combining preoperative computed tomography (CT) and postoperative whole slide image (WSI) to predict the disease-free survival (DFS) of resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma. Based on a cohort of 1078 patients from multiple centers, our dual-information instance neural network achieved superior performance over unimodal approaches. The risk stratification defined by the model effectively distinguished DFS in both validation cohorts and served as an independent predictor, suggesting the complementary value of the model beyond clinicopathological factors. An exploratory scoring system integrating the model-derived risk stratification with key clinicopathological factors was developed, identifying patients with significantly different prognostic outcomes. Further analyses suggested that patients with high-risk stage IB disease or high scores might derive DFS benefit from adjuvant chemotherapy, warranting prospective validation. Beyond its predictive capacity, the model also provided morphological insights, identifying prognostically significant structures such as tertiary lymphoid structures and stroma barriers, while RNA-sequencing analysis revealed distinct oncogenic pathway activation and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironments in high-risk patients. By leveraging routinely acquired clinical images, this multimodal approach offers a practical tool for improving prognostic stratification, with potential implications for informing patient selection for adjuvant chemotherapy in resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma.
zh_abstract: 肺腺癌是一种高度异质性疾病，这凸显了对更准确预后预测的需求。我们开发了一种多模态深度学习模型，结合术前计算机断层扫描（CT）和术后全切片图像（WSI），以预测已切除的I期肺腺癌的无病生存期（DFS）。基于来自多个中心的1078例患者队列，我们的双信息实例神经网络取得了优于单模态方法的性能。该模型定义的风险分层在两个验证队列中均有效区分了DFS，并作为独立预测因子，提示该模型在临床病理因素之外具有互补价值。我们开发了一个探索性评分系统，将模型衍生的风险分层与关键临床病理因素整合，识别出预后结局显著不同的患者。进一步分析提示，高风险IB期疾病或高评分患者可能从辅助化疗中获得DFS获益，值得前瞻性验证。除预测能力外，该模型还提供了形态学见解，识别出具有预后意义的结构，如三级淋巴结构和间质屏障，而RNA测序分析揭示高风险患者中存在不同的致癌通路激活和免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境。通过利用常规获取的临床图像，这种多模态方法提供了一种改善预后分层的实用工具，并可能对指导已切除I期肺腺癌患者辅助化疗的患者选择具有潜在意义。

title: Reimagining inflammatory bowel disease in the age of artificial intelligence: discovery, care, education, and sustainability for the next decade.
zh_title: AI时代炎症性肠病的未来十年展望
summary: 观点文章讨论多模态基础模型如何重塑炎症性肠病的科学发现、诊疗、教育与可持续性。

abstract: [Journal of Crohn's & colitis] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly evolving from task-specific algorithms to multimodal foundation models capable of integrating heterogeneous biological and clinical data across the health-care continuum. In inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), this transformation offers an unprecedented opportunity to move beyond fragmented analyses toward a unified understanding and management of disease. Artificial intelligence is emerging as the connective infrastructure linking scientific discovery, therapeutic development, patient care, education, and health-care delivery systems into continuously learning ecosystems. In this viewpoint, we explore how AI may reshape IBD over the next decade through 5 interconnected domains. Advances in multimodal AI accelerate biological discovery by integrating multiomics, spatial biology, and foundation models to identify mechanistic disease endotypes. Simultaneously, AI can shorten the path from molecular discovery to therapeutic innovation by supporting target identification, predicting protein structure, drug positioning, and adaptive clinical trial design. These scientific advances converge at the bedside, where multimodal AI may transform patient care from reactive management to predictive precision medicine through integrated diagnostics, digital biomarkers, real-time monitoring and individualized risk prediction. Beyond clinical care, AI is redefining medical education by enabling adaptive learning, explainable decision support, and democratized specialist expertise, while contributing to sustainable health care through optimized resource allocation, workforce support, and continuously learning systems. Realizing this vision will require robust governance, interoperability, prospective validation, and equitable implementation. If responsibly deployed, AI holds the potential to redefine IBD diagnosis, classification, therapeutic strategies and management within an intelligent ecosystem able to accelerate discovery, personalize care, and improve outcomes for patients and health-care systems alike.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Crohn's & colitis] 人工智能（AI）正迅速从任务特定算法演变为能够整合贯穿医疗保健连续体的异质性生物学和临床数据的多模态基础模型。在炎症性肠病（IBD）中，这一转变提供了前所未有的机会，使人们能够超越碎片化分析，转向对疾病的统一理解和管理。人工智能正在成为连接性基础设施，将科学发现、治疗开发、患者护理、教育和医疗保健提供系统连接成持续学习的生态系统。在这篇观点文章中，我们探讨AI在未来十年如何通过5个相互关联的领域重塑IBD。多模态AI的进步通过整合多组学、空间生物学和基础模型来识别机制性疾病内型，从而加速生物学发现。同时，AI可通过支持靶点识别、预测蛋白质结构、药物定位和适应性临床试验设计，缩短从分子发现到治疗创新的路径。这些科学进展汇聚于床旁，在那里多模态AI可能通过整合诊断、数字生物标志物、实时监测和个体化风险预测，将患者护理从反应性管理转变为预测性精准医学。除临床护理外，AI正在重新定义医学教育，通过实现自适应学习、可解释决策支持和专科专业知识的民主化，同时通过优化资源分配、劳动力支持和持续学习系统为可持续医疗保健做出贡献。实现这一愿景将需要稳健的治理、互操作性、前瞻性验证和公平实施。如果负责任地部署，AI有潜力在能够加速发现、个性化护理并改善患者和医疗保健系统结局的智能生态系统中重新定义IBD的诊断、分类、治疗策略和管理。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University; conditions: Pulmonary Nodules, Lung Cancer (Diagnosis); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will test how well an existing artificial intelligence (AI) model can use photos of the surface of the eyes to tell whether lung nodules are benign or cancerous. The study plans to enroll 1,000 adults at several hospitals in China. Their lung nodules have already been found on a chest CT scan, and their doctors have already scheduled surgery as part of usual care. The research team will take photos of both eyes before surgery and compare the AI results with the findings from routine laboratory examination of the tissue removed during surgery. The AI results are for research only and will not guide patient care. The study does not require additional CT scans, blood draws, or long-term follow-up. The findings will inform future studies of whether eye photos could help identify people who may benefit from chest CT screening.

title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
zh_title: 从孟加拉语患者自述预测就诊专科的模型比较
summary: 比较机器学习、深度学习、Transformer与LLM从孟加拉语患者自述预测就诊专科，XLM-RoBERTa最佳，准确率86.26%。
key_points: 语料3798条、20个专科，取5个专科2730条
XLM-RoBERTa准确率86.26%、宏F1 86.21%
所有模型共用同一80:20内部划分，无外部验证
reason: 规范的回顾性模型比较，但仅内部划分、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best DL model was Bidirectional GRU (80.77%, 80.83%), and the best LLM was Gemini (90.29%, 90.15%). Holm-corrected paired McNemar tests show SVM significantly outperforming Bi-LSTM (adjusted p = 0.004), whereas the Gemini-versus-Grok gap does not survive correction (adjusted p = 0.104), and neither the strongest transformer versus the weakest LLM (Grok) nor SVM versus the strongest transformer reaches significance. A tuned classical model is thus statistically indistinguishable from the strongest transformer, so accuracy rankings alone should not be read as evidence of one family's superiority. The findings provide a comparative baseline for Bangla medical text classification.
zh_abstract: 在孟加拉国医疗保健系统中，及时获得合适的专科医生仍然是一个瓶颈，因为患者用非正式孟加拉语而非临床术语描述症状，导致转诊无效。本文比较了四类模型家族，用于从孟加拉语患者叙述中预测医学专科：使用混合TF-IDF特征的六个机器学习（ML）模型、使用在语料库上训练的Word2Vec嵌入的四个深度学习（DL）模型、四个微调Transformer以及五个以零样本方式评估的大语言模型（LLM）。从涵盖20个专科的3798份患者记录语料库中，我们保留了记录最多的五个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、胃肠病学），并将所得的2730份记录按80:20分为所有模型家族共享的训练集和测试集。最佳Transformer为XLM-RoBERTa（准确率86.26%，宏F1 86.21%），最佳ML模型为SVM（84.98%，84.92%），最佳DL模型为双向GRU（80.77%，80.83%），最佳LLM为Gemini（90.29%，90.15%）。Holm校正的配对McNemar检验显示，SVM显著优于Bi-LSTM（校正后P = 0.004），而Gemini与Grok之间的差距未通过校正（校正后P = 0.104），并且最强Transformer与最弱LLM（Grok）之间以及SVM与最强Transformer之间均未达到显著性。因此，经调优的经典模型在统计学上与最强Transformer无法区分，所以仅凭准确率排名不应被解读为某一模型家族更优的证据。这些发现为孟加拉语医学文本分类提供了比较基线。

title: Cloud vs. on-premise large language models for urgent patient-portal message screening: a comparative evaluation
zh_title: 云端与本地大模型筛查患者门户紧急消息对比
summary: 以医生判定为参照，在三个队列中比较六种大模型对患者门户消息的紧急分诊能力，其中包含可本地部署的开源权重模型。

reason: 同行评审、含外部队列与医生金标准对照，但样本未达数千例且无临床结局
abstract: Patient portal messaging carries a substantial share of outpatient communication, and rising message volume has slowed clinical response to urgent concerns embedded in routine traffic. Whether large language models (LLMs) can triage these messages, and whether locally hosted open-weight models can match cloud-hosted ones, remains unclear. We evaluated six LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, Llama 4 Scout, GPT-OSS 20B, Gemma 3 27B) against a physician reference standard in three cohorts: 500 primary care messages enriched for urgent cases, 503 epilepsy clinic messages from the same health system, and 300 patient-authored messages from public platforms outside it. Under Majority adjudication in primary care, GPT-5 missed no urgent message, and four of six models, including one deployable on-premises, reached sensitivity 0.97 or higher and negative predictive value 0.98 or higher. Rank ordering held across cohorts. Both cloud-hosted and on-premise LLMs can rule out urgent messages with high sensitivity, though specificity remained limited.
zh_abstract: 患者门户消息（patient portal messaging）在门诊沟通中占有相当大的比例，而消息量的上升已减缓临床对常规信息流中紧急关切的响应。大型语言模型（LLMs）能否对这些消息进行分诊，以及本地托管的开放权重模型能否与云端托管模型相匹敌，仍不明确。我们在三个队列中，参照医生参考标准评估了六种 LLM（GPT-4o、GPT-5、GPT-5 Mini、Llama 4 Scout、GPT-OSS 20B、Gemma 3 27B）：500 条针对紧急病例富集的初级保健消息、来自同一医疗系统的 503 条癫痫门诊消息，以及来自该系统之外公共平台的 300 条患者撰写消息。在初级保健的多数裁决（Majority adjudication）下，GPT-5 未漏掉任何紧急消息，六种模型中有四种（包括一种可本地部署的模型）达到灵敏度 0.97 或更高、阴性预测值 0.98 或更高。排序在各队列中保持一致。云端托管和本地部署的 LLM 均能以高灵敏度排除紧急消息，但特异度仍有限。

title: Epidemiology-informed graph neural networks for predicting and interpreting transmissible hospital-acquired infections
zh_title: 流行病学信息图神经网络预测医院感染

abstract: Transmissible hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) arise from complex, time-varying interactions among patients, healthcare workers, and clinical environments. Although data-driven approaches like graph neural networks (GNNs) effectively model these contacts, they often function as black boxes that overlook established epidemiological principles, limiting interpretability and clinical trust. Inspired by physics-informed neural networks, we propose an epidemiology-informed GNN (EIGNN) framework for patient-level state transitions prediction in dynamic hospital settings, integrating mechanistic epidemiological models into GNNs in a principled manner. Patient-level risk factors learned from dynamic contact networks are jointly leveraged to infer latent epidemiological states, predict state transitions across multiple horizons, and estimate key epidemiological parameters, including transmission and recovery rates. We evaluate the approach on a real-world hospital-onset COVID-19 cohort and two public datasets simulating viral and bacterial HAIs. Across multiple architectures and horizons, EIGNNs achieves AUC-ROC up to 98.46% while providing interpretable, mechanistically consistent insights, offering a transparent tool for infection prevention and control.
zh_abstract: 可传播的医院获得性感染（HAIs）源于患者、医护人员和临床环境之间复杂的、随时间变化的相互作用。尽管图神经网络（GNNs）等数据驱动方法能有效建模这些接触，但它们常作为黑箱运行，忽视既有的流行病学原理，限制了可解释性和临床信任。受物理信息神经网络启发，我们提出流行病学信息GNN（EIGNN）框架，用于动态医院环境中的患者级状态转移预测，以有原则的方式将机制性流行病学模型整合进GNNs。从动态接触网络学习到的患者级风险因素被联合利用，以推断潜在流行病学状态、预测多个时间跨度上的状态转移，并估计关键流行病学参数，包括传播率和恢复率。我们在一个真实世界医院发病COVID-19队列和两个模拟病毒性与细菌性HAIs的公开数据集上评估该方法。在多种架构和时间跨度上，EIGNNs达到最高98.46%的AUC-ROC，同时提供可解释、机制一致的洞见，为感染预防与控制提供透明工具。

abstract: Every few months, a cancer patient's CT scans decide whether treatment continues. 3D foundation models can now detect, segment, register and track lesions, yet none of them reads the scans as a radiologist does. A radiologist decides which findings are lesions, which are the same lesion months later and whether a new spot means progression, and checks each decision against the extensive rules of a clinical guideline. We introduce LesionAgent, an LLM agent that performs this read end to end without task-specific training. It operates frozen 3D models as tools, acts in 3D through coordinate-labelled views, remembers every lesion across visits in a registry, verifies every model output it relies on, and leaves every number to a deterministic guideline engine. On four public longitudinal CT datasets, LesionAgent tracks more lesions and measures them more accurately than every automatic basel

title: ClinDataBench: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Clinical Trial Analysis Dataset Construction
zh_title: ClinDataBench：评估LLM智能体构建临床试验分析数据集
summary: 预印本发布基于公开CDISC pilot的基准，评估LLM智能体生成合规可复现的ADaM分析数据集。
key_points: 智能体需从原始试验数据生成ADaM数据集

abstract: A new drug reaches patients only after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has reviewed its trial evidence, which every application carries as analysis datasets in the Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Analysis Data Model (ADaM) format that programmers derive by hand from raw trial data, a statistical analysis plan (SAP) and dataset specifications. Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) could take over this work, and a slow-changing industry will adopt them only with evidence of what they get right and wrong. However, work on large language models (LLMs) for CDISC data stops short of evaluating a complete, conformant and reproducible package, and the standard validator checks structure rather than whether each value is derived correctly. We introduce ClinDataBench, built on the public CDISC pilot study: an agent receives 22 Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) domains, the statistical analysis plan (SAP) and specifications, and must deliver 13 Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, Define-XML metadata and a program that rebuilds them offline. Agents run in containers whose only network route is their model API, restricting online access to published reference outputs during execution. A host-only evaluator scores conformance under the Pinnacle 21 Community (P21) validator, selected derivations, clean reconstruction and effort separately. We compare three settings: Base, which submits the agent's first package; Self-Refine, which revises it without external validation feedback; and CRITIC, which revises it with the agent's own validator report. In an exploratory pilot with six models, the three closed models and DeepSeek delivered all 13 datasets in every setting and eleven of their twelve packages rebuilt semantically, while two other open-weight models delivered no complete package. Validator findings ranged from 15 to 64 dataset-rule pairs. Four of six CRITIC workflows had usable validator comparisons, and each reduced its finding count. None reduced its failed derivation count. The package with the fewest findings carried none of the 234 efficacy summary records in the form the specifications define, showing that lower validator finding counts do not necessarily indicate more correct derivations.
zh_abstract: 一种新药只有在U.S. Food and Drug Administration（FDA）审查其试验证据后才会到达患者，每份申请都以Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium（CDISC）Analysis Data Model（ADaM）格式的分析数据集承载这些证据，而程序员需从原始试验数据、统计分析计划（SAP）和数据集规范中手工衍生这些数据集。基于大语言模型（LLMs）的编码智能体可以接管这项工作，而一个变化缓慢的行业只有在获得它们做对什么和做错什么的证据后才会采用它们。然而，针对CDISC数据的LLMs工作止步于评估一个完整、符合规范且可复现的包，而标准验证器检查的是结构，而不是每个值是否被正确衍生。我们提出ClinDataBench，它基于公开的CDISC试点研究构建：智能体接收22个Study Data Tabulation Model（SDTM）域、统计分析计划（SAP）和规范，并且必须交付13个Analysis Data Model（ADaM）数据集、Define-XML元数据以及一个可离线重建它们的程序。智能体在容器中运行，其唯一网络路径是其模型API，从而在执行期间限制对已发表参考输出的在线访问。仅主机端评估器分别对Pinnacle 21 Community（P21）验证器下的符合性、选定衍生项、干净重建和工作量进行评分。我们比较三种设置：Base，提交智能体的第一个包；Self-Refine，在没有外部验证反馈的情况下修订它；以及CRITIC，利用智能体自己的验证器报告修订它。在一项使用六个模型的探索性试点中，三个闭源模型和DeepSeek在每种设置下都交付了全部13个数据集，并且它们的十二个包中有十一个在语义上重建成功，而另外两个开放权重模型没有交付任何完整包。验证器发现的问题范围为15至64个数据集-规则对。六个CRITIC工作流中有四个具有可用的验证器比较，且每个都减少了其问题计数。没有一个减少了其失败的衍生项计数。问题计数最少的包没有以规范所定义的形式包含234条疗效汇总记录中的任何一条，表明较低的验证器问题计数并不一定表示更正确的衍生。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Precision medicine relies heavily on electronic health records (EHRs) to systematically capture longitudinal clinical data across populations. Integrating omics data, such as genomics, proteomics, and metabolomics, with EHRs holds transformative potential for individual-level disease risk assessment and therapeutic optimization. Recent advances in artificial intelligence, particularly multimodal learning algorithms, have enabled deeper exploration of EHR data, enhancing predictive modeling, patient stratification, and phenotyping. These artificial intelligence (AI)-driven approaches are expanding the scope of precision medicine from research contexts to scalable, real-time clinical decision-making. In real-world implementation, however, leveraging EHRs for precision medicine demands navigating complex technical, ethical, and operational challenges. These include data interoperability, model generalizability, and equity concerns. Future efforts should emphasize standardization, responsible AI practices, and integration of digital health and patient-reported outcomes to build learning health systems that are adaptive, equitable, and clinically impactful.
zh_abstract: 精准医学高度依赖电子健康记录（EHRs）来系统性地捕获跨人群的纵向临床数据。将组学数据（如基因组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学）与 EHR 整合，对于个体层面的疾病风险评估和治疗优化具有变革性潜力。人工智能的最新进展，尤其是多模态学习算法，使对 EHR 数据的更深入探索成为可能，从而增强了预测建模、患者分层和表型分析。这些由人工智能（AI）驱动的方法正在将精准医学的范围从研究情境扩展到可扩展的实时临床决策。然而在现实世界的实施中，利用 EHR 开展精准医学需要应对复杂的技术、伦理和运营挑战，包括数据互操作性、模型泛化性和公平性关切。未来的工作应强调标准化、负责任的人工智能实践，以及数字健康和患者报告结局的整合，以构建具有适应性、公平且具有临床影响力的学习型医疗系统。

abstract: Chamber-wide assessment of restitution dynamics is not feasible in vivo during atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. We reconstructed left-atrial digital twins from high-density (HD) bipolar electroanatomical maps in 323 patients, computed node-level restitution steepness (maximal restitution slope [Smax]; >0.4 million nodes), and induced virtual AF with standardized ramp pacing to classify sustainability (sustained ≥16 s vs non-sustained <16 s), excluding 32 cases with extensive low-voltage substrate and depressed mean Smax. We found that clustering of HD restitution profiles identifies four restitution patterns that stratify clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrence, with the Overall-Low pattern (aHR, 0.37) and the Average-Homogeneous pattern (aHR, 0.59) each showing lower risk than the Overall-High pattern. Furthermore, non-sustained virtual AF independently predicted lower recurrence (aHR: 0.27). Adding restitution pattern and sustainability to clinical covariates improved discrimination (ΔHarrell’s C-index: 0.050), and the combined digital-twin model remained incremental after adjustment for low-voltage area burden, supporting digital-twin outputs as complementary functional descriptors for risk stratification after pulmonary vein isolation.
zh_abstract: 在房颤（AF）消融术中，于体进行全腔恢复动力学评估不可行。我们基于 323 例患者的高密度（HD）双极电解剖标测图重建左心房数字孪生，计算节点级恢复陡度（最大恢复斜率 [Smax]；>40 万个节点），并用标准化斜坡起搏诱导虚拟 AF，以分类其可持续性（持续 ≥16 秒 vs 非持续 <16 秒），同时排除 32 例具有广泛低电压基质和平均 Smax 降低的病例。我们发现，HD 恢复谱的聚类识别出四种恢复模式，可对临床房性心律失常复发进行分层，其中 Overall-Low 模式（aHR，0.37）和 Average-Homogeneous 模式（aHR，0.59）均显示比 Overall-High 模式更低的风险。此外，非持续性虚拟 AF 独立预测较低的复发（aHR：0.27）。将恢复模式与可持续性加入临床协变量后改善了区分度（ΔHarrell’s C 指数：0.050），且联合数字孪生模型在调整低电压区负荷后仍具有增量价值，支持数字孪生输出作为肺静脉隔离后风险分层的补充功能描述指标。

title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient–Physician Communication — The AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
zh_title: 诊前AI生成通俗摘要对问诊时长与医患沟通的影响：AI-INFOCARE随机对照试验
summary: 单中心随机对照试验纳入300例神经外科门诊患者，评估诊前经人工质控的AI通俗版病情摘要对医患互动质量与问诊时长的影响。
key_points: 单中心门诊RCT，300名成人1:1随机分组
干预为经质量核查的AI生成通俗版病情摘要
主要终点为患者报告医患互动质量FAPI
reason: 前瞻性RCT并报告沟通与问诊时长结局，属重要档；单中心300例限制上限
abstract: Background Limited health literacy, clinical jargon, and time-constrained consultations often impair patients' understanding of medical findings. We evaluated whether AI-generated, quality-checked lay language summaries provided before consultations improve communication-related outcomes. Methods In this single-center, randomized trial in an outpatient neurosurgical setting, 300 adults were randomly assigned 1:1 to standard care with or without a quality-checked, AI-generated layperson summary of their medical findings (Simply Onno) before consultation. The primary end point was patient-reported quality of physician-patient interaction (Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]). Secondary end points included autonomy support (Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]), encounter difficulty (Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]), and consultation duration (minutes). Results The mean FAPI score was higher in the intervention group (4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54; difference, 0.17; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.05 to 0.29; P=0.005; Hedges' g=0.33), driven by shared decision-making (difference, 0.29; 95% CI, 0.15 to 0.42), with no evidence of a difference in perceived empathy. Patient-rated autonomy support was higher (difference, 0.14; 95% CI, 0.06 to 0.23), whereas physicians rated their own autonomy support slightly lower (difference, -0.12; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.21 to -0.04). Median consultation time was 25 versus 33 minutes in the intervention group versus the control group, respectively, an approximate 21% relative reduction (ratio of geometric means, 0.79; 95% CI, 0.70 to 0.88). For encounter difficulty (DDPRQ-10), we found potential evidence of a small increase (difference, 0.09; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.03 to 0.21). Secondary end point confidence intervals were unadjusted for multiplicity. Conclusions AI-generated summaries provided before outpatient neurosurgical consultations were associated with better patient-reported interaction quality and autonomy support and shorter consultations. Physicians rated their own autonomy support as slightly lower in the intervention group; evidence for increased encounter difficulty was limited, with confidence intervals compatible with no difference. These findings support further evaluation of quality-checked, patient-facing document translation; effects on clinical outcomes and clinician workload require confirmation before routine adoption.
zh_abstract: 【背景】有限的健康素养、临床术语以及时间受限的诊疗常常损害患者对医学发现的理解。我们评估了在诊疗前提供由AI生成并经质量核查的通俗语言摘要是否能改善与沟通相关的结果。【方法】在这项在门诊神经外科环境中开展的单中心随机试验中，300名成人按1:1随机分配至接受标准诊疗，加或不加在诊疗前提供其医学发现的由AI生成并经质量核查的通俗语言摘要（Simply Onno）。主要终点为患者报告的医患互动质量（Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]）。次要终点包括自主性支持（Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]）、就诊困难程度（Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]）以及诊疗时长（分钟）。【结果】干预组平均FAPI评分更高（4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54；差值0.17；95%置信区间[CI] 0.05至0.29；P=0.005；Hedges' g=0.33），这一差异由共同决策驱动（差值0.29；95% CI 0.15至0.42），而在感知共情方面无差异证据。患者评定的自主性支持更高（差值0.14；95% CI 0.06至0.23），而医生对自身提供的自主性支持评分略低（差值-0.12；聚类稳健95% CI -0.21至-0.04）。干预组与对照组的中位诊疗时长分别为25分钟与33分钟，相对降低约21%（几何均数比0.79；95% CI 0.70至0.88）。对于就诊困难程度（DDPRQ-10），我们发现可能存在小幅增加的证据（差值0.09；聚类稳健95% CI -0.03至0.21）。次要终点的置信区间未针对多重性进行调整。【结论】在门诊神经外科诊疗前提供AI生成摘要与患者报告的互动质量和自主性支持更好以及诊疗时间更短相关。干预组中医生对自身提供的自主性支持评分略低；就诊困难程度增加的证据有限，其置信区间与无差异相容。这些发现支持进一步评估经质量核查、面向患者的文档翻译；在常规采用之前，其对临床结局和临床医生工作量的影响仍需确认。

title: Artificial Intelligence–Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction — Development and External Validation in Prospective Multicenter Studies
zh_title: AI增强听诊识别左心室功能不全：前瞻性多中心开发与外部验证
summary: 前瞻性多中心研究开发并外部验证结合数字听诊与单导联心电的AI集成模型，用于识别左室射血分数≤40%的左心室功能不全。
key_points: 四个标准听诊部位采集心音并同步单导联心电
