abstract: Background Left ventricular dysfunction (LVD) is common and associated with adverse prognosis, even in asymptomatic individuals. Early treatment improves outcomes, underscoring the need for efficient strategies to identify patients who may benefit from echocardiographic evaluation. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an AI auscultation method to detect LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography. Methods In this prospective, multicenter study, adult patients referred for echocardiography were enrolled to undergo digital auscultation at four standard auscultation sites with simultaneous single-lead ECGs. LVD was defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) less than or equal to 40% on concurrent echocardiography. An ensemble model combining a transformer-based network and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network was trained on multicenter data and externally validated. The model's performance was compared with a seven-cardiologist reader substudy and clinical logistic regression models incorporating clinical variables, single-lead ECG-derived features, and B-type natriuretic peptide levels. Results The multicenter training cohort included 2359 patients (mean age, 69.7±13.5 years; 40.4% female; 8.9% with reduced LVEF). The external validation cohort of 964 patients (mean age, 68.6±15.4 years; 38.9% female; 7.6% with reduced LVEF) was obtained from another independent multicenter registry. The four-site AI auscultation outperformed ECG-only models and the clinical logistic models, achieving an area under the receiver operator curve (AUROC) of 0.926 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.911 to 0.939) in the training cohort. In the external validation cohort, AUROC was 0.904 (95% CI, 0.876 to 0.930) and sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were 86.3%, 74.2%, and 75.1%, respectively. In a 100-patient reader substudy, AI auscultation outperformed cardiologist consensus in accuracy (82.0% vs. 62.0%; P=0.004). Model performance was consistent across prespecified subgroups. The simplified two-site auscultation model retained high accuracy in the external validation cohort (AUROC, 0.903; 95% CI, 0.878 to 0.927). Conclusions AI auscultation accurately detected LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography, supporting its potential as a scalable and accessible pre-echocardiographic risk-enrichment tool. Further validation is warranted before broader screening applications. (Funded by AMI Inc
zh_abstract: 【背景】左心室功能障碍（LVD）常见，并且与不良预后相关，即使在无症状个体中也是如此。早期治疗可改善结局，这凸显了需要高效策略来识别可能从超声心动图评估中获益的患者。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一种AI听诊方法，用于在因临床指征转诊接受超声心动图检查的患者中检测LVD。【方法】在这项前瞻性、多中心研究中，因超声心动图检查转诊的成人患者被纳入，在四个标准听诊部位接受数字听诊，并同步记录单导联心电图。LVD定义为同期超声心动图显示左心室射血分数（LVEF）小于或等于40%。一个结合基于transformer的网络和一维卷积神经网络的集成模型在多中心数据上训练并进行外部验证。该模型的性能与一项由七名心脏科医生判读的子研究以及纳入临床变量、单导联心电图衍生特征和B型利钠肽水平的临床逻辑回归模型进行比较。【结果】多中心训练队列包括2359例患者（平均年龄69.7±13.5岁；女性40.4%；8.9%伴LVEF降低）。964例患者的外部验证队列（平均年龄68.6±15.4岁；女性38.9%；7.6%伴LVEF降低）来自另一个独立的多中心注册登记。四部位AI听诊优于仅使用心电图的模型和临床逻辑回归模型，在训练队列中达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.926（95%置信区间[CI] 0.911至0.939）。在外部验证队列中，AUROC为0.904（95% CI 0.876至0.930），敏感性、特异性和准确度分别为86.3%、74.2%和75.1%。在一项100例患者的判读者子研究中，AI听诊在准确度上优于心脏科医生共识判读（82.0% vs. 62.0%；P=0.004）。模型性能在预设亚组中保持一致。简化的两部位听诊模型在外部验证队列中保持高准确度（AUROC 0.903；95% CI 0.878至0.927）。【结论】AI听诊能够准确检测因临床指征转诊接受超声心动图检查患者中的LVD，支持其作为可扩展且可及的超声心动图前风险富集工具的潜力。在更广泛筛查应用之前仍需进一步验证。（由 AMI Inc 资助

title: ECG foundation models for cardiovascular screening in a cohort of young competitive athletes

summary: 在8.7万条心电上微调三个心电基础模型，仅用43例专家标注运动员心电测试，显示明显域偏移。

abstract: AI-powered cardiac screening could evolve sports medicine by boosting accuracy, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, with automated ECG interpretation based on foundation models becoming key for large-scale athlete screening. Before deployment, it is crucial to verify whether these clinically developed models are applicable to this population. We evaluated whether ECG foundation models trained on general clinical populations can diagnose athlete-specific ECG findings. We fine-tuned three models (ECG-FM, HuBERT-ECG, ECGFounder) on PhysioNet/CinC 2021, 87,662 samples, and tested them on 43 expert-annotated ECGs from highly trained/national-level athletes. Performance was strong on PhysioNet/CinC 2021 (AUROC 0.97, AUPRC 0.57, Sensitivity 0.89) but dropped on athletes’ data, confirming domain shift. ECGFounder performed best (AUROC 0.84, AUPRC 0.72, Sensitivity 0.57) and detected the most frequent findings, Sinus Bradycardia (AUROC 0.87) and Sinus Arrhythmia (AUROC 0.95), well. Per-label estimates for rare classes must be interpreted cautiously, given the small cohort. This work contributes to developing athlete-focused AI frameworks for reliable ECG-based screening.
zh_abstract: 人工智能驱动的心脏筛查可能通过提高准确性、效率和成本效益来推动运动医学发展，而基于基础模型的自动化心电图解读正成为大规模运动员筛查的关键。部署前，必须验证这些临床开发的模型是否适用于该人群。我们评估了在一般临床人群上训练的心电图基础模型能否诊断运动员特有的心电图发现。我们在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021（87,662 个样本）上微调了三个模型（ECG-FM、HuBERT-ECG、ECGFounder），并在来自高度训练/国家级运动员的 43 份经专家标注的心电图上测试它们。在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021 上表现强劲（AUROC 0.97、AUPRC 0.57、敏感性 0.89），但在运动员数据上下降，证实了域偏移。ECGFounder 表现最佳（AUROC 0.84、AUPRC 0.72、敏感性 0.57），并良好检测出最常见发现：窦性心动过缓（Sinus Bradycardia）（AUROC 0.87）和窦性心律不齐（Sinus Arrhythmia）（AUROC 0.95）。鉴于队列较小，对罕见类别的逐标签估计必须谨慎解读。这项工作有助于开发以运动员为中心的人工智能框架，用于可靠的心电图筛查。

title: Multimodal digital biomarker for asthma: complementary roles of vocal, clinical and demographic factors
zh_title: 哮喘多模态数字标志物：语音、临床与人口学因素的互补作用
summary: 基于1218人队列的专家混合框架，融合持续元音与朗读语音嵌入及临床人口学数据识别哮喘，AUROC 0.83。

abstract: Asthma affects over 260 million people worldwide, yet diagnosis remains dependent on spirometry and specialist assessment, limiting accessibility in primary care and low-resource settings. Vocal biomarkers offer a promising non-invasive alternative, but prior studies have largely focused on acoustic features without integrating clinical context. We present a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts framework for asthma identification that adaptively combines acoustic embeddings from sustained vowel phonation and reading passage tasks with structured clinical and demographic data. The model was evaluated on a matched cohort of 1218 self-reported asthma cases and healthy controls from the Colive Voice study. The multimodal model achieved an AUROC of 0.83 and Brier score of 0.18, outperforming unimodal approaches. Exploratory analysis of the gating mechanism in asthma cases showed that greater respiratory symptom burden was associated with increased weighting of reading-passage modality and reduced weighting of sustained-vowel phonation modality. These findings support the feasibility of voice-based identification of self-reported asthma; however, independent prospective validation remains necessary before clinical use.
zh_abstract: 哮喘影响全球超过 2.6 亿人，但诊断仍依赖肺量计检查和专科评估，限制了其在初级保健和低资源环境中的可及性。声音生物标志物提供了一种有前景的非侵入性替代方案，但既往研究主要集中于声学特征，未整合临床背景。我们提出一个用于哮喘识别的多模态专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts）框架，该框架自适应地结合持续元音发声和朗读段落任务的声学嵌入与结构化临床和人口学数据。模型在来自 Colive Voice 研究的 1218 例自报哮喘病例和健康对照的匹配队列上进行了评估。多模态模型达到 AUROC 0.83 和 Brier 评分 0.18，优于单模态方法。对哮喘病例中门控机制的探索性分析显示，更大的呼吸症状负担与朗读段落模态权重增加及持续元音发声模态权重降低相关。这些发现支持基于声音识别自报哮喘的可行性；然而，在临床使用前仍需要独立的前瞻性验证。

title: NeuroSim: a clinically informed multi-disorder EEG simulator with personalized pattern injection and AI-driven neurological modeling

summary: 预印本发布NeuroSim框架，可生成含五种神经疾病、多严重度可控病理模式的合成多通道脑电，用于缓解标注数据稀缺。

abstract: Deep learning for electroencephalography (EEG) based neurodiagnostics is constrained by the limited availability of labeled clinical recordings. Datasets covering Alzheimers disease (AD), Parkinsons disease (PD), schizophrenia (SCZ), epilepsy (EPI), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) are scarce, demographically narrow, and heterogeneous across acquisition sites, while privacy requirements restrict data sharing. Existing EEG simulators typically address a single disorder or trade biological interpretability for statistical fidelity. This study presents NeuroSim, a simulation framework that generates synthetic multichannel EEG with user-controlled injection of disease-specific patterns across five disorders and multiple severity levels. A physiologically motivated baseline generator produces band-limited rhythms, event-related potentials, artifacts, and hierarchical subject-level and trial-level variability. Disease patterns are introduced through region-specific and severity-specific spectral modulation that encodes established biomarkers, including posterior alpha suppression in AD, motor beta enhancement in PD, and spike-wave discharges in EPI. An interactive interface exposes montage, sampling rate, duration, artifacts, stimuli, affected regions, and severity, and exports signals with reproducible metadata. The simulated signals reproduced the expected biomarker directionality under spectral, topographic, and multivariate statistical analysis. A convolutional-attention classifier trained on simulated data reached 95.3 to 96.8 percent hold-out accuracy, and post hoc explainability analyses produced class-separable embeddings with attributions concentrated on pathophysiologically expected electrodes. Application of the analysis pipeline to recordings from the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus confirmed compatibility with heterogeneous clinical data. In subject-level augmentation experiments on real clinical EEG, supplementing real training data with NeuroSim samples increased classification accuracy from 91.6 to 94.5 percent for AD versus healthy controls and from 90.9 to 94.0 percent for PD versus healthy controls, exceeding the improvement obtained with conventional signal-level augmentation. NeuroSim is released as open-source software to support augmentation, benchmarking, and explainable artificial intelligence in neurological diagnostics.
zh_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）的神经诊断深度学习受限于标注临床记录的可用性有限。覆盖阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、精神分裂症（SCZ）、癫痫（EPI）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的数据集稀缺、人口学范围狭窄、跨采集站点异质，而隐私要求限制数据共享。现有 EEG 模拟器通常只处理单一疾病，或以生物学可解释性换取统计保真度。本研究提出 NeuroSim，一个模拟框架，可生成合成多通道 EEG，并可由用户控制地在五种疾病和多个严重程度水平上注入疾病特异性模式。一个生理学驱动的基线生成器产生带限节律、事件相关电位、伪迹以及分层的受试者水平和试次水平变异性。疾病模式通过区域特异性和严重程度特异性的频谱调制引入，该调制编码已确立的生物标志物，包括 AD 中的后部 α 波抑制、PD 中的运动区 β 波增强以及 EPI 中的棘慢波放电。交互界面可设置导联布局（montage）、采样率、时长、伪迹、刺激、受影响区域和严重程度，并导出带有可复现元数据的信号。在频谱、地形和多变量统计分析下，模拟信号重现了预期的生物标志物方向性。一个在模拟数据上训练的卷积注意力分类器达到 95.3% 至 96.8% 的留出集准确率，事后可解释性分析产生了类别可分离的嵌入，其归因集中在病理生理学上预期的电极。将分析流程应用于 Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus 的记录，证实了其与异质临床数据的兼容性。在真实临床 EEG 的受试者级数据增强实验中，用 NeuroSim 样本补充真实训练数据，使 AD 与健康对照的分类准确率从 91.6% 提高到 94.5%，使 PD 与健康对照的分类准确率从 90.9% 提高到 94.0%，超过了使用传统信号级数据增强所获得的提升。NeuroSim 作为开源软件发布，以支持神经科诊断中的数据增强、基准测试和可解释人工智能。

title: A Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble Framework for Privacy-Preserving Mortality Prediction Across Heterogeneous Healthcare Systems
zh_title: 区块链联邦集成框架用于跨机构隐私保护死亡预测
summary: 预印本模拟研究：智能合约经同行医院验证后方可纳入本地模型，以抵御投毒或替换模型。
key_points: 四家模拟医院基于XGBoost与随机森林的联邦集成
合约要求同行验证AUROC中位数≥0.70方可准入
采用加权logit平均或堆叠并做联邦重校准
reason: 方法有新意，但为单中心数据模拟的回顾性研究，无真实外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective: To test whether a smart contract that admits hospital-trained models to a shared mortality model only after peer hospitals verify their performance can exclude poisoned or substituted models, and at what cost. Design: Retrospective simulation study of a federated learning protocol. Methodology: In the Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble (BFE), hospitals committed SHA-256 digests of locally trained XGBoost and random-forest models to a Solidity contract; peers posted digest-bound validation AUROCs, and the contract admitted models with a median peer AUROC of at least 0.70. Admitted models were pooled by weighted logit averaging (BFE-PW) or stacking (BFE-Stack) with federated recalibration. Code and drafts were produced with an AI coding assistant under the authors' supervision. Setting: Four hospitals simulated from one academic centre with age, renal case-mix and laboratory-availability skew; a data-scarce regime keeping 5-20% of each hospital's patients; and a natural partition by care era. Participants: 425,215 adult admissions (186,103 patients; 2.35% in-hospital mortality) in MIMIC-IV v3.1, with predictors from the first 24 hours. Interventions: BFE against centralised, local-only, FedAvg, FedProx, median and Multi-Krum FedAvg and federated logistic regression, under seven attacks on training, attestation, recalibration and model delivery. Main outcome measures: AUROC and AUPRC (joint patient-clustered bootstrap), calibration, attack effects, gas and transactions. Results: Under gross label flipping, FedAvg lost 29% of its AUPRC while the contract excluded the poisoned models in every seed (Multi-Krum FedAvg was equally protected); all substituted models were detected, and collusion blocked release. A targeted flip of female deaths passed the gate and lowered sensitivity for deaths in women from 32.8% to 27.5%; poisoned recalibration inverted BFE-PW (AUROC 0.098) unless a median-of-sites recalibration was used (0.902). With large hospitals, BFE-PW matched FedAvg in AUROC (0.902) and BFE-Stack matched FedProx (0.907 and 0.906), below local-only (0.910) and centralised XGBoost (0.915), with lower AUPRC; with 5% of the data, BFE-PW exceeded local models (0.866 against 0.844). Pooled calibration hid two-fold under-prediction at one hospital (observed-to-expected ratio 2.13), which a local intercept corrected (0.93). One aggregation used 37 transactions and 3.3 million gas, rising roughly quadratically with consortium size. Conclusions: Contrac
zh_abstract: 目的：检验一种智能合约能否在同行医院验证医院训练模型的表现后才允许其进入共享死亡率模型，从而排除被投毒或被替换的模型，以及其代价为何。设计：对一种联邦学习方案的回顾性模拟研究。方法：在区块链赋能的联邦集成（Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble, BFE）中，医院将本地训练的 XGBoost 和随机森林模型的 SHA-256 摘要提交至 Solidity 合约；同行发布与摘要绑定的验证 AUROC，合约允许同行 AUROC 中位数至少为 0.70 的模型进入。获准模型通过加权 logit 平均（BFE-PW）或堆叠（BFE-Stack）并结合联邦重校准进行汇总。代码和草稿在作者监督下由 AI 编码助手生成。场景：四家医院从同一学术中心模拟，存在年龄、肾脏病例组合和实验室可用性偏倚；一个数据稀缺机制保留每家医院 5-20% 的患者；以及按诊疗时代进行自然划分。参与者：MIMIC-IV v3.1 中 425,215 例成人入院（186,103 名患者；院内死亡率 2.35%），预测变量来自前 24 小时。干预：将 BFE 与集中式、仅本地、FedAvg、FedProx、中位数 FedAvg 和 Multi-Krum FedAvg 以及联邦逻辑回归进行比较，涵盖针对训练、证明、重校准和模型交付的七种攻击。主要结局指标：AUROC 和 AUPRC（联合患者聚类 bootstrap）、校准、攻击效应、gas 和交易数。结果：在严重标签翻转下，FedAvg 损失了其 AUPRC 的 29%，而合约在每个随机种子中均排除了被投毒模型（Multi-Krum FedAvg 受到同等保护）；所有被替换模型均被检测到，合谋阻止了发布。针对女性死亡的定向翻转通过了门控，并将女性死亡的敏感性从 32.8% 降至 27.5%；被投毒的重校准使 BFE-PW 反转（AUROC 0.098），除非使用站点中位数重校准（0.902）。在医院数据量较大时，BFE-PW 的 AUROC 与 FedAvg 相当（0.902），BFE-Stack 与 FedProx 相当（0.907 和 0.906），但低于仅本地模型（0.910）和集中式 XGBoost（0.915），且 AUPRC 更低；在仅使用 5% 数据时，BFE-PW 超过本地模型（0.866 对 0.844）。汇总校准掩盖了一家医院两倍的预测不足（观察值与期望值之比 2.13），局部截距校正后为 0.93。一次聚合使用了 37 笔交易和 330 万 gas，并随联盟规模大致呈二次增长。结论：Contrac

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Deep Learning for Prediction of Radiation-Induced Xerostomia in Head and Neck Cancer
zh_title: 不确定性感知多模态深度学习预测头颈癌放疗后口干

abstract: To develop and evaluate an uncertainty-aware multimodal learning framework for predicting radiation-induced xerostomia in patients receiving head-and-neck cancer radiotherapy. We developed a Bidirectional Attention-enhanced Diffusion Transformer (BA-DiT) that combines self-supervised multimodal representation learning with supervised Bayesian fine-tuning. The model integrates pretreatment CT images and three-dimensional dose distributions, focusing on bilateral parotid glands while incorporating surrounding anatomical and dosimetric information. During pretraining, bidirectional cross-attention integrates anatomical and dosimetric features, while a latent Diffusion Transformer learns joint representations through diffusion-based learning, feature reconstruction, and contrastive alignment. Supervised fine-tuning employs a Bayesian classifier to predict individualized xerostomia risk and quantify predictive uncertainty, with a learnable label-transition model accounting for potential toxicity label uncertainty. BA-DiT was developed using four independent cohorts (Moffitt, Emory, MSHS, and TCIA) and evaluated against baseline and ablation models. Evaluation included predictive performance, calibration, uncertainty quantification, decision curve analysis, and patient-level case studies. In independent MSHS and Emory cohorts, BA-DiT achieved AUCs of 0.83 and 0.80, respectively, outperforming baseline models. Predictive uncertainty peaked near the decision boundary, with aleatoric uncertainty being the predominant component. Uncertainty-based selective prediction generally improved net benefit among retained patients, with greater gains at lower prediction coverage. BA-DiT enables individualized xerostomia risk prediction while providing complementary uncertainty estimates, potentially supporting informed clinical decision-making and personalized toxicity management.
zh_abstract: 开发并评估一个不确定性感知的多模态学习框架，用于预测接受头颈癌放疗患者的放射性口干症。我们开发了一种双向注意力增强的扩散Transformer（BA-DiT），它将自监督多模态表示学习与有监督贝叶斯微调相结合。该模型整合治疗前CT图像和三维剂量分布，聚焦双侧腮腺，同时纳入周围解剖和剂量学信息。在预训练期间，双向交叉注意力整合解剖和剂量学特征，而潜在扩散Transformer通过基于扩散的学习、特征重建和对比对齐学习联合表示。有监督微调采用贝叶斯分类器预测个体化口干症风险并量化预测不确定性，并使用可学习的标签转移模型来考虑潜在的毒性标签不确定性。BA-DiT使用四个独立队列（Moffitt、Emory、MSHS和TCIA）进行开发，并针对基线和消融模型进行评估。评估包括预测性能、校准、不确定性量化、决策曲线分析和患者层面病例研究。在独立的MSHS和Emory队列中，BA-DiT分别达到AUC 0.83和0.80，优于基线模型。预测不确定性在决策边界附近达到峰值，其中偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）是主要成分。基于不确定性的选择性预测通常提高了保留患者的净获益，且在较低预测覆盖率下获益更大。BA-DiT能够实现个体化口干症风险预测，同时提供补充性不确定性估计，可能支持知情的临床决策和个体化毒性管理。

abstract: Background: Patients' difficulties with illness and care (not understanding a result, distress, daily restrictions, not knowing where to go, family strain) may not surface in clinical encounters or records. Regulatory guidance on patient-focused drug development recognizes social-media listening as a source of patient experience data, but no systematic framework exists for Traditional Chinese discussions in Taiwan, and keyword pipelines measure such content poorly. Objective: To characterize patient-expressed needs, burdens and barriers ("frictions") in Taiwanese online health discussions with an eight-domain, Taiwan-contextualized framework, identify whose frictions they are, and assess how securely each is measured. Methods: From a 13.6-million-unit archive of the PTT forum and three ask-a-physician services, seeded samples of 9,131 pipeline-flagged units and 1,000 unflagged forum articles (10,130 distinct units) were read in full by a large language model under rubrics for relevance, author (patient or family member) and eight domains: information gap, emotional burden, lifestyle burden, medication experience, system navigation, access barrier, caregiver burden and cost burden. Profiles were reported separately for forum articles and physician submissions and checked against a second vendor, two physicians' independent labels of 160 accepted and rejected units, and the archive's keyword pipeline. Results: Among 2,395 model-confirmed forum articles, 83.1% voiced at least one friction: information gap 59.5% (physicians 86%-93%), emotional burden 39.0%, medication experience 24.1%, lifestyle burden 22.2% and system navigation 16.3%; access barrier, caregiver burden and cost burden were each below 7%. Of 3,105 submissions, nearly all were questions and 53.8% also carried a burden. Navigation rarely concerned insurance (9.1%). Emotional and lifestyle burden were commoner in forum articles than submissions under the model, a second vendor and both physicians; medication experience and navigation were instrument-dependent, and physicians disagreed on cost (32% vs 4%). zh_abstract: 【背景】患者因疾病和照护而面临的困难（不理解某项结果、痛苦、日常活动受限、不知道该去哪里、家庭压力）可能不会在临床接触或记录中显现。关于以患者为中心的药物开发的监管指南将社交媒体倾听视为患者体验数据的来源，但台湾繁体中文讨论尚无系统框架，且关键词流程对此类内容的测量效果很差。【目的】使用八领域、台湾情境化框架，刻画台湾在线健康讨论中患者表达的需求、负担和障碍（“摩擦”），识别这些摩擦属于谁，并评估每一项被测量的可靠程度。【方法】从 PTT 论坛和三个问医生服务的 1360 万单元档案中，抽取 9,131 个流程标记单元和 1,000 篇未标记论坛文章（10,130 个不同单元）的种子样本，由大语言模型依据相关性、作者（患者或家庭成员）和八个领域的评分规则进行全文阅读；八个领域为：信息缺口、情感负担、生活方式负担、用药体验、系统导航、可及性障碍、照护者负担和费用负担。分别报告论坛文章和医生提交内容的特征剖面，并与第二家供应商、两位医生对 160 个被接受和拒绝单元的独立标注以及档案的关键词流程进行核对。【结果】在 2,395 篇模型确认的论坛文章中，83.1% 表达了至少一种摩擦：信息缺口 59.5%（医生 86%-93%）、情感负担 39.0%、用药体验 24.1%、生活方式负担 22.2% 和系统导航 16.3%；可及性障碍、照护者负担和费用负担均低于 7%。在 3,105 份提交内容中，几乎全部都是问题，且 53.8% 也承载负担。导航很少涉及保险（9.1%）。家庭成员撰写的论坛文章（14.5%）更常表达情感负担（54.9% vs 36.3%）、系统导航（34.8% vs 13.2%；取决于测量工具）和可及性障碍（16.4% vs 4.7%），而患者撰写的文章更常表达生活方式负担（24.8% vs 6.9%）；在表达照护者负担的文章中，86.0% 同时伴随情感负担。在模型、第二家供应商和两位医生标注下，情感负担和生活方式负担在论坛文章中比提交内容中更常见；用药体验和系统导航取决于测量工具，且医生对费用负担存在分歧（32% vs 4%）。关键词流程已针对 29.9% 的 model-c 存储其信息缺口输出

title: Artificial intelligence and triple negative breast cancer: can pathomics help oncologists?

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive and heterogeneous subtype of breast cancer with limited targeted therapies and poor prognosis. Recent advances in digital pathology and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming traditional, qualitative histopathology into quantitative, data-driven analysis. Within computational pathology, pathomics (the extraction of handcrafted, high-dimensional features from digitized histological images) and deep learning (DL)-based whole-slide image analysis have been investigated for the prediction of molecular subtypes, biomarker expression, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and treatment response in TNBC. AI models, including DL and multimodal systems integrating histopathology, omics, and clinical data, are being explored for patient stratification, risk assessment, and therapy personalization, encompassing chemotherapy, immunotherapy, PARP inhibitors, and antibody-drug conjugates. By linking spatial tissue architecture with molecular profiles, these approaches may provide new insights into tumor biology and the tumor microenvironment. Most TNBC-specific studies are retrospective, small or single-center, few have been externally validated and, to our knowledge, none has yet demonstrated clinical utility in prospective trials; prediction of biomarkers such as PD-L1 or homologous recombination deficiency from hematoxylin and eosin slides remains investigational and cannot replace validated testing. Despite these challenges, AI-assisted computational pathology is a promising decision-support tool, which complements and does not replace pathologists and oncologists, for enhancing diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decision-making in TNBC.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是乳腺癌的一种侵袭性强且高度异质的亚型，靶向治疗有限且预后差。数字病理学和人工智能（AI）的最新进展正在将传统的定性组织病理学转变为定量的、数据驱动的分析。在计算病理学中，病理组学（pathomics，从数字化组织学图像中提取手工设计的高维特征）和基于深度学习（DL）的全切片图像分析已被研究用于预测TNBC的分子亚型、生物标志物表达、肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞和治疗反应。包括DL以及整合组织病理学、组学和临床数据的多模态系统在内的AI模型，正在被探索用于患者分层、风险评估和治疗个体化，涵盖化疗、免疫治疗、PARP抑制剂和抗体-药物偶联物。通过将空间组织结构与分子谱联系起来，这些方法可能为肿瘤生物学和肿瘤微环境提供新见解。大多数TNBC特异性研究为回顾性、小样本或单中心研究，少数经过外部验证，并且据我们所知，尚无研究在前瞻性试验中证明临床效用；从苏木精-伊红（H&E）切片预测PD-L1或同源重组缺陷等生物标志物仍处于研究阶段，不能替代经过验证的检测。尽管存在这些挑战，AI辅助的计算病理学是一种有前景的决策支持工具，可补充而非替代病理学家和肿瘤学家，用于增强TNBC的诊断、预后和治疗决策。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Lokman Hekim University; conditions: Nursing Education; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 60; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] More than 300 million surgical procedures are performed worldwide each year. However, surgical errors remain among the most common medical errors causing preventable patient harm. Although various health policies have been implemented globally and nationally, adverse events continue to occur due to factors such as high patient volumes and insufficient staffing. One of the most important initiatives developed to prevent surgery-related adverse events is the World Health Organization's "Safe Surgery Saves Lives" project. Within this initiative, the Surgical Safety Checklist was developed and has contributed to significant reductions in adverse events. The World Health Organization has encouraged countries to adapt the checklist to their healthcare systems. In Türkiye, it was revised by adding an additional section based on the principle that "Safe surgery starts in the clinic." Current patient safety policies and initiatives largely focus on healthcare professionals. However, developing a culture of surgical safety should begin during undergraduate education. After graduation, students may adopt existing institutional practices regarding patient and surgical safety. Therefore, developing nursing students' knowledge, skills, and professional judgment regarding safe surgery before graduation is essential. This randomized controlled experimental study aims to compare the effectiveness of an artificial intelligence-assisted virtual simulation game and traditional simulation in improving nursing students' knowledge and skills regarding the Surgical Safety Checklist. The effects of these interventions on students' problem-solving skills and patient safety competencies will also be examined. Students, research fellows, and the statistician will be blinded. Data will be collected using the Surgical Safety Checklist Knowledge Test, Surgical Safety Checklist Skills Assessment Checklist, Problem Solving Inventory, and a scale assessing nursing students' patient safety competencies. Data will be analyzed using SPSS, with p\<0.05 considered statistically significant.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Lokman Hekim University；疾病/条件：护理教育；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；阶段：NA；入组人数：60；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 每年全球实施超过 3 亿例外科手术。然而，手术差错仍是导致可预防患者伤害的最常见医疗差错之一。尽管全球和国家层面已实施多种卫生政策，但由于患者数量大和人员配备不足等因素，不良事件仍持续发生。为预防手术相关不良事件而制定的最重要举措之一是世界卫生组织（World Health Organization）的“安全手术拯救生命”（Safe Surgery Saves Lives）项目。在该倡议中，开发了手术安全核查表（Surgical Safety Checklist），并已促进不良事件的显著减少。世界卫生组织鼓励各国根据其医疗体系调整核查表。在土耳其（Türkiye），基于“安全手术始于诊所”的原则，通过增加一个额外部分对其进行了修订。当前的患者安全政策和倡议主要聚焦于医疗专业人员。然而，培养手术安全文化应始于本科教育。毕业后，学生可能会采纳机构现有的患者和手术安全实践。因此，在毕业前培养护理学生对安全手术的知识、技能和专业判断至关重要。这项随机对照实验研究旨在比较人工智能辅助虚拟模拟游戏与传统模拟在提高护理学生关于手术安全核查表的知识和技能方面的有效性。还将考察这些干预措施对学生问题解决能力和患者安全胜任力的影响。学生、研究员和统计师将被设盲。数据将使用手术安全核查表知识测试、手术安全核查表技能评估核查表、问题解决量表（Problem Solving Inventory）以及评估护理学生患者安全胜任力的量表收集。数据将使用 SPSS 分析，p<0.05 被认为具有统计学显著性。

title: Tele-Cranio: a CT-free AI solution for remote diagnosis and planning of craniomaxillofacial deformities

summary: npj Digital Medicine 报道基于手机 2D 面部照片重建 3D 面部与骨性形态的 AI 框架，用于颅颌面畸形远程评估与手术模拟。

abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is central to craniomaxillofacial (CMF) deformity care, yet dependence on in-hospital imaging constrains remote preoperative assessment and outcome visualization, and repeated imaging can increase radiation and access burdens, particularly for children. We developed Tele-Cranio, a telemedicine-oriented artificial intelligence framework that uses mobile-acquired 2D facial photographs to reconstruct 3D facial morphology, estimate corresponding skeletal morphology and support postoperative facial simulation conditioned on surgeon-defined skeletal plans. Tele-Cranio was developed using 539 paired multimodal samples comprising 2D facial photographs, 3D facial scans and CT-derived skeletal models from individuals aged 3–60 years, including 334 patients with CMF deformities across malocclusion, cleft lip with/without palate, hemifacial microsomia and rare anomalies. Its core model, the Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity, learns a shared anatomical representation linking facial soft tissue and skeletal structures across normal and pathological morphology. For remote assessment, Tele-Cranio converts facial photographs into 3D facial surfaces and then infers 3D patient-specific skeletal geometry. For simulation, it generates individualized 3D postoperative facial previews after clinicians complete skeletal planning using standard clinical tools. Validated across heterogeneous CMF subgroups, Tele-Cranio provides an interpretable CT-free layer for remote triage, pre-CT consultation, radiation-free follow-up and surgeon–patient communication, while complementing rather than replacing CT-based definitive diagnosis and operative planning.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）是颅颌面（CMF）畸形诊疗的核心，但依赖院内成像限制了远程术前评估和结果可视化，而且重复成像可能增加辐射和可及性负担，尤其是对儿童而言。我们开发了 Tele-Cranio，这是一种面向远程医疗的人工智能框架，利用移动设备采集的 2D 面部照片重建 3D 面部形态、估计相应的骨骼形态，并支持以外科医生定义的骨骼方案为条件的术后面部模拟。Tele-Cranio 使用 539 对配对多模态样本开发，这些样本包括来自 3–60 岁个体的 2D 面部照片、3D 面部扫描和 CT 衍生的骨骼模型，其中包含 334 例 CMF 畸形患者，涵盖错颌畸形、伴或不伴腭裂的唇裂、半侧颜面短小症和罕见异常。其核心模型 Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity 学习一种共享的解剖表征，将正常和病理形态下的面部软组织与骨骼结构联系起来。对于远程评估，Tele-Cranio 将面部照片转换为 3D 面部表面，然后推断患者特异性的 3D 骨骼几何结构。对于模拟，它在临床医生使用标准临床工具完成骨骼规划后，生成个体化的 3D 术后面部预览。在异质性 CMF 亚组中验证后，Tele-Cranio 为远程分诊、CT 前会诊、无辐射随访和外科医生–患者沟通提供了一个可解释的无 CT 层，同时补充而非替代基于 CT 的确定性诊断和手术规划。

title: Bridging Brain Connectome and Clinical Notes: A Novel Multimodal Framework for MCI Study.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 脑连接组与临床文本对齐的多模态轻度认知障碍框架
summary: IEEE TMI 论文提出将脑连接组与临床报告在共享跨模态隐空间对齐的多模态框架，用于轻度认知障碍研究。
key_points: 以脑子网络为 token 而非原始图像块
在个体与连接组层面跨模态对齐
强调影像与文本关联的可解释性
reason: 方法有新意且已同行评审，但未提及外部验证或临床结局
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Integrating brain imaging data with clinical reports enables the effective use of complementary multimodal information, supporting more accurate and timely diagnosis in real-world clinical settings. This approach has gained growing attention in brain disorder research, yet significant limitations remain: how to encode brain structure and function to reflect meaningful neurological patterns, and how to effectively link objective imaging data with subjective text-based reports while establishing interpretable associations. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal framework that aligns brain connectomes with clinical reports in a shared cross-modal latent space at both subject and connectome levels. Our key innovation lies in treating brain subnetworks as tokens rather than raw image patches, enabling more efficient identification of system-level associations between neuroimaging findings and clinical observations. These cross-modal associations are further fused to enhance mild cognitive impairment (MCI) prediction and provide interpretable diagnostic insights. To our knowledge, this is the first attempt to integrate both structural and functional brain connectivity with non-imaging clinical information. Experimental validation on the ADNI dataset demonstrates performance competitive with recently reported methods. Notably, despite no explicit connectome-token-level supervision, the learned connectome-text associations recover multiple relationships independently reported in the neuroimaging and clinical literature, suggesting that the framework captures clinically coherent cross-modal associations. This pioneering work advances multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) for neurodegenerative disease diagnosis by bridging the gap between neuroimaging analysis and clinical text interpretation through innovative connectome tokenization and cross-modal alignment strategies.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 将脑影像数据与临床报告相结合，能够有效利用互补的多模态信息，从而支持在真实临床环境中实现更准确、更及时的诊断。这种方法在脑部疾病研究中日益受到关注，但仍存在显著局限：如何编码脑结构与功能以反映有意义的神经学模式，以及如何有效将客观影像数据与主观文本报告联系起来，同时建立可解释的关联。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新的多模态框架，在受试者水平和连接组水平上，将脑连接组与临床报告在共享的跨模态潜空间中对齐。我们的关键创新在于将脑子网络视为 token（标记），而不是原始图像块，从而能够更高效地识别神经影像发现与临床观察之间的系统级关联。这些跨模态关联进一步被融合，以增强轻度认知障碍（MCI）预测并提供可解释的诊断见解。据我们所知，这是首次尝试将结构性和功能性脑连接与非影像临床信息整合起来。在 ADNI 数据集上的实验验证表明，其性能与近期报道的方法具有竞争力。值得注意的是，尽管没有明确的连接组 token 级监督，所学习到的连接组-文本关联恢复了神经影像和临床文献中独立报道的多重关系，这表明该框架捕捉到了临床一致的跨模态关联。这项开创性工作通过创新的连接组 token 化（tokenization）和跨模态对齐策略，弥合了神经影像分析与临床文本解读之间的差距，从而推进了用于神经退行性疾病诊断的多模态人工智能（AI）。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Antonio Luiz Pinho Ribeiro; conditions: Heart Failure, Left Ventricular (LV) Systolic Dysfunction; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 5400; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The goal of this parallel-group cluster randomized clinical trial is to evaluate whether opportunistic screening for left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD), using an artificial intelligence algorithm applied to electrocardiograms (AI-ECG), increases the detection of previously unrecognized LVSD among adults aged ≥40 years receiving routine care in primary healthcare centers within the Brazilian Public Health System. LVSD is a key finding in the diagnosis of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), a condition for which effective guideline-directed medical therapies are available but which remains underdiagnosed and undertreated. The study will also evaluate the effects of AI-ECG screening on clinical management, healthcare utilization, implementation outcomes, and healthcare costs. The main questions this study aims to answer are: 1. Does adding AI-ECG screening to usual clinical assessment increase the proportion of patients with newly identified LVSD (left ventricular ejection fraction \<50%) within six months compared with clinical assessment alone? 2. Does AI-ECG screening improve the use of echocardiography, the recognition by primary care teams, and the initiation or optimization of guideline-directed medical therapy for HFrEF? 3. How do LVSD detection rates differ between patients identified through AI-ECG screening alone and those identified through clinical suspicion alone? 4. Is this screening strategy feasible, acceptable, and cost-effective when implemented in primary healthcare? Primary healthcare centers will be randomized to either an intervention group, in which AI-ECG screening results will be provided alongside the standard ECG report, or a control group receiving usual care without AI-ECG results. Participants will: 1. Undergo a routine 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG), as clinically indicated by their primary care physician. 2. Be referred for echocardiography based on clinical suspicion of LVSD in both groups or, additionally, a positive AI-ECG screening result in the intervention group. 3. Receive educational materials about HFrEF if newly diagnosed, while participating healthcare professionals will receive educational interventions on heart failure diagnosis and management. 4. Complete questionnaires evaluating educational interventions, when applicable. 5. Be followed for six months to assess newly identified LVSD, treatment initiation and optimization, healthcare utilization (including emergency visits and hospita
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Antonio Luiz Pinho Ribeiro；疾病/状况：心力衰竭、左心室（LV）收缩功能障碍；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：5400；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 这项平行组整群随机临床试验的目标是评估，在巴西公共卫生系统内的初级卫生保健中心接受常规诊疗的年龄≥40岁成人中，使用应用于心电图的人工智能算法（AI-ECG）对左心室收缩功能障碍（LVSD）进行机会性筛查，是否能提高既往未被识别的LVSD检出率。LVSD是射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）诊断中的一项关键发现；HFrEF已有有效的指南指导药物治疗，但仍存在诊断不足和治疗不足。该研究还将评估AI-ECG筛查对临床管理、医疗资源利用、实施结局和医疗成本的影响。本研究旨在回答的主要问题是：1. 与单独临床评估相比，将AI-ECG筛查加入常规临床评估，是否能在六个月内提高新识别LVSD（左心室射血分数<50%）患者的比例？ 2. title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
zh_title: System 1 智能体：本地可靠快速的工具调用方法
summary: 预印本提出不经文本生成的本地智能体方法，用确定性编译器把工具调用转为选择题，在1952条生物医学工具请求上达97.0%正确率。

reason: 预印本，基准对比充分且关注隐私与幻觉，但未经同行评审、无临床部署验证
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
zh_abstract: 代理式人工智能（Agentic artificial intelligence）可自动化分析敏感临床数据，但当前代理依赖大语言模型（LLMs）。云端LLM会暴露患者数据。本地LLM会产生幻觉，并且工具调用中虚构的值会传播到后续每一步。在此，我们提出一种构建System 1代理的方法：这些本地代理在不生成文本的情况下调用工具。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的模式（schema）和请求转换为多项选择题，其选项来自请求和模式，然后由单次决策模型回答这些问题。在针对157个生物医学工具的1,952次请求中，最佳System 1代理在97.0%的请求中选择了正确工具或正确拒绝，显著领先于所有18种本地LLM代理设置（最佳为95.2%）。System 1代理填写了6,056个明确给出的参数值中的97.0%。没有任何System 1调用包含虚构内容，相比之下5.5-19.7%的LLM调用包含虚构内容。System 1 Agents框架作为开源软件可在 https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents 免费获取。

title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
zh_title: Decision2Care：不生成文本、可审计的临床决策智能体
summary: 预印本提出以决策模型选择电子病历动作的智能体，在546例急诊入院12种疾病上诊断准确率86.5%，并记录每步候选。
key_points: 不输出自由文本，按概率选择EHR动作
546例急诊入院、12种疾病评测
准确率86.5%，对比MIRA-v2的86.1%

reason: 有基线对照、多病种评测与可审计设计，但为预印本且无外部验证
abstract: Clinicians reviewing a diagnostic work-up will ask what was considered at each step and why the assessment changed. Agents powered by free text can reach physician-level diagnostic accuracy, but their written reasoning does not always reflect the factors that went into the decision. Here, we present Decision2Care, a decision agent that works up the acutely ill patient without producing any text. A decision model assigns a probability to each permitted EHR action, and fixed rules carry out the most probable one. We evaluated Decision2Care on the records of 546 emergency admissions across 12 diseases. Decision2Care reached a diagnostic accuracy of 86.5%, compared with 86.1% for the MIRA-v2 agent, and required a median of 2.2 s per work-up, compared with 92-100 s. Each work-up tracked which options Decision2Care was considering at each step. In 10 of the 12 diseases, the differential diagnosis changed most at the test on which the guideline bases the diagnosis. Where Decision2Care was most confident after a single work-up, all but four of its diagnoses were correct (98.5%). We traced each of these four errors back to a single imaging report. Three of them were corrected when that report was removed. The same kind of decision was used to select the treatments, and Decision2Care's drug orders were judged guideline-adherent more often than MIRA-v2's. In emergency patients, its prediction of death was comparable to that of three intensivists on the same cases. In five of the eight intensive care cohorts, it exceeded the best of the three 24-h severity scores within 2-6 h of records. Our results show that decision agents can carry out clinical work-ups while recording the options, probabilities, and execution rules behind each action for audit.
zh_abstract: 临床医生在审阅诊断检查流程时会询问每一步考虑了哪些可能，以及评估为何发生变化。由自由文本驱动的智能体可以达到医生水平的诊断准确率，但其书面推理并不总能反映决策中考虑的因素。在此，我们提出 Decision2Care，一种决策智能体，可在不生成任何文本的情况下对急性病患者进行诊断检查。一个决策模型为每个允许的电子健康记录（EHR）操作分配概率，固定规则执行概率最高的操作。我们在涵盖 12 种疾病的 546 例急诊入院记录上评估了 Decision2Care。Decision2Care 达到 86.5% 的诊断准确率，而 MIRA-v2 智能体为 86.1%；每次诊断检查所需时间中位数为 2.2 秒，而后者为 92-100 秒。每次诊断检查都追踪了 Decision2Care 在每一步正在考虑哪些选项。在 12 种疾病中的 10 种中，鉴别诊断变化最大的是指南据以作出诊断的检查。在 Decision2Care 单次诊断检查后最有信心的病例中，其诊断除四例外均正确（98.5%）。我们将这四例错误中的每一例都追溯至一份影像报告。当移除该报告后，其中三例得到纠正。同类决策被用于选择治疗，且 Decision2Care 的用药医嘱被判定为符合指南的频率高于 MIRA-v2。在急诊患者中，其对死亡的预测与三位重症监护医师对相同病例的预测相当。在八个重症监护队列中的五个中，其在记录后 2-6 小时内超过了三种 24 小时严重程度评分中的最佳者。我们的结果表明，决策智能体能够执行临床诊断检查，同时记录每项操作背后的选项、概率和执行规则以供审计。

title: No Mastery without the Machine — Medical Education in the Age of Clinical AI
zh_title: 临床AI时代的医学教育：不靠机器难成高手
summary: NEJM AI观点文章认为，AI延伸了临床推理，医学教育应从记忆转向监督与质疑机器推理、识别失效模式。
key_points: AI被视为医学教育威胁，作者认为该担忧合理但不完整
医学历来依赖最佳工具，而非仅靠人类认知
掌握重心转向调度、监督与对智能系统的适度信任

需判断何时人类介入能改善医疗、何时只是干预
reason: 同行评审观点文章，无数据，按综述观点档最高6分，给4分
abstract: AbstractAI is often framed as a threat to medical education owing to concerns it may diminish the cognitive struggle through which trainees traditionally develop clinical judgment - a legitimate but incomplete concern. Medicine has never been defined by unaided human cognition; it has been defined by the obligation to use the best available tools in the service of patients. As AI systems increasingly extend not only clinicians' perception, but also their reasoning, medical mastery may shift from memorization and independent synthesis toward the orchestration, supervision, and calibrated deference to intelligent systems. The task for medical education is therefore not to preserve cognitive struggle for its own sake, but to refocus it from recalling facts to interrogating machine reasoning, detecting failure modes, and knowing when human intervention improves care versus when it merely interrupts a better system.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）常被框定为对医学教育的威胁，因为人们担心它可能会削弱受训者传统上借以发展临床判断力的认知挣扎——这一担忧合理但并不全面。医学从来不是由无辅助的人类认知来定义的；它是由为患者服务而使用最佳可用工具的义务来定义的。随着 AI 系统日益不仅扩展临床医生的感知，也扩展其推理能力，医学精通可能会从记忆与独立综合转向对智能系统的编排、监督和有校准的遵从。因此，医学教育的任务不是为认知挣扎本身而保留它，而是将其重心从回忆事实转向质询机器推理、检测失败模式，以及知道何时人类干预能改善照护、何时它只是打断了一个更好的系统。

title: The ITE-Transformer: A pre-trained foundation model for predicting individualized treatment effects from electronic health records
zh_title: ITE-Transformer：从电子病历预测个体化治疗效应的预训练基础模型
summary: 预印本提出基于Transformer的框架，结合纵向病历自监督表征学习与双稳健因果机器学习，预测个体化治疗效应。
key_points: 从诊断与用药史学习时间上下文化表征
用双稳健因果方法估计治疗效应
可回答个体反事实治疗问题
仅见预印本，未见外部验证描述
reason: 新方法思路清晰但仅预印本、无外部验证，属5-6档
abstract: Transformer-based foundation models have shown strong potential for modeling longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs), yet existing models focus primarily on risk prediction rather than treatment effect estimation, which limits evidence generation. Here, we introduce the ITE-Transformer, a transformer-based framework that combines self-supervised representation learning from longitudinal patient trajectories with doubly robust causal machine learning for predicting individualized treatment effects (ITEs). As a result, our ITE-Transformer allows to study counterfactual questions of how an individual patient's outcome may differ under alternative treatment strategies. The ITE-Transformer learns temporally contextualized representations of patients' diagnosis and medication histories and subsequently uses these representations to predict treatment assignment, treatment-specific outcome risks, and patient-specific ITEs. The ITE-Transformer is trained using structured EHR data from ~350,000 participants in the All of Us Research Program and evaluated in two clinically different comparative-effectiveness tasks: (i) GLP-1 receptor agonists versus DPP-4 inhibitors among patients with type 2 diabetes, with major adverse cardiovascular events as the outcome, and (ii) immunotherapy versus chemotherapy in a pan-cancer cohort, with all-cause mortality as the outcome. Across both applications, the ITE-Transformer improves the discrimination and calibration of treatment assignment and outcome models compared with existing tabular machine learning approaches and an otherwise identical transformer trained without self-supervised pre-training. The ITE-Transformer further identifies substantial heterogeneity in predicted ITEs and yields interpretable patterns of treatment response associated with patients' diagnoses, medication histories, and comorbidities. Together, our work demonstrates how clinical foundation models can be developed for analyzing heterogeneity in treatment effects and thus support real-world evidence generation.
zh_abstract: 基于Transformer的基础模型已显示出对纵向电子健康记录（EHRs）建模的强大潜力，但现有模型主要关注风险预测而非治疗效应估计，这限制了证据生成。在此，我们介绍ITE-Transformer，这是一个基于Transformer的框架，它将来自纵向患者轨迹的自监督表示学习与双重稳健因果机器学习相结合，用于预测个体化治疗效应（ITEs）。因此，我们的ITE-Transformer能够研究反事实问题，即个体患者在替代治疗策略下的结局可能如何不同。ITE-Transformer学习患者诊断和用药史的时间情境化表示，随后使用这些表示来预测治疗分配、治疗特异性结局风险以及患者特异性ITE。ITE-Transformer使用来自All of Us Research Program中约350,000名参与者的结构化EHR数据进行训练，并在两个临床不同的比较有效性任务中评估：（i）在2型糖尿病患者中比较GLP-1受体激动剂与DPP-4抑制剂，以主要不良心血管事件为结局；（ii）在泛癌队列中比较免疫治疗与化疗，以全因死亡率为结局。在这两个应用中，与现有表格机器学习方法以及一个在其他方面相同但未进行自监督预训练的Transformer相比，ITE-Transformer改善了治疗分配模型和结局模型的区分度与校准度。ITE-Transformer进一步识别出预测ITE中的显著异质性，并产生与患者诊断、用药史和合并症相关的可解释治疗反应模式。总之，我们的工作展示了如何开发临床基础模型来分析治疗效应异质性，从而支持真实世界证据生成。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] With the development of artificial intelligence (AI), AI-assisted clinical diagnosis, driven by big data analytics and machine/deep learning (ML/DL), has brought great changes in clinical decision. AI enhances disease detection, classification, and treatment planning by processing diverse data such as electronic health records (EHRs), medical images, and genomics. Key applications include high-accuracy cancer screening, neurological disorder prediction, and diagnostics in ophthalmology, endocrinology, and pediatrics. Significant challenges involve data quality/standardization, model interpretability, and ethical/legal concerns. Mitigation strategies include federated learning, Explainable AI, and fairness constraints. Future directions focus on multimodal data fusion, real-time monitoring via wearables, and collaborative human-AI diagnostics. AI is positioned as a tool to augment clinicians, promising improved diagnostic precision, efficiency, and accessibility in precision medicine, contingent on overcoming technical and ethical hurdles through interdisciplinary collaboration.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 随着人工智能（AI）的发展，由大数据分析以及机器学习/深度学习（ML/DL）驱动的人工智能辅助临床诊断已在临床决策中带来巨大变化。AI通过处理电子健康记录（EHRs）、医学图像和基因组学等多样化数据，增强疾病检测、分类和治疗规划。关键应用包括高准确度的癌症筛查、神经系统疾病预测，以及眼科、内分泌科和儿科中的诊断。重大挑战涉及数据质量/标准化、模型可解释性以及伦理/法律问题。缓解策略包括联邦学习、可解释AI（Explainable AI）和公平性约束。未来方向聚焦于多模态数据融合、通过可穿戴设备进行实时监测，以及人类-AI协作诊断。AI被定位为增强临床医生的工具，有望改善精准医学中的诊断精度、效率和可及性，但其前提是通过跨学科合作克服技术和伦理障碍。

summary: 回顾性纳入两中心 879 例，中心 A 训练、中心 B 独立测试，评估 CT 影像组学与多模态融合模型对良恶性分类及生存预测的表现。

abstract: Reliable preoperative classification and outcome prediction could improve management of locally advanced colorectal cancer. We retrospectively studied 879 participants from two centers, including 741 patients with locally advanced colorectal cancer and 138 with benign colorectal lesions. Clinical, radiomics, deep learning, and early fusion models were trained at center A (n = 615) and independently tested at center B (n = 264) using pretreatment contrast-enhanced computed tomography and clinical data. The clinical-radiomics nomogram achieved a test AUC of 0.957 for benign-malignant classification. For 3-year and 5-year overall survival, radiomics achieved test AUCs of 0.874 and 0.898, while fusion achieved 0.870 and 0.899, respectively. These findings identify CT radiomics as a promising digital biomarker for colorectal cancer stratification and show that early deep learning fusion offers limited incremental value over an optimized radiomics baseline.

abstract: Spatial omics has generated measurements at unprecedented scale, yet computational approaches remain largely confined to individual modalities and 2D representations. Here we assemble ImageOmicsNet-300M, a corpus of 300 million single-cell and spatial transcriptomic profiles, including 24.9 million H&E-predicted virtual spatial transcriptomics profiles, and 4,623 H&E sections. Of these H&E sections, we generated 1,782 from aging mouse organs and serially sectioned human skin spanning five decades, with matched spatial transcriptomics and snRNA-seq. Building on this resource, we develop GenVinci, a multimodal tissue foundation model that reconstructs 3D tissue scenes from routine 2D histology. GenVinci predicts spatial gene expression from H&E with zero-shot generalization and maps senescence-associated states across 85.8 million cells, revealing cell-type-specific patterns and disease-associated remodeling. Integration with human genetics implicates suprabasal keratinocytes in atopic dermatitis and keratinocyte carcinomas, linked to higher and lower p16 and p21 expression, respectively. These findings establish GenVinci as a framework mapping senescence in 3D across scales.
zh_abstract: 空间组学已产生前所未有的规模测量，然而计算方法在很大程度上仍局限于单一模态和2D表示。在此，我们构建了ImageOmicsNet-300M，一个包含3亿个单细胞和空间转录组谱的语料库，包括2490万个由H&E预测的虚拟空间转录组谱和4623张H&E切片。在这些H&E切片中，我们生成了1782张来自衰老小鼠器官和跨越五十年的连续切片人类皮肤，并配有匹配的空间转录组学和snRNA-seq。基于这一资源，我们开发了GenVinci，一种多模态组织基础模型，可从常规2D组织学重建3D组织场景。GenVinci从H&E预测空间基因表达，具有零样本泛化能力，并在8580万个细胞中映射衰老相关状态，揭示细胞类型特异性模式和疾病相关重塑。与人类遗传学整合表明基底上层角质形成细胞（suprabasal keratinocytes）参与特应性皮炎和角质形成细胞癌，分别与较高和较低的p16和p21表达相关。这些发现确立GenVinci作为一个跨尺度在3D中映射衰老的框架。

title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
zh_title: 异向变分编码的多层脑 MRI 超分辨及尼日利亚队列专家阅片评估
summary: 预印本提出序列无关的多层脑 MRI 超分辨率框架 MS-HVED，并在尼日利亚队列中由专家阅片评估。
key_points: 融合轴位、冠状位、矢状位多层图像
采用高斯乘积与视野感知融合
面向资源受限环境的临床协议
reason: 预印本新方法含专家阅片评估，但未经同行评审、证据有限
abstract: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved
zh_abstract: 高分辨率脑MRI对于神经影像学评估很重要，但常规临床方案往往依赖快速、各向异性的2D采集，尤其是在资源受限环境中。这些采集可能在方向、对齐和解剖覆盖范围上有所不同，导致图像堆栈部分重叠。现有的基于学习的超分辨率方法通常依赖单一的、约束不足的输入，或依赖具有理想化采集几何结构的固定多堆栈配置。我们提出MS-HVED，一种序列无关的框架，用于灵活的多堆栈脑MRI超分辨率。可用的轴位、冠状位和矢状位堆栈被独立编码为多尺度高斯后验，并使用视野感知的高斯乘积（Product-of-Gaussians）公式进行融合，该公式限制无支撑区域的贡献。物理信息引导的域随机化模拟异质性临床采集条件，包括倾斜、部分覆盖和成像伪影。MS-HVED在合成基准上实现了有竞争力或更优的重建保真度，并相对于低分辨率输入改善了下游组织分割。为评估超出训练队列的泛化能力，我们在来自尼日利亚队列的30例常规脑MRI检查上进行了外部临床验证，该队列代表医学影像研究中代表性不足的人群。这些检查构成了涉及44例真实病例和7名专家神经放射科医生的盲法读者研究的最大组成部分。在尼日利亚队列中，MS-HVED在210次配对评估中的187次被优先选择优于监督基线，评价指标为整体图像质量。在所有临床队列中，MS-HVED在使用所有可用输入时获得更高的整体质量评分（5.93 vs. 4.49，p<.001），当省略轴位或冠状位输入时，这种偏好仍然存在（p<.001）。代码见github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

summary: 综述性章节，概述 AI 在肺癌、COPD、哮喘、结核、间质性肺病及 COVID-19 等肺部疾病诊疗各环节的应用。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] Pulmonary diseases currently pose significant threats to global health, spanning common chronic conditions including lung cancer, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and asthma, as well as infectious and inflammatory diseases like tuberculosis, interstitial lung disease (ILD), and COVID-19. Therefore, accurate diagnosis, effective therapeutic strategies, and reliable assessment of prognosis for pulmonary diseases are essential for improving patient outcomes and safeguarding public health. Despite the increasing availability of medical imaging and pathological data owing to improvements in detection technologies, what is becoming increasingly evident are the limitations of conventional diagnosis, which relies solely on clinicians' subjective judgment based on imaging, pulmonary function, pathology, and clinical experience. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) technology, especially machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), has made significant progress in areas such as image recognition and model construction. Numerous studies have demonstrated the widespread application of AI in the screening and diagnosis of lung diseases, the optimization of treatment strategies, and prognosis assessment, revealing its remarkable ability to process and interpret complex clinical data. Although concerns persist regarding data quality, the "black box" nature of algorithms, clinical practice, and the regulatory landscape, the application of AI in lung disease research and clinical care is more and more promising. In this review, we summarize the latest advances of AI in the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary diseases, analyze the challenges and limitations of current AI technologies ranging from data and algorithms to clinical translation, and highlight directions for future research.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 肺部疾病目前对全球健康构成重大威胁，涵盖常见慢性疾病，包括肺癌、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和哮喘，以及感染性和炎症性疾病，如结核病、间质性肺疾病（ILD）和COVID-19。因此，对肺部疾病进行准确诊断、采取有效治疗策略以及可靠评估预后，对于改善患者结局和保障公共卫生至关重要。尽管随着检测技术的进步，医学影像和病理数据的可及性日益增加，但越来越明显的是，仅依赖临床医生基于影像、肺功能、病理和临床经验的主观判断的传统诊断存在局限性。近年来，人工智能（AI）技术，尤其是机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL），在图像识别和模型构建等领域取得了显著进展。大量研究已证明AI在肺部疾病筛查和诊断、治疗策略优化以及预后评估中的广泛应用，显示出其处理和解释复杂临床数据的显著能力。尽管在数据质量、算法的“黑箱”性质、临床实践和监管环境方面仍存在担忧，但AI在肺部疾病研究和临床照护中的应用正日益具有前景。在本综述中，我们总结了AI在肺部疾病诊断和治疗中的最新进展，分析了当前AI技术从数据和算法到临床转化方面的挑战和局限性，并强调了未来研究方向。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chinese PLA General Hospital; conditions: Kidney (Renal Cell) Cancer, Ureteropelvic Junction Obstruction, Upper Urinary Tract Carcinoma; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1700; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate whether an artificial intelligence (AI) based software system can assist surgeons in identifying key anatomical structures during minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery. During these procedures, surgeons operate while viewing images from laparoscopic endoscope. Key anatomical structures, such as the kidney, renal artery and vein, ureter, renal pelvis, inferior vena cava, and left reproductive vein, as well as surgical targets such as tumors, may sometimes be difficult to distinguish because of bleeding, surgical smoke, tissue movement, changes in tissue appearance, or obstruction by surgical instruments. The study team has developed an AI-based image recognition system that analyzes surgical video in real time and identifies and outlines relevant anatomical structures on the screen during surgery. The study has two main goals (primary endpoints): 1. To evaluate how accurately the AI system can identify and delineate key anatomical structures in surgical videos collected from different hospitals, surgeons, surgical procedures, and imaging systems. 2. To evaluate the real-time performance and technical reliability of the AI system in the operating room, including processing latency, frame rate, system failure rate, and the proportion of time during surgery in which AI-generated results are successfully displayed. The study will include adults aged 18 years or older who undergo one of five types of minimally invasive upper urinary tract surgery: partial nephrectomy, radical nephrectomy, radical nephroureterectomy, inferior vena cava tumor thrombectomy, or pyeloplasty. The study will be conducted at 11 hospitals in China. In the first phase, surgical videos recorded between 2015 and 2025 will be used to develop, validate, and test the AI system. In the second phase, approximately 100 patients will be prospectively enrolled from internal centers, and the AI-generated anatomical recognition results will be displayed on a monitor during surgery. Overall, approximately 1,600 retrospective surgical cases and 100 prospective cases are planned for inclusion. The AI system is designed solely as an assistive tool for anatomical recognition. It does not make clinical decisions, provide autonomous surgical instructions, or control any surgical equipment. Surgeons remain fully responsible for all clinical and surgical decisions, and the AI display can be turned off at any time. All participants will receive standard clinical care. Parti
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：中国人民解放军总医院；疾病：肾脏（肾细胞）癌、肾盂输尿管连接部梗阻、上尿路癌；类型：OBSERVATIONAL（观察性）；入组：1700；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING（尚未招募）] 本研究旨在评估基于人工智能（AI）的软件系统能否在微创上尿路手术中协助外科医生识别关键解剖结构。在这些手术中，外科医生通过观察腹腔镜内窥镜图像进行操作。关键解剖结构，如肾脏、肾动脉和肾静脉、输尿管、肾盂、下腔静脉和左生殖静脉，以及手术目标如肿瘤，有时可能因出血、手术烟雾、组织移动、组织外观变化或手术器械遮挡而难以区分。研究团队开发了一种基于AI的图像识别系统，可实时分析手术视频，并在手术过程中于屏幕上识别和勾勒相关解剖结构。本研究有两个主要目标（主要终点）：1. 评估AI系统在来自不同医院、外科医生、手术方式和成像系统采集的手术视频中识别和勾画关键解剖结构的准确性。2. 评估AI系统在手术室中的实时性能和技术可靠性，包括处理延迟、帧率、系统故障率，以及手术期间AI生成结果成功显示的时间比例。研究将纳入接受以下五类微创上尿路手术之一的18岁及以上成年人：肾部分切除术、根治性肾切除术、根治性肾输尿管切除术、下腔静脉癌栓取出术或肾盂成形术。本研究将在中国11家医院开展。第一阶段将使用2015年至2025年间记录的手术视频来开发、验证和测试AI系统。第二阶段将从内部中心前瞻性入组约100例患者，并在手术期间于监视器上显示AI生成的解剖识别结果。总体计划纳入约1,600例回顾性手术病例和100例前瞻性病例。AI系统仅设计为解剖识别的辅助工具。它不做出临床决策、不提供自主手术指令，也不控制任何手术设备。外科医生仍对所有临床和手术决策负全部责任，且AI显示可随时关闭。所有参与者将接受标准临床护理。Parti

abstract: The gaze direction of the physician during consultations plays an important role in patient satisfaction, with several studies pointing to the positive correlation between the amount of time the physician spends looking at the patient and patient satisfaction. Additionally, the effects of the virtual consultation environment on the gaze behaviour of the doctor have yet to be studied. Therefore, this study aims to assess the impact of the virtual consultation environment by comparing the amount of total time the doctor spends looking at the patient between face-to-face and virtual consultations, as well as the average duration during the consultation and the gaze frequency. The study population consisted of 14 doctors divided between 4 medical specialties: Gynaecology/Obstetrics (4), Neurology (3), Endocrinology (3) and General and Familiar Medicine (4). A low-cost desktop that runs an appearance-based gaze estimation pipeline was implemented in the clinical setup. Each doctor recorded 20 face-to-face consultations and 20 virtual consultations, which were then processed by the pipeline to obtain the percentage of time the doctor spent looking at the patient during the consultation. Overall, we found that doctors look more at the patient in virtual consultations compared to face-to-face consultations, both in total time and average duration during the consultation. Within medical specialties, three out the four specialties involved presented clear tendencies to look more at the patient in virtual consultations when compared to face-to-face consultations.
zh_abstract: 医生在问诊期间的注视方向对患者满意度起着重要作用，多项研究指出医生看向患者的时间量与患者满意度呈正相关。此外，虚拟问诊环境对医生注视行为的影响尚待研究。因此，本研究旨在通过比较面对面问诊与虚拟问诊中医生看向患者的总时间、问诊期间的平均持续时间以及注视频率，评估虚拟问诊环境的影响。研究人群由14名医生组成，分布于4个医学专科：妇科/产科（4）、神经科（3）、内分泌科（3）和普通与家庭医学（4）。在临床环境中部署了一台低成本台式机，运行基于外观的注视估计流程。每位医生记录了20次面对面问诊和20次虚拟问诊，随后由该流程处理，以获得医生在问诊期间看向患者的时间百分比。总体而言，我们发现与面对面问诊相比，医生在虚拟问诊中看向患者更多，无论是总时间还是问诊期间的平均持续时间。在各医学专科内，涉及的四个专科中有三个表现出明确倾向，即与面对面问诊相比，在虚拟问诊中看向患者更多。

abstract: AbstractAI models using medical images are increasingly proposed to support clinical decision-making in lung cancer, motivating assessment of their methodological rigor and transparency. To assess how these models are developed, evaluated, and reported, and to identify gaps in best statistical practices, we conducted a cross-sectional meta-research review of OpenAlex-indexed studies (January 1, 2023, to June 30, 2025) that developed image-based AI tools for lung cancer risk prediction, detection, or prognosis. Thirty-six studies met our inclusion criteria. Convolutional neural networks were used in most studies (27 studies, 75%), and area under the curve (AUC) was the most frequently reported evaluation metric (29 studies, 81%). Although 23 studies (64%) reported some form of uncertainty quantification, most were limited to presenting confidence intervals for global performance metrics (e.g., AUC, sensitivity, and accuracy) rather than individual prediction- or risk-level uncertainty. Common limitations included limited external test set use (14 studies, 39%), insufficient subgroup analyses (10 studies, 28%), and limited adherence to established prediction-model reporting guidelines. Overall, future research should prioritize standardized reporting, use of external test sets, and model performance assessment across clinically relevant subpopulations. The coexistence of increasingly powerful AI-based prediction models with inconsistent study design, evaluation, and reporting practices emphasizes the urgent need to implement more rigorous and transparent methodological standards in this field. (Funded by Yale School of Public Health.).
zh_abstract: 摘要：使用医学图像的AI（人工智能）模型正越来越多地被提出用于支持肺癌的临床决策，这促使人们评估其方法学严谨性和透明度。为评估这些模型如何被开发、评估和报告，并识别最佳统计实践方面的差距，我们对OpenAlex索引的研究（2023年1月1日至2025年6月30日）进行了一项横断面元研究综述，这些研究开发了基于图像的AI工具用于肺癌风险预测、检测或预后。36项研究符合我们的纳入标准。大多数研究使用了卷积神经网络（convolutional neural networks）（27项研究，75%），曲线下面积（AUC）是最常报告的评估指标（29项研究，81%）。尽管23项研究（64%）报告了某种形式的不确定性量化，但大多数仅限于呈现全局性能指标（如AUC、敏感性和准确性）的置信区间，而非个体预测层面或风险层面的不确定性。常见局限性包括外部测试集使用有限（14项研究，39%）、亚组分析不足（10项研究，28%），以及对既定预测模型报告指南的依从性有限。总体而言，未来研究应优先考虑标准化报告、使用外部测试集，以及在临床相关亚人群中评估模型性能。日益强大的基于AI的预测模型与不一致的研究设计、评估和报告实践并存，强调该领域迫切需要实施更严谨和透明的方法学标准。（由耶鲁大学公共卫生学院资助。）

abstract: The European Medical Device Regulations have been criticized for imposing disproportionate barriers to innovation due to excessive regulatory requirements. In response, the European Commission proposed amendments to key regulations in December 2025. The reforms aim to eliminate double regulation, reduce documentation requirements, and introduce new regulatory tools. In this Comment, we argue that these changes are generally well-targeted but leave specific challenges for innovative artificial intelligence-enabled medical devices unresolved.

title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
zh_title: TabBioMed：大规模生物医学表格学习基准
summary: arXiv 预印本发布 94 个公开生物医学表格数据集基准，统一预处理与评测框架，并对比 23 个模型。

覆盖电子病历、药物发现与多类组学

reason: 94 数据集、23 模型的大型公开基准；但为预印本，属重要档
abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.
zh_abstract: 机器学习的最新进展加速了生物医学预测，但在结构化生物医学数据上的评估仍然碎片化，尤其是对于具有高维、大样本量、缺失和类别不平衡的数据集。我们推出TabBioMed，一个大规模基准，包含94个经过整理的公开生物医学表格数据集，涵盖电子健康记录、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学和系统生物学。TabBioMed通过标准化、感知数据集的预处理和评估框架统一这些数据集，从而能够在分类、回归和多目标任务之间进行可复现比较。我们对23个模型进行了基准测试，涵盖经典基线、梯度提升树、神经表格架构和表格基础模型。基础模型在家族层面提供了最强的预测性能。然而，它们的增益依赖于数据情形（regime）：基于树的模型和调优的多层感知机仍极具竞争力，在推理时间或训练成本约束下常常占优。总体而言，TabBioMed表明生物医学表格学习强烈依赖情境，最佳模型选择取决于数据情形、任务类型和计算预算。我们发布TabBioMed，包含整理后的数据集和划分、预处理代码、基线和结果，为生物医学机器学习中的实际模型选择和未来方法开发提供可复现的基准，网址为 https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed。

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare

summary: 预印本提出开放医疗AI评测计划 InclusionMed，从388个候选中筛出4个公开基准，加自建诊断推理基准共5项，前沿大模型综合得分17.5–49.1。
key_points: Atlas按3种医疗角色×3种能力组织
首版覆盖9格中的3格

abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
zh_abstract: 推动面向包容性医疗的医学AI需要跨多样医疗角色、任务和照护场景的评估，但基准覆盖仍不均衡。我们推出InclusionMed，一项面向包容性医疗的开放式医学AI评估倡议。InclusionMed Atlas将基准按三个医疗角色和三种AI能力组织。首个版本中，我们通过结构化审查和独立复现，从388个候选基准中选出了四个公开基准。加上我们的私有诊断推理基准InclusionMed-DxFiles，Atlas共包含五个基准，覆盖其九个角色—能力单元中的三个。我们在Atlas上评估了前沿大语言模型，并将结果汇总为InclusionMed Index，总体得分范围为17.5至49.1（满分100）。该Index还按医疗角色和AI能力报告得分，显示模型的排名会随所考虑的角色或能力而变化。使用任务级标签的基准内分析显示，Index中排名最高的十个模型在患者沟通上的得分均高于临床决策。Index得分相近的模型在估计推理成本上也存在显著差异。这些发现凸显了需要覆盖更多样化医疗需求的评估，以及针对具体情境选择模型。通过开放合作和社区贡献，InclusionMed力求确保全球多样化的医疗需求能够塑造医学AI进展的定义和衡量方式。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: General Hospital of Ningxia Medical University; conditions: Postoperative Pulmonary Complications (PPCs); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1500; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Background and Objective Postoperative pulmonary complications (PPCs) are common after elective colorectal surgery and are associated with prolonged hospitalization, increased morbidity, and delayed recovery. Existing PPC prediction tools were mainly developed in thoracic or mixed surgical populations and rely predominantly on clinical variables; preoperative chest CT information remains underused, and a population-specific tool for elderly colorectal cancer patients is still lacking. This study aims to develop and validate a multimodal deep learning model that integrates preoperative chest CT-derived features with multidimensional clinical variables to predict PPCs in patients aged ≥65 years undergoing elective radical colorectal cancer surgery, and to quantify its incremental value and clinical net benefit. Methods This is a single-center retrospective cohort study. Eligible patients will be assigned to a development window (August 2020-August 2024), split chronologically at a 7∶1∶2 ratio into training, validation, and test sets with five-fold cross-validation, and a locked temporal external validation window (September 2024-September 2026), which will be used only after the final model is fixed. The primary outcome is 30-day composite PPCs defined according to the EPCO criteria; the Melbourne Group Scale will serve as a parallel sensitivity definition. Preoperative clinical variables and chest CT images obtained within four weeks before surgery will be collected. A convolutional neural network imaging branch-or 2D transfer learning based on RadImageNet if the sample size is insufficient-will extract CT deep features, which will be fused with clinical variables at the feature (intermediate) level. Six classifiers, including logistic regression, support vector machine, random forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and multilayer perceptron, will be tuned within a unified search space. Discrimination (AUC with DeLong test and Bootstrap 95% CI), calibration (calibration curves, Brier score), incremental value (NRI, IDI), and clinical utility (decision curve analysis) will be evaluated against the ARISCAT and GSU-Pulmonary scores, a clinical-only model, and an imaging-only model. Grad-CAM and SHAP will be applied to interpret the model. Expected Outcome The study is expected to provide an interpretable and deployable preoperative risk stratification tool for elderly patients undergoing colorectal surgery, clarify the incremental contribution of preoperative chest CT inf
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：宁夏医科大学总医院（General Hospital of Ningxia Medical University）；疾病：术后肺部并发症（Postoperative Pulmonary Complications, PPCs）；类型：OBSERVATIONAL；入组人数：1500；状态：ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] 【背景与目的】术后肺部并发症（PPCs）在择期结直肠手术后常见，并与住院时间延长、发病率增加和恢复延迟相关。现有的PPC预测工具主要在胸科或混合手术人群中开发，且主要依赖临床变量；术前胸部CT信息仍未得到充分利用，且仍缺乏针对老年结直肠癌患者的人群特异性工具。本研究旨在开发并验证一种多模态深度学习模型，该模型整合术前胸部CT衍生特征与多维临床变量，用于预测年龄≥65岁接受择期结直肠癌根治术患者的PPCs，并量化其增量价值和临床净获益。 【方法】这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究。符合条件的患者将被分配至开发窗口（2020年8月至2024年8月），按时间顺序以7∶1∶2的比例分为训练集、验证集和测试集，并进行五折交叉验证；同时设置锁定的时间外部验证窗口（2024年9月至2026年9月），仅在最终模型固定后使用。主要结局是根据EPCO标准定义的30天复合PPCs；墨尔本小组量表（Melbourne Group Scale）将作为平行的敏感性定义。将收集术前临床变量和手术前四周内获得的胸部CT图像。将使用卷积神经网络影像分支——若样本量不足，则使用基于RadImageNet的二维迁移学习——提取CT深度特征，并在特征（中间）层面与临床变量融合。六种分类器，包括逻辑回归、支持向量机、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM和多层感知机，将在统一搜索空间内调参。将针对ARISCAT和GSU-Pulmonary评分、仅临床模型和仅影像模型评估区分度（AUC，采用DeLong检验和Bootstrap 95% CI）、校准度（校准曲线、Brier评分）、增量价值（NRI、IDI）和临床效用（决策曲线分析）。将应用Grad-CAM和SHAP解释模型。 【预期结局】本研究预期为接受结直肠手术的老年患者提供一种可解释且可部署的术前风险分层工具，阐明术前胸部CT inf的增量贡献。

abstract: [Sage open pathology] Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), encompassing Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, remains a complex and heterogeneous condition with variable response to biologic therapies. Despite significant advances with anti-TNF agents, integrin inhibitors, and interleukin-12/23 blockers, treatment outcomes are limited by primary nonresponse, secondary loss of efficacy, immunogenicity, and substantial healthcare costs. The advent of artificial intelligence (AI), particularly machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) algorithms, offers new opportunities to address these challenges by integrating diverse clinical, laboratory, imaging, histologic, genetic, and microbiome data. Recent studies demonstrate that AI-based models achieve high accuracy in predicting biologic response, remission, and adverse outcomes, outperforming conventional statistical approaches. AI has also shown promise in real-time endoscopic assessment, histologic grading, and forecasting disease progression, enabling earlier intervention and personalized therapy. However, current models are constrained by limited datasets, heterogeneity, lack of large-scale prospective validation, and concerns regarding interpretability, transparency, and patient privacy. Future efforts should prioritize multicenter trials, external validation, and ethical integration into clinical workflows. Collectively, AI-driven prediction of biologic therapy response represents a pivotal step toward precision medicine in IBD, with the potential to optimize therapeutic strategies, reduce ineffective treatment exposure, and improve patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Sage open pathology] 炎症性肠病（inflammatory bowel disease, IBD），包括克罗恩病（Crohn's disease）和溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis），仍然是一种复杂且异质性的疾病，对生物制剂的反应存在差异。尽管抗TNF药物、整合素抑制剂和白细胞介素-12/23阻断剂取得了显著进展，但治疗结局仍受原发性无应答、继发性疗效丧失、免疫原性和巨大医疗成本的限制。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI），特别是机器学习（machine learning, ML）和深度学习（deep learning, DL）算法的出现，通过整合多样化的临床、实验室、影像、组织学、遗传和微生物组数据，为解决这些挑战提供了新机会。近期研究表明，基于AI的模型在预测生物制剂反应、缓解和不良结局方面达到较高准确度，优于传统统计方法。AI在实时内镜评估、组织学分级和预测疾病进展方面也显示出前景，可实现更早干预和个体化治疗。然而，当前模型受限于数据集有限、异质性、缺乏大规模前瞻性验证，以及对可解释性、透明性和患者隐私的担忧。未来工作应优先开展多中心试验、外部验证，并将伦理整合到临床工作流程中。总体而言，AI驱动的生物治疗反应预测是迈向IBD精准医学的关键一步，具有优化治疗策略、减少无效治疗暴露和改善患者结局的潜力。

abstract: Background Bone mineral density (BMD) and the Fracture Risk Assessment Tool (FRAX) incompletely capture fracture risk in the osteopenic range, where much of the fracture burden occurs. Routine chest radiographs are acquired across a broad range of patients and may contain information relevant to fracture risk, offering a potential opportunistic complement without additional imaging burden. Methods We developed a convolutional neural network survival model in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated it in 85,284 patients from two independent institutions. Eligibility required a chest radiograph obtained within 1 year of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry scans, so all participants had been referred for densitometry. The primary outcome was incident major osteoporotic fracture. Discrimination was assessed by using the concordance index (C-index) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) at 2, 3, 5, and 10 years, compared with FRAX with BMD and with the lowest BMD T-score. Results In the external validation cohorts (mean 58.6 years of age; 68.9% female; and follow-up of 77 months), the deep-learning (DL) model achieved a C-index of 0.843 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.837 to 0.850) and a censoring-adjusted 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI, 0.846 to 0.863), which was higher than that of FRAX with BMD (C-index, 0.779, 95% CI, 0.770 to 0.787; 10-year AUROC, 0.785, 95% CI, 0.775 to 0.794; both P Conclusions A survival DL model applied to routine chest radiographs identified patients at high fracture risk with discrimination exceeding that of FRAX, with the greatest benefit in patients with osteopenia. As all participants had been referred for densitometry, absolute-risk and case-finding estimates require prospective evaluation in an unselected routine-radiography population. (Funded by the National Research Foundation of Korea and others.).
zh_abstract: 【背景】骨密度（BMD）和骨折风险评估工具（FRAX）不能完全捕捉骨量减少范围内的骨折风险，而大部分骨折负担发生在该范围内。常规胸部X线片在广泛患者人群中获取，可能包含与骨折风险相关的信息，提供一种潜在的机会性补充，而不增加额外影像负担。【方法】我们在53,109名三级医院成人中开发了一种卷积神经网络生存模型，并在来自两个独立机构的85,284名患者中进行了外部验证。纳入资格要求胸部X线片在双能X线吸收测定扫描前1年内获取，因此所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定。主要结局为新发主要骨质疏松性骨折。通过使用一致性指数（C-index）以及2年、3年、5年和10年的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估判别能力，并与联合BMD的FRAX以及最低BMD T值进行比较。【结果】在外部验证队列中（平均年龄58.6岁；女性68.9%；随访77个月），深度学习（DL）模型达到C-index为0.843（95%置信区间[CI]，0.837至0.850）以及经删失校正的10年AUROC为0.855（95% CI，0.846至0.863），高于联合BMD的FRAX（C-index，0.779，95% CI，0.770至0.787；10年AUROC，0.785，95% CI，0.775至0.794；两者均P）【结论】应用于常规胸部X线片的生存DL模型识别出高骨折风险患者，其判别能力超过FRAX，在骨量减少患者中获益最大。由于所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定，绝对风险和病例发现估计需要在未选择的常规放射摄影人群中进行前瞻性评估。（由韩国国家研究基金会等资助。）

title: Interpretable AI links routine clinical gout phenotypes to multi-omic signatures and divergent health trajectories
zh_title: 可解释AI将痛风临床表型与多组学及健康轨迹关联
summary: 用常规实验室变量无监督分型，并在英国生物银行、中国GoutRe与MIMIC-IV三个队列外部评估。
key_points: 21,235人数据，含两个外部独立队列
识别三种痛风亚型，复发与死亡风险不同

reason: 跨三国多队列外部验证且样本过万，符合重要档加分项。
abstract: Integrative frameworks that connect scalable clinical phenotypes with molecular mechanisms are needed to resolve disease heterogeneity. We developed and externally evaluated an interpretable gout clinical-subset framework using routine data from 21,235 participants across UK Biobank (UKB; n = 10,599), the multicentre Chinese GoutRe registry (n = 8617), and MIMIC-IV (n = 2019). Unsupervised learning on six prespecified routine laboratory variables identified three subsets: C1, a low-burden state with preserved reserve; C2, a urate-metabolic inflammatory state with the greatest recurrence liability and a greater cardiometabolic and hepatic comorbidity burden; and C3, a state characterized by systemic vulnerability and higher mortality. In UKB, death-competing recurrence analysis showed a higher recurrence incidence for C2 versus C1 (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 1.896, 95% CI 1.710–2.101), whereas C3 did not differ from C1 (sHR 0.994, 95% CI 0.887–1.112). A six-variable CRT model reconstructed the locked subset labels using nested 10-fold out-of-fold evaluation in UKB and external application without retraining in GoutRe and MIMIC-IV. One-versus-rest AUCs were 0.965/0.945/0.980 in UKB, 0.906/0.914/0.953 in GoutRe, and 0.912/0.898/0.962 in MIMIC-IV for C1/C2/C3, respectively. Genetic, proteomic, and metabolomic analyses supported distinct urate-inflammatory and systemic-vulnerability axes, although the C3 senescence-related genetic signal was nominal and requires replication. Routine laboratory data can identify gout clinical subsets with distinct molecular profiles and patterns of recurrence and mortality; whether these subsets can guide clinical management requires prospective evaluation.
zh_abstract: 需要将可扩展的临床表型与分子机制联系起来的整合性框架，以解析疾病异质性。我们利用来自21,235名参与者的常规数据开发并外部评估了一个可解释的痛风临床亚组框架，这些参与者来自UK Biobank（UKB；n = 10,599）、多中心中国GoutRe注册研究（n = 8617）和MIMIC-IV（n = 2019）。对六个预先指定的常规实验室变量进行无监督学习，识别出三个亚组：C1，一种储备保留的低负担状态；C2，一种尿酸盐代谢炎症状态，具有最高的复发风险以及更大的心脏代谢和肝脏合并症负担；C3，一种以全身脆弱性和更高死亡率为特征的状态。在UKB中，以死亡为竞争风险的复发分析显示，C2与C1相比复发发生率更高（亚分布风险比[sHR] 1.896，95% CI 1.710–2.101），而C3与C1无差异（sHR 0.994，95% CI 0.887–1.112）。一个六变量CRT模型在UKB中使用嵌套10折折外评估重建了锁定的亚组标签，并在GoutRe和MIMIC-IV中不重新训练进行外部应用。C1/C2/C3的一对多AUC在UKB中分别为0.965/0.945/0.980，在GoutRe中分别为0.906/0.914/0.953，在MIMIC-IV中分别为0.912/0.898/0.962。遗传学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学分析支持不同的尿酸盐-炎症轴和全身脆弱性轴，尽管C3的衰老相关遗传信号仅为名义性（nominal），需要重复验证。常规实验室数据可以识别具有不同分子谱以及复发和死亡模式的痛风临床亚组；这些亚组能否指导临床管理需要前瞻性评估。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled clinical decision support: device regulation and decision influence.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA
zh_title: AI临床决策支持：器械监管与决策影响力
summary: 评述FDA 2026年1月临床决策支持指南，指出AI赋能的CDS可能加剧临床医生的自动化偏差。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled clinical decision support (CDS) challenges core assumptions of the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) recently updated CDS guidance, including the concepts of independent clinician review of outputs and manufacturer-intended use for exempting certain CDS tools from medical device regulation. We examine the FDA's January 2026 CDS guidance in the context of the evolving landscape of AI-enabled CDS tools, clinician interaction studies with AI-enabled CDS, and AI governance frameworks. Although the FDA's framework distinguishes non-device CDS from regulated software, AI-enabled CDS may synthesize and transform clinical information in ways that are difficult to verify during routine care, increasing clinician susceptibility to automation bias. Incorporating pragmatic triggers into existing governance frameworks can help identify scenarios with a heightened risk for clinical decision influence. Oversight calibrated to real-world clinical decision influence is needed to strengthen practical safety standards for AI-enabled CDS.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 人工智能（AI）赋能的临床决策支持（CDS）对食品药品监督管理局（FDA）最近更新的CDS指南的核心假设提出挑战，包括对输出进行独立临床医生审查的概念，以及制造商预期用途可使某些CDS工具豁免医疗器械监管的概念。我们在AI赋能CDS工具不断演变的格局、临床医生与AI赋能CDS交互研究以及AI治理框架的背景下，审视FDA 2026年1月的CDS指南。尽管FDA的框架将非器械CDS与受监管软件区分开来，但AI赋能CDS可能以在常规诊疗中难以核实的方式综合和转换临床信息，增加临床医生对自动化偏倚的易感性。将务实触发因素纳入现有治理框架，有助于识别临床决策影响风险升高的情景。需要根据现实世界临床决策影响进行校准的监督，以加强AI赋能CDS的实用安全标准。
