abstract: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. We introduce Breath-Dx, the first comprehensive benchmark of time series classification methods for breath-based disease screening. Our work leverages the Scent of Health (S-OH) dataset, the largest public clinical eNose collection to date, comprising 1,234 patients across nine diagnostic groups, each providing a 17-channel multivariate time series with explicit temporal train/test splits that account for sensor drift. We systematically evaluate 10 methods spanning four families: feature-based tabular learners, convolution-based models, graph-based, and time series architectures. All methods degrade significantly under temporal validation (0.05-0.12 AUC drop compared to random cross-validation), confirming that drift embeds a strong temporal signal. Under this realistic evaluation, the best methods achieve ROC AUC of 0.74-0.76 for some lung conditions, though others remain near chance. Recurrent architectures show the most consistent performance across diseases, while specialized time series methods achieve the highest peak results. Demographic confounders matter: breath signals provide independent diagnostic value for some conditions but add little beyond age for others. We release the S-OH dataset, all temporal splits, evaluation protocols, and code to enable reproducible research and accelerate progress in clinical breathomics.
zh_abstract: 电子鼻（eNose）技术通过呼出气分析为疾病筛查提供了一种便携、非侵入性的途径。然而，该领域的进展受到阻碍，因为缺乏在现实条件下比较机器学习方法的系统性基准，尤其是传感器漂移——一种已知但很少被量化的失效模式。大多数现有研究依赖小型私有数据集且方案不一致，导致结果不可比较并减缓进展。我们推出 Breath-Dx，这是首个用于基于呼吸的疾病筛查的时间序列分类方法的综合基准。我们的工作利用 Scent of Health（S-OH）数据集，这是迄今最大的公开临床 eNose 集合，包含九个诊断组的 1,234 名患者，每位患者提供 17 通道多变量时间序列，并具有考虑传感器漂移的显式时间训练/测试划分。我们系统评估 10 种方法，涵盖四个类别：基于特征的表格学习器、基于卷积的模型、基于图的方法和时间序列架构。所有方法在时间验证下均显著退化（与随机交叉验证相比 AUC 下降 0.05-0.12），证实漂移嵌入了强时间信号。在这种现实评估下，最佳方法对某些肺部疾病达到 ROC AUC 0.74-0.76，而其他疾病仍接近随机水平。循环架构在跨疾病中表现最一致，而专门的时间序列方法达到最高峰值结果。人口学混杂因素很重要：呼吸信号对某些疾病提供独立诊断价值，但对其他疾病在年龄之外几乎没有增加信息。我们发布 S-OH 数据集、所有时间划分、评估协议和代码，以实现可重复研究并加速临床呼吸组学进展。

abstract: [JAMA network open] Hospital discharge summaries are essential for continuity of care, but fragmented electronic health record (EHR) data can compromise their quality and safety. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for clinical documentation tasks despite limited evidence regarding their performance in health care settings compared with the current standard of care. To evaluate clinician acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries derived from EHRs compared with routine clinician-written summaries. In this retrospective comparative effectiveness study using a prespecified noninferiority framework, acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries was compared with clinician-authored discharge summaries. Admission records from 5 London hospitals for September 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, were evaluated against the full admission record by practicing physicians. Admissions were eligible only if the clinician-authored discharge summary contained identifiable clinical summary, plan and requested actions, and information given sections. Data analysis was conducted from July 2025 to February 2026. LLM-generated summaries were produced using GPT-4o mini (July 18, 2024 release; OpenAI) and a clinician-codesigned prompt. The primary outcome was clinician signoff with no or minor edits, derived from 2 sequential questions: (1) whether the reviewer would sign the summary and (2) whether no, minor, or major edits were required. title: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning

summary: 预印本用物理引导3D自监督学习，在212对颞下颌关节CBCT-MRI上从常规CBCT提取亚视觉软组织病变信号。

abstract: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.
zh_abstract: 常规 X 射线模态如锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）针对高对比度矿化组织进行优化，使软组织异常埋没在光子噪声之下并低于人类视觉感知。因此，检测非钙化病变需要二次磁共振成像（MRI）。我们证明，软组织病变的亚视觉放射学特征在物理上保留于常规 CBCT 扫描中，并且即使在配对数据极度稀缺的情况下，也可使用有针对性的、物理引导的深度学习流程提取用于机会性筛查。以颞下颌关节（TMJ）作为模型系统（N = 212 对 CBCT-MRI 关节），我们通过两阶段框架解决高容量 3D 网络的严重过拟合。首先，我们采用冻结的全网格 3D 掩码自编码器（BertsWin），通过 GradientConductor（GCond）优化器和解剖感知目标（PhysLoss）在 6,550 个未标注 CBCT 体积上预训练，该目标将梯度流重定向到 [-300, 300] HU 软组织窗。其次，髁突顶点的自动定位驱动确定性 3D 裁剪，消除 81% 的背景骨性方差。通过患者隔离的 3x10 折分层交叉验证方案评估，MRI 证实的滑膜积液的统计稳健亚视觉信号（ROC AUC = 0.793）仅从使用 PhysLoss 和 GCond 方案预训练的表征中出现。关键的是，只有这种设置能捕获真正的 3D 解剖手性（p < 0.001）和高患者内结构一致性（0.791）而非患者间噪声；相反，使用标准 L2 损失或未掩码方差分解（MVC）预训练的相同架构退化为随机猜测。这些发现建立了一个可推广的范式，将常规低对比度放射学扫描重新用于隐匿性软组织疾病的机会性筛查工具。

title: Human-Agentic AI Collaboration Workflow for Trend Analysis of ChatGPT Applications in Healthcare

summary: medRxiv预印本用LLM智能体与领域专家协作，系统检索并分析ChatGPT在医疗健康中的应用研究趋势。

abstract: Background: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have demonstrated strong potential to transform healthcare research and practice. However, LLMs are probabilistic and generate inherently variable outputs, which create risk and uncertainty in healthcare applications. Therefore, analyzing the current research landscape of ChatGPT applications is imperative to understand applied techniques and related concerns and to facilitate their practical integration into healthcare information systems. Objective: Leveraging LLM-based agentic AI with domain experts to analyze trends in ChatGPT healthcare applications and to examine the collaborative and interpretative capacities of LLM agents in broader contexts beyond narrowly defined topics. Methods: The review used a systematic search of the PubMed and Web of Science databases, following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, and focused on ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors. To support the review process, an adaptive, iterative LLM-based agentic AI with a human-in-the-loop mechanism was employed for automated metadata extraction, identification, classification, and knowledge synthesis. The extracted information was subsequently used for temporal and thematic analyses, citation network construction, and main-path analysis. Results: Across 192 papers, the review identified 511 ChatGPT application types, 690 concern items, and 368 influence usage factors distinct from traditional IT, achieving a metadata error rate of 1.04%. The human-agentic AI workflow enabled efficient synthesis of contextual information across studies, addressing the growing challenge of timely evidence integration in medical knowledge. The findings provide insights into the evolving trajectories of ChatGPT applications in healthcare and demonstrate the value of an expert-validated human-agentic AI workflow in supporting literature analysis and streamlining review processes. Conclusion: This review provides a comprehensive overview of emerging ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors in healthcare. The study further provides meaningful insights into the operational mechanisms of agentic AI, demonstrating the potential of human-AI collaboration for medical informatics research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】随着人工智能（AI）的快速发展，大型语言模型（LLM），如 ChatGPT，已展现出改变医疗保健研究与实践的强大潜力。然而，LLM 具有概率性并产生内在可变输出，这在医疗保健应用中带来风险和不确定性。因此，分析 ChatGPT 应用的当前研究格局至关重要，以理解所应用的技术和相关关切，并促进其实际整合到医疗保健信息系统中。【目的】利用基于 LLM 的代理式 AI 与领域专家一起分析 ChatGPT 在医疗保健应用中的趋势，并考察 LLM 代理在狭义主题之外的更广泛情境中的协作与解释能力。【方法】本综述对 PubMed 和 Web of Science 数据库进行系统检索，遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南，聚焦于 ChatGPT 应用、相关关切、应用技术和使用因素。为支持综述过程，采用具有人在回路机制的自适应、迭代式基于 LLM 的代理式 AI 进行自动化元数据提取、识别、分类和知识综合。提取的信息随后用于时间与主题分析、引文网络构建和主路径分析。【结果】在 192 篇论文中，本综述识别出 511 种 ChatGPT 应用类型、690 个关切断面和 368 个区别于传统 IT 的影响使用因素，元数据错误率为 1.04%。人类-代理式 AI 工作流能够高效综合跨研究的上下文信息，应对医学知识中及时证据整合日益增长的挑战。研究结果提供了对 ChatGPT 在医疗保健中应用演变轨迹的洞见，并证明了经专家验证的人类-代理式 AI 工作流在支持文献分析和简化综述流程方面的价值。【结论】本综述全面概述了医疗保健中新兴的 ChatGPT 应用、相关关切、应用技术和使用因素。该研究进一步提供了对代理式 AI 运行机制的有意义洞见，展示了人-AI 协作在医学信息学研究中的潜力。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Xiaohui Zhao; conditions: Breast Cancer, Radiotherapy; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 51000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Breast cancer remains the most prevalent malignancy among women worldwide, with a continuously increasing incidence. As a crucial component of comprehensive cancer treatment, radiotherapy plays a key role in reducing local recurrence rates and improving overall survival outcomes. However, traditional radiotherapy target volume contouring and treatment planning design rely heavily on clinician expertise, presenting challenges such as prolonged processing time, significant inter-observer variability, and high subjectivity in dose optimization. Although artificial intelligence has made substantial progress in automated contouring and planning, conventional single-modal models still face major limitations. These models struggle to effectively integrate clinical text, tumor biological characteristics, and dose distribution factors, resulting in restricted generalizability. Therefore, developing an intelligent radiotherapy assistance system capable of multimodal data fusion is of high clinical significance to enhance precision and efficiency in breast cancer radiotherapy. This study aims to develop an innovative breast cancer radiotherapy assistance system based on a multimodal large language model. By integrating multimodal imaging data (including CT, MRI, and ultrasound), pathology reports, and structured electronic health record text, the system realizes end-to-end intelligence from target volume contouring to treatment plan generation. Employing a multicenter, ambidirectional cohort design, the study collects comprehensive clinical data from breast cancer patients who have undergone breast-conserving surgery or mastectomy. Technologically, the system innovatively combines the natural language processing capabilities of large language models with the image analysis strengths of deep learning, utilizing attention mechanisms to achieve deep fusion and interactive comprehension of heterogeneous medical data. Notably, the system breaks through traditional radiotherapy planning workflows by jointly optimizing target contouring and dose planning as a unified pipeline, applying reinforcement learning algorithms to dynamically balance target volume coverage with organ-at-risk protection. The outcomes of this study will provide an important paradigm for the clinical application of AI in radiation oncology and advance the field of precision radiotherapy.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Xiaohui Zhao；疾病/条件：乳腺癌、放疗；类型：观察性；入组人数：51000；状态：尚未招募] 乳腺癌仍是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤，且发病率持续上升。作为综合癌症治疗的重要组成部分，放疗在降低局部复发率和改善总生存结局方面发挥关键作用。然而，传统放疗靶区勾画和治疗计划设计严重依赖临床医生经验，存在处理时间长、观察者间变异大以及剂量优化高度主观等挑战。尽管人工智能在自动勾画和计划方面取得实质性进展，传统单模态模型仍面临重大局限。这些模型难以有效整合临床文本、肿瘤生物学特征和剂量分布因素，导致泛化能力受限。因此，开发能够进行多模态数据融合的智能放疗辅助系统，对于提高乳腺癌放疗的精准性和效率具有高度临床意义。本研究旨在开发一种基于多模态大语言模型的创新性乳腺癌放疗辅助系统。通过整合多模态影像数据（包括CT、MRI和超声）、病理报告和结构化电子健康记录文本，该系统实现从靶区勾画到治疗计划生成的端到端智能化。研究采用多中心、双向性队列设计，收集接受保乳手术或乳房切除术的乳腺癌患者的综合临床数据。在技术上，该系统创新性地将大语言模型的自然语言处理能力与深度学习的图像分析优势相结合，利用注意力机制实现异构医学数据的深度融合和交互理解。值得注意的是，该系统突破传统放疗计划工作流程，将靶区勾画和剂量计划作为统一流程进行联合优化，应用强化学习算法动态平衡靶区覆盖与危及器官保护。本研究的结果将为AI在放射肿瘤学中的临床应用提供重要范式，并推动精准放疗领域发展。

abstract: The automated segmentation of unstained kidney brightfield microscopy images remains a significant challenge in medical imaging. In conventional histopathology, staining provides crucial structural and molecular contrast, allowing renal compartments and structures to be readily distinguished. The absence of staining markedly reduces this contrast, obscuring the fine architectural details that are essential for diagnosis. Addressing this gap would reduce reliance on staining protocols, reduce technical and interpretive variability, and preserve valuable tissue for downstream molecular or multi-omics analyses. Ultimately, automation of unstained image segmentation could enable faster, more objective tissue analysis while preserving samples for further molecular testing. In this work, we provide a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art segmentation methods applied to renal brightfield microscopy images. Current findings highlight a predominance of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based architectures for semantic segmentation approaches while recent trends point to the growing application of transformer-based and instance-segmentation strategies. However, the field is still hampered by the scarcity and poor annotation of publicly available renal datasets. Aiming to further contribute to the enhancement of the field, a dataset of 18 Whole Slide Images (WSIs) of unstained human kidney tissue is made publicly available. Additionally, in the dataset, we provide 543 annotated tiles extracted from the WSIs, facilitating further research into stain-independent segmentation approaches. As a third contribution, we present a preliminary case study, evaluating state-of-the-art deep learning segmentation architectures, including U-Net and Segment Anything Model (SAM). Our preliminary results indicate that deep learning models demonstrate promising segmentation performance in unstained kidney biopsies. In alignment with these findings, advanced customised loss functions and data augmentation were integrated into the supervised training of the promising U-Net, DeepLabv3+, and TransUNet models, achieving significant improvements compared to the baseline experiments. To exploit the abundance of unlabelled data, we further tested FixMatchSeg, a semi-supervised learning method; however, its segmentation performance remained slightly behind the supervised methods. Taken together, these contributions establish a foundation for future research in stain-independent Computationa
zh_abstract: 无染色肾脏明场显微镜图像的自动分割仍然是医学成像中的重大挑战。在传统组织病理学中，染色提供关键的结构和分子对比度，使肾区室和结构易于区分。缺乏染色显著降低这种对比度，模糊诊断所必需的精细结构细节。解决这一差距将减少对染色方案的依赖，减少技术和解释变异性，并为下游分子或多组学分析保留宝贵组织。最终，无染色图像分割的自动化可以促成更快、更客观的组织分析，同时保留样本用于进一步分子检测。在本工作中，我们全面综述应用于肾脏明场显微镜图像的最先进分割方法。当前发现强调，语义分割方法以卷积神经网络（CNN）架构为主，而近期趋势表明基于 transformer 和实例分割策略的应用日益增多。然而，该领域仍受公开可用肾脏数据集稀缺和标注质量差的阻碍。为进一步促进该领域发展，我们公开提供一个包含 18 张无染色人肾组织全切片图像（WSI）的数据集。此外，在该数据集中，我们提供从 WSI 中提取的 543 个标注图块，促进对不依赖染色的分割方法的进一步研究。作为第三项贡献，我们呈现一个初步案例研究，评估最先进的深度学习分割架构，包括 U-Net 和 Segment Anything Model（SAM）。我们的初步结果表明，深度学习模型在无染色肾活检中展现出有前景的分割性能。与这些发现一致，先进的定制损失函数和数据增强被整合到有前景的 U-Net、DeepLabv3+ 和 TransUNet 模型的监督训练中，与基线实验相比取得显著改善。为利用大量未标注数据，我们进一步测试了半监督学习方法 FixMatchSeg；然而，其分割性能仍略落后于监督方法。综上所述，这些贡献为无染色计算病理学的未来研究奠定了基础。

title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery

abstract: Biomedical research is constrained by the time and domain expertise required to analyze increasingly large and complex datasets. Here we present OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist designed to address this gap by investigating scientist-defined queries and generating verifiable, data-grounded analyses. OpenScientist was evaluated by domain experts across five biomedical case studies, completing analyses in minutes that otherwise would take months of human time and expertise. It accurately quantified Alzheimer’s blood biomarker performance, generated a plasma proteomic survival model that predicted survival in a hidden-evaluation cohort, proposed a reproducible mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, generated multiple myeloma hypotheses validated in an external cohort with attenuated signal in randomized controls, and demonstrated concordance with an independent human analysis in a blinded, prespecified proteomic comparison. These results support the use of OpenScientist to assist biomedical data analysis in concert with human experts. To support research involving sensitive clinical datasets, OpenScientist can operate in a fully air-gapped environment using open-source models for inference. OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by researching the literature, generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and generating insights from complex datasets.
zh_abstract: 生物医学研究受到分析日益庞大和复杂数据集所需时间和领域专业知识的制约。在此，我们介绍 OpenScientist，一种开源智能体式 AI 协同科学家，旨在通过研究科学家定义的查询并生成可验证、以数据为基础的分析来弥合这一差距。OpenScientist 由领域专家在五项生物医学案例研究中进行了评估，可在数分钟内完成原本需要数月人工时间和专业知识才能完成的分析。它准确量化了阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer’s）血液生物标志物的性能，生成了一个血浆蛋白质组学生存模型，该模型在隐藏评估队列中预测了生存，提出了一个将 tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变联系起来、可重复的机制，生成了多发性骨髓瘤假设并在外部队列中得到验证，且在随机对照中信号减弱，并在一项盲法、预先设定的蛋白质组学比较中显示出与独立人工分析的一致性。这些结果支持使用 OpenScientist 与人类专家协同辅助生物医学数据分析。为支持涉及敏感临床数据集的研究，OpenScientist 可在使用开源模型进行推理的完全气隙隔离环境中运行。OpenScientist 表明，开放、可审计的智能体式 AI 可以通过检索文献、生成假设、执行分析并从复杂数据集中生成洞见来支持真实世界临床研究。

title: Dual chain-of-thought AI‑PDCA framework for clinical history taking and documentation
zh_title: 双链式思维 AI-PDCA 框架用于临床问诊与病历书写
summary: npj Digital Medicine 同行评审研究：构建双链式思维大模型支持的 PDCA 教学框架，并比较 AI 评分与教师评分的可靠性。

abstract: Clinical history-taking and documentation are foundational competencies in undergraduate medical training, yet scalable and individualized training tools remain limited. Large language model (LLM)-based systems provide automated practice opportunities but often lack structured medical reasoning, closed-loop instructional design, and integration into formal curricula. As part of a curriculum reform initiative, we constructed a clinical case repository, developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated faculty Plan–Do–Check–Act (PDCA) training framework supported by dual chain-of-thought (CoT)-driven LLMs, and evaluated the reliability of AI-based scoring against faculty assessment. We then conducted a retrospective observational analysis of routinely collected educational performance data from 135 undergraduate medical students enrolled in one of three existing instructional configurations: traditional instruction, AI-assisted training, or AI + PDCA training. Educational outcomes were assessed using standardized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) assessments. The AI + PDCA configuration was associated with the highest OSCE performance in both history-taking and clinical documentation. Among the two AI-supported configurations, longitudinal mixed-effects modeling showed steeper learning trajectories in the AI + PDCA configuration than in the AI-assisted configuration. These findings suggest that integrating AI-derived learning analytics with faculty-guided instructional intervention may support a closed-loop educational model associated with favorable competency acquisition while maintaining human oversight. This framework offers a scalable approach for implementing trustworthy, competency-based AI-enhanced medical education in routine academic practice.
zh_abstract: 临床病史采集和病历记录是本科医学培训中的基础胜任力，但可扩展且个体化的培训工具仍然有限。基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统提供了自动化练习机会，但往往缺乏结构化的医学推理、闭环教学设计以及整合到正式课程中。作为课程改革举措的一部分，我们构建了一个临床病例库，开发了一个整合人工智能（AI）的教师 Plan–Do–Check–Act（PDCA）培训框架，并由双思维链（CoT）驱动的 LLM 支持，同时评估了 AI 评分相对于教师评估的可靠性。随后，我们对 135 名本科医学生常规收集的教育表现数据进行了回顾性观察性分析，这些学生分别接受三种现有教学配置之一：传统教学、AI 辅助培训或 AI + PDCA 培训。教育结局使用标准化客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）评估来评价。AI + PDCA 配置在病史采集和临床病历记录方面均与最高的 OSCE 表现相关。在两种 AI 支持的配置中，纵向混合效应模型显示，AI + PDCA 配置的学习轨迹比 AI 辅助配置更陡峭。这些发现表明，将 AI 衍生的学习分析与教师指导的教学干预相结合，可能支持一种与良好胜任力获得相关的闭环教育模式，同时保持人类监督。该框架为在日常学术实践中实施可信、基于胜任力的 AI 增强医学教育提供了一种可扩展的方法。

title: Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records
zh_title: EHRDiB：以证据为条件的电子病历补全与合成
summary: 预印本提出统一病历补全与合成的扩散桥框架，在MIMIC-IV与Duke Health上对比11种方法并评估效用与泄露风险。
key_points: 统一访视补全与病历合成，区分原始缺失与人为隐藏
8项补全对比中7项与真实数据分类器差距最小

reason: 方法有新意且双数据源对比充分，但为预印本、无临床结局与代码说明，属值得一看档
abstract: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data relative to the best comparator. Synthesis with calibrated thresholding yielded the lowest marginal distribution error across all three datasets, with Coverage above 0.95 for both output rules. Across twelve evidence-fraction intervals in MIMIC-IV synthesis, membership-inference AUROC increased from 0.516 to 0.598 as the mean target evidence fraction rose from 0.20 to 0.50; utility gaps narrowed relative to the lowest evidence configuration but did not decrease monotonically. Our study provides a unified framework and empirical foundation for EHR generation that considers both its utility for clinical analysis and its information disclosure risk.
zh_abstract: 患者信息可以指导电子健康记录（EHR）生成，但其数量如何塑造预测效用和披露风险仍鲜有刻画。在此，我们提出 EHRDiB，它通过区分原始缺失与保留不提供的输入，并将共享多模态表示与证据条件化的潜在扩散桥相结合，统一了就诊完成和合成。我们在 MIMIC-IV 以及数值型和离散化 Duke Health 表示上，将 EHRDiB 与三种补全方法和八种合成方法进行了比较。评估涵盖两项任务的下游预测效用、生成多样性和分布保真度，以及合成任务的披露风险。在八项补全比较中的七项中，EHRDiB 相对于真实数据训练的分类器取得了最小的效用差距。在合成中，相对于最佳比较方法，十个 MIMIC-IV 主要诊断目标的 AUPRC 差距缩小了 45.2%，数值型 Duke Health 数据的 AUPRC 差距缩小了 53.3%。采用校准阈值化的合成在全部三个数据集上产生了最低的边缘分布误差，两种输出规则的 Coverage 均高于 0.95。在 MIMIC-IV 合成的十二个证据比例区间中，随着平均目标证据比例从 0.20 升至 0.50，成员推断 AUROC 从 0.516 增至 0.598；相对于最低证据配置，效用差距缩小，但并未单调下降。我们的研究为 EHR 生成提供了一个统一框架和实证基础，同时考虑其对临床分析的效用及其信息披露风险。

title: BioLT: Streaming Biosignal Modeling
zh_title: BioLT：面向长程生理信号的流式建模框架
summary: 预印本提出流式解码器框架，把窗口级生理信号模型转为可处理数小时长程ECG、PPG、EEG的模型。
key_points: 将任意窗口级特征提取器或基础模型转为流式模型
显式编码窗间时间间隔以建模信号中断
固定大小压缩记忆库使训练与推理保持线性
reason: 方法具新意并针对真实长程信号短板，但为预印本、未见外部验证细节，属值得一看档
abstract: AO_SCPLOWBSTRACTC_SCPLOWClinical biosignals such as ECG, PPG, and EEG are increasingly acquired as hours-long streams from bedside monitors and wearables, yet existing analysis pipelines almost universally operate on isolated short windows of around 10 seconds and cannot process the long, irregular, frequently interrupted signals. We introduce BioLT, a streaming decoder-only framework for long-context biosignal modeling that turns any window-level feature extractor or pretrained biosignal foundation model into a streaming model. BioLT combines (i) a discontinuity-aware encoding that exposes the inter-window elapsed time as an explicit input channel, so that the decoder can learn to model these gaps as clinically meaningful information, and (ii) a fixed-size compressed memory bank supervised with cumulative summary statistics, which keeps both training and inference linear in the recording length while preserving long-range context. We evaluate on CPSC-2021, VitalDB, MC-MED, and CHB-MIT for arrhythmia, sepsis, and seizure detection and for forecasting up to 20 minutes ahead, using domain features and embeddings from six biosignal foundation models. Across 21 dataset-feature settings, BioLT achieves the highest detection AUROC in 15 and the highest 20-minute forecasting AUROC in 13 settings, and shows consistent performance gains over state-of-the-art snapshot foundation-model embeddings. These highlight the importance of modeling how streaming biosignal representations evolve over time, beyond improving window-level representations alone.
zh_abstract: 临床生物信号（如 ECG、PPG 和 EEG）越来越多地以长达数小时的流形式从床旁监护仪和可穿戴设备中采集，但现有分析流程几乎普遍只处理约 10 秒的孤立短窗口，无法处理长时、不规则且频繁中断的信号。我们提出 BioLT，一种用于长上下文生物信号建模的流式仅解码器框架，可将任意窗口级特征提取器或预训练生物信号基础模型转换为流式模型。BioLT 结合了：(i) 不连续性感知编码，将窗口间经过时间作为显式输入通道暴露出来，使解码器能够学习将这些间隔建模为具有临床意义的信息；(ii) 一个固定大小的压缩记忆库，由累积汇总统计量监督，使训练和推理在记录长度上保持线性，同时保留长程上下文。我们在 CPSC-2021、VitalDB、MC-MED 和 CHB-MIT 上评估心律失常、脓毒症和癫痫发作检测以及最长提前 20 分钟的预测，使用领域特征和来自六个生物信号基础模型的嵌入。在 21 个数据集-特征设置中，BioLT 在 15 个设置中取得最高检测 AUROC，在 13 个设置中取得最高 20 分钟预测 AUROC，并相较于最先进的快照基础模型嵌入表现出持续的性能提升。这些结果突显了建模流式生物信号表示如何随时间演变的重要性，而不仅仅是改进窗口级表示。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Coronary Artery Disease: From Detection to Precision Management.
zh_title: 人工智能在冠心病中的应用：从检出到精准管理
summary: 综述梳理AI在冠心病筛查、无创影像、导管室与长期管理各环节的应用进展。

abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Coronary artery disease (CAD) remains the leading cause of death worldwide, yet the landscape is rapidly evolving as artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to its detection, diagnosis, and management. This review surveys the expanding role of AI across the full spectrum of CAD care. In screening, deep-learning electrocardiography and electronic health record-based digital markers enable earlier identification of clinically significant disease. In noninvasive imaging, AI-driven coronary computed tomography angiography automates calcium scoring, derives fractional flow reserve without invasive wires, and quantifies high-risk plaque features that predict incident adverse events. Within the cardiac catheterization laboratory, angiography-derived physiologic assessment and AI-guided intravascular imaging segmentation support real-time procedural decision-making. Beyond diagnosis, machine-learning models integrating multimodality imaging data improve risk stratification over conventional clinical scores, while pharmacogenomic algorithms and wearable-based digital rehabilitation platforms enable patient-centric secondary prevention. Despite this progress, significant challenges persist, including limited evidence from randomized trials, algorithmic bias in underrepresented populations, regulatory uncertainty surrounding software-as-a-medical-device frameworks, and the risk of clinician de-skilling. AI has the potential to act as a collaborative tool that augments-rather than replaces-physician judgment. Future directions include foundation models, multiomics integration, agentic AI workflows, and equity-centered deployment strategies to ensure that AI-driven advances benefit all individuals with CAD.
zh_abstract: [Methodist DeBakey 心血管杂志] 冠状动脉疾病（CAD）仍是全球首要死因，但随着人工智能（AI）越来越多地应用于其检测、诊断和管理，这一格局正在迅速演变。本综述概述了 AI 在 CAD 诊疗全谱系中日益扩大的作用。在筛查方面，深度学习心电图和基于电子健康记录的数字标志物能够更早识别具有临床意义的疾病。在无创影像方面，AI 驱动的冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管造影可自动进行钙化评分、无需侵入性导丝即可推导血流储备分数，并量化可预测新发不良事件的高危斑块特征。在心导管实验室中，血管造影衍生的生理学评估和 AI 引导的血管内影像分割支持实时术中决策。除诊断外，整合多模态影像数据的机器学习模型较传统临床评分改善风险分层，而药物基因组学算法和基于可穿戴设备的数字康复平台使以患者为中心的二级预防成为可能。尽管取得这些进展，重大挑战仍然存在，包括随机试验证据有限、代表性不足人群中的算法偏倚、围绕软件即医疗器械框架的监管不确定性，以及临床医生技能退化的风险。AI 有潜力作为一种协作工具，增强而非取代医生的判断。未来方向包括基础模型、多组学整合、智能体式 AI 工作流以及以公平为中心的部署策略，以确保 AI 驱动的进展惠及所有 CAD 个体。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Korea University Anam Hospital; conditions: AF - Atrial Fibrillation; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1006; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common type of irregular heartbeat in adults. People with AF may also have other heart problems, including reduced heart pumping function or diseases affecting the heart muscle or heart valves. Identifying these problems early is important because the condition of the heart can affect treatment decisions and long-term care. An ultrasound examination of the heart, called transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) or an echocardiogram, is commonly used to check how well the heart pumps blood and to look for structural problems, such as heart valve disease. However, an echocardiogram requires special equipment and trained healthcare professionals to perform and interpret the examination. Because of these requirements, it may not always be available when needed. This can be particularly challenging in situations where heart function needs to be evaluated quickly, such as when a patient with AF has a very fast heart rate. Delays may also occur in outpatient settings because of limited availability of echocardiography. A standard 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) is a simple and widely available test that records the electrical activity of the heart. AI-based computer programs can analyze information contained in an ECG that may not be easily recognized through routine interpretation. This study will use two AI-based ECG programs, called AiTiALVSD and AiTiALVDD. AiTiALVSD analyzes a standard 12-lead ECG to identify patients who may have reduced heart pumping function. Previous studies have evaluated this program in different clinical settings, including patients with AF and a fast heart rate. title: Effect of Data Preprocessing Decisions on Sepsis-3 Labels in MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD: A Sensitivity Analysis
zh_title: 预处理决策对 MIMIC-III 与 eICU 中 Sepsis-3 标签的影响
summary: medRxiv 预印本在固定队列上逐一改变 51 种预处理设置，检验仅预处理差异能否解释文献中脓毒症检出率的巨大跨度。
key_points: 固定队列：MIMIC-III 13,388 例、eICU 94,782 例首住 ICU
在五个预处理域构造 51 种设置变体
比较各设置下的 Sepsis-3 检出率差异
reason: 大样本公开数据库系统性敏感性分析，对脓毒症模型可复现性有价值，但为预印本且内部验证
abstract: Objective: Published Sepsis-3 detection rates range from 3.4 % to 65.2 % in MIMIC-III and from 9.8 % to 47.9 % in eICU-CRD. We tested whether data preprocessing decisions alone produce differences of this magnitude when data, cohort and sepsis definition are held fixed. Materials and Methods: Using the MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD databases we developed and applied a configurable pipeline (medalabel) that stepwise maps the databases into the OMOP Common Data Model, standardizes and cleans the data, and preprocesses them to compute Sepsis-3 labels. Each setting of the preprocessing represents one decision of published Sepsis-3 implementations, and settings can be freely combined. On fixed cohorts of first ICU stays (13,388 in MIMIC-III, 94,782 in eICU-CRD), we changed one setting of a reference configuration at a time (51 variants in five preprocessing domains) and compared detection rates and septic stays (Jaccard index) with the reference. We approximately reconstructed six published pipelines and combined the settings with the largest effects in pairs to test whether their effects add up. The time a value is measured can differ from the time it is documented and thus available for automated analysis. Beyond the usual retrospective view based on measurement time, the pipeline optionally combines both time points to simulate a real-time system. Results: The reference configuration labelled 31.5 % of ICU stays in MIMIC-III and 8.2 % in eICU-CRD as septic. Changing a single setting resulted in sepsis detection rates of 15.3-58.6 % in MIMIC-III and 4.6-17.2 % in eICU-CRD. The largest shifts from the reference, all in the same direction in both databases, came from the SOFA baseline, up to +27.1 percentage points (pp) in MIMIC-III and +9.0 pp in eICU-CRD, from disabling imputation (-16.3 and -2.5 pp), the temporal window (+12.6 and +5.3 pp) and aggregation (-10.1 and -0.8 pp); clinician-validated parameter sets had little effect (-4.8 and -1.1 pp). Even variants that changed the rate by less than 2 pp labelled partly different patients, with Jaccard indices as low as 0.67 in MIMIC-III and 0.56 in eICU-CRD (1 = identical septic stays). Reconstructions deviated from the published rates by 2-10 pp. Two settings applied together deviated from the sum of their single effects by 0.9-11.8 pp in MIMIC-III and by up to 4.9 pp in eICU-CRD. Simulating a real-time system lowered the MIMIC-III rate by 5.0 pp and delayed the label in 45 % of the stays that remained septic. Discus
zh_abstract: 【目的】已发表的Sepsis-3检出率在MIMIC-III中范围为3.4%至65.2%，在eICU-CRD中范围为9.8%至47.9%。我们在数据、队列和脓毒症定义保持不变的情况下，检验了仅数据预处理决策是否会产生如此幅度的差异。【材料与方法】使用MIMIC-III和eICU-CRD数据库，我们开发并应用了一个可配置流程（medalabel），该流程逐步将数据库映射到OMOP Common Data Model，标准化和清理数据，并对其进行预处理以计算Sepsis-3标签。预处理的每个设置代表已发表Sepsis-3实现的一项决策，且设置可自由组合。在固定的首次ICU住院队列中（MIMIC-III中13,388例，eICU-CRD中94,782例），我们每次改变参考配置的一个设置（五个预处理域中的51个变体），并将检出率和脓毒症住院（Jaccard指数）与参考配置进行比较。我们近似重建了六个已发表的流程，并将效应最大的设置成对组合，以检验其效应是否相加。一个数值被测量的时间可能不同于其被记录、从而可用于自动化分析的时间。除了基于测量时间的常规回顾性视图外，该流程还可选择合并这两个时间点，以模拟实时系统。【结果】参考配置将MIMIC-III中31.5%的ICU住院和eICU-CRD中8.2%的ICU住院标记为脓毒症。改变单一设置导致MIMIC-III中脓毒症检出率为15.3-58.6%，eICU-CRD中为4.6-17.2%。相对于参考配置的最大偏移（在两个数据库中方向均相同）来自SOFA基线，在MIMIC-III中高达+27.1个百分点（pp），在eICU-CRD中为+9.0 pp；来自禁用插补（-16.3和-2.5 pp）、时间窗（+12.6和+5.3 pp）和聚合（-10.1和-0.8 pp）；临床医生验证的参数集影响很小（-4.8和-1.1 pp）。即使是将检出率改变不足2 pp的变体，也标记了部分不同的患者，MIMIC-III中Jaccard指数低至0.67，eICU-CRD中低至0.56（1 = 完全相同的脓毒症住院）。重建结果与已发表检出率相差2-10 pp。两个设置共同应用时，其偏离各自单一效应之和的程度在MIMIC-III中为0.9-11.8 pp，在eICU-CRD中高达4.9 pp。模拟实时系统使MIMIC-III的检出率降低5.0 pp，并使45%的仍为脓毒症的住院标签延迟。Discus

title: Future-Information Leakage in 30-Day Readmission Prediction: An Empirical Audit and a Calibrated Electronic Health Record Model in Medicare-Insured Adults
zh_title: 30天再入院预测的未来信息泄漏审计
summary: 基于MIMIC-IV约23.7万次住院，审计出院时点可得性并量化未来信息泄漏对性能与结论的扭曲。
key_points: 研究236,906次Medicare保险住院，患病率21.4%
历史特征按原始时间戳重算，剔除全病程特征
仅内部验证，采用XGBoost与患者分组交叉验证
reason: 大样本方法学审计有借鉴价值，但为预印本且仅内部验证
abstract: Objective: To develop and internally validate a calibrated discharge model of 30-day within-system readmission in Medicare-insured adults, and to quantify how a future-information leak and outcome artifacts distorted performance, timing, and subgroup conclusions. Materials and Methods: Retrospective study of 236,906 Medicare-insured MIMIC-IV v3.1 admissions (87,750 patients; prevalence 21.4%). Predictors were audited for discharge-time availability; history features were tested for future information and recomputed from raw timestamps. A consensus gradient-boosted (XGBoost) model was selected inside patient-grouped folds; CIs used patient-cluster bootstrap. Results: A feature documented as a prior 180-day length-of-stay trend used each patient's whole record, including later admissions; removing it and two derived terms lowered test area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from 0.774 to 0.706. The corrected procedure reached an out-of-fold AUROC of 0.7057 (95% CI 0.7016 to 0.7102; primary); the 44-feature model scored 0.7056 on the historically exposed test partition (calibration slope 0.99), above reconstructed LACE and HOSPITAL (both P<.001). A day-1 discrimination peak largely reflected 2,368 probable administrative continuations within 1 hour of discharge; merging these into the preceding stay gave test AUROC 0.698 (0.702 after refitting). The White minus Black AUROC difference was 0.003 (95% CI -0.018 to 0.024); specificity was lower for Black patients (0.61 vs 0.69). Discussion: Documentation audits and patient-grouped validation missed a leak that inflated discrimination and created spurious subgroup and calendar-period differences; simple empirical checks found it. Conclusion: Empirical leakage checks should accompany availability audits. The corrected model is calibrated, moderately discriminating, and needs external validation before clinical use.
zh_abstract:
【目的】开发并在内部验证一个校准的30天系统内再入院出院模型，用于参加 Medicare 保险的成人，并量化未来信息泄漏和结局伪差如何扭曲性能、时间及亚组结论。
【材料与方法】对236,906条 MIMIC-IV v3.1 中参加 Medicare 保险的住院记录（87,750名患者；患病率21.4%）进行回顾性研究。对预测变量进行出院时可用性审计；对病史特征检验未来信息，并从原始时间戳重新计算。在按患者分组的折内选择共识梯度提升（XGBoost）模型；置信区间使用患者簇自助法。
【结果】一个被记录为先前的180天住院时长趋势的特征使用了每位患者的整个记录，包括后续住院；移除该特征和两个派生项后，测试集受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）从0.774降至0.706。校正后的流程达到折外 AUROC 0.7057（95% CI 0.7016至0.7102；主要结果）；44特征模型在历史暴露的测试分区上得分为0.7056（校准斜率0.99），高于重建的 LACE 和 HOSPITAL（均 P<.001）。第1天区分度峰值在很大程度上反映了出院1小时内2,368例可能的行政性连续住院；将这些合并到前一次住院后，测试 AUROC 为0.698（重新拟合后为0.702）。白人减黑人的 AUROC 差异为0.003（95% CI -0.018至0.024）；黑人患者的特异度较低（0.61 对 0.69）。
【讨论】记录审计和按患者分组验证漏掉了一个泄漏，该泄漏抬高了区分度并产生了虚假的亚组和日历时期差异；简单的经验性检查发现了它。
【结论】经验性泄漏检查应与可用性审计同时进行。校正后的模型已校准、具有中等区分度，在临床使用前需要外部验证。

title: Implementing Artificial Intelligence in Daily Clinical Practice, from Voice Dictation to Operating Room Organization: A Targeted Narrative Review with Hysteroscopy as a Clinical Exemplar.
zh_title: AI进入日常临床实践：以宫腔镜为例的叙述性综述
summary: （据摘要）叙述性综述梳理从语音听写、环境记录到手术室调度等AI落地环节，以宫腔镜为例区分图像级与患者级证据。
key_points: 覆盖语音记录、决策支持与手术室运营
以宫腔镜为从技术性能到临床效用范例

reason: 同行评审叙述性综述，关注落地与证据分级；综述类封顶6分，故取5
abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering routine care through documentation tools, decision support, and hospital operations. The central question is whether these systems improve clinical work and patient care once embedded in routine workflows, not only whether they perform well on test data. This targeted narrative review follows AI from voice dictation and ambient documentation to operating room (OR) organization, using hysteroscopy as a clinical exemplar of the transition from technical performance to clinical utility. Evidence identified through targeted searches completed on 6 September 2026 was appraised with a framework that distinguishes image-level from patient-level results, internal from independent validation, and discrimination from clinical utility. Randomized trials and multisite observational data show modest, product-dependent benefits of clinician-reviewed ambient documentation; inaccuracies persist. Evidence for patient-message drafting derives from ratings of responses to public-forum questions and supports only bounded, supervised feasibility testing. In hysteroscopy, selected models discriminate well in narrowly defined tasks, but most studies are retrospective, image-level, or internally validated, and patient-level errors in high-risk categories are seldom reported. Reported gains in OR scheduling come largely from simulation. Safe implementation requires a defined clinical need, baseline measurement, subgroup-aware local validation, accountable review, and predefined criteria for expansion or withdrawal.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 人工智能（AI）正通过文档工具、决策支持和医院运营进入常规诊疗。核心问题在于这些系统在嵌入常规工作流程后是否能改善临床工作和患者照护，而不仅仅是它们在测试数据上表现良好。本针对性叙述性综述追踪AI从语音听写和环境文档到手术室（OR）组织的应用，并以宫腔镜作为从技术性能向临床效用转变的临床范例。通过截至2026年9月6日完成的针对性检索所识别的证据，采用一个区分图像层面与患者层面结果、内部验证与独立验证、区分能力与临床效用的框架进行评价。随机试验和多中心观察数据显示，由临床医生审核的环境文档具有适度且因产品而异的获益；不准确之处仍然存在。患者信息起草的证据来源于对公共论坛问题回答的评分，仅支持有范围限制的、受监督的可行性测试。在宫腔镜中，选定模型在狭义定义任务中区分能力良好，但大多数研究为回顾性、图像层面或内部验证，且高风险类别中的患者层面错误很少被报告。所报告的手术室排程改善主要来自模拟。安全实施需要有明确的临床需求、基线测量、考虑亚组的本地验证、可问责的审核，以及预先设定的扩展或退出标准。

zh_title: AI在颅缝早闭手术规划中的应用：范围综述
summary: 范围综述纳入11项儿科颅缝早闭研究，梳理AI在严重度评分、表型分类、术前模拟与预后预测中的应用。
key_points: 纳入11项研究，方法含无监督学习、CNN、有限元模型、VAE

abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] Craniosynostosis, the premature fusion of cranial sutures, can cause abnormal skull shapes, neurological issues and aesthetic concerns. Surgical correction is standard, but planning is complex and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers the potential to enhance diagnosis, optimise planning and predict postoperative outcomes. A scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidelines identified 11 studies involving paediatric patients with craniosynostosis. AI methods included unsupervised machine learning, convolutional neural networks, finite element models and variational autoencoders. Applications encompassed cranial severity scoring, phenotype classification, preoperative surgical simulation, intraoperative guidance and outcome prediction. AI-derived metrics correlated strongly with expert assessments, facilitated patient-specific planning and predicted postoperative aesthetics. AI is a transformative adjunct in craniosynostosis surgery. Clinically, it improves diagnostic accuracy, supports personalised surgical planning and guides intraoperative decision-making. Some studies show AI can contribute to better functional and aesthetic outcomes, showing great promise in the paediatric surgical field. Although AI does not replace clinical expertise, it enhances precision and reproducibility. Future research should prioritise prospective validation, integration into surgical workflows and development of interpretable, surgeon-friendly AI tools to maximise clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] 颅缝早闭是指颅缝过早融合，可导致颅骨形状异常、神经学问题和美学顾虑。手术矫正是标准治疗，但规划复杂且依赖操作者。人工智能（AI）有望增强诊断、优化规划并预测术后结局。一项遵循PRISMA-ScR指南的范围综述识别出11项涉及颅缝早闭儿科患者的研究。AI方法包括无监督机器学习、卷积神经网络、有限元模型和变分自编码器。应用涵盖颅骨严重程度评分、表型分类、术前手术模拟、术中引导和结局预测。AI得出的指标与专家评估高度相关，促进了患者特异性规划，并预测了术后美学。AI是颅缝早闭手术中的变革性辅助手段。在临床上，它提高诊断准确性、支持个性化手术规划并指导术中决策。一些研究显示AI可有助于改善功能和美学结局，在儿科外科领域展现出巨大前景。尽管AI不能替代临床专业知识，但它增强了精确性和可重复性。未来研究应优先开展前瞻性验证、整合到手术工作流程中，并开发可解释、外科医生友好的AI工具，以最大化临床获益。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: KNCV Tuberculosis Foundation; conditions: Tuberculosis Infection, Latent, Tuberculosis Prevention; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 1804; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] The Artificial Intelligence Assisted Innovative Low-cost Skin Testing Model to Accelerate Person-centered TB Prevention Services in Tanzania, Mozambique and Uganda (TEST4TPT) project will evaluate a person-centered approach to improve access to tuberculosis infection (TBI) testing and linkage to tuberculosis preventive treatment (TPT) in Mozambique, Tanzania, and Uganda. The project will generate evidence on the feasibility, acceptability, clinical utility, diagnostic and operational performance, and implementation of a novel point-of-care TBI testing approach, including home- or community-based testing and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted reading. By bringing testing closer to people at increased risk of tuberculosis (TB), TEST4TPT aims to reduce barriers to care, support timely TPT initiation, and contribute to improved completion of preventive treatment. The overall goal of TEST4TPT is to evaluate an integrated, home-based approach to TBI testing using SIILTIBCY (an authorized diagnostic skin test used to detect TBI), community health worker (CHW)-facilitated support, and AI-assisted result reading, with the aim of improving initiation and completion of TPT among close contacts of people newly diagnosed with pulmonary TB disease.

title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Stroke Registry Research: Current Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions.

abstract: [Journal of neuroendovascular therapy] Registry-based studies provide real-world evidence that can support clinical decision-making, improve the quality of care, and advance understanding of disease. However, conducting registry-based studies requires substantial time and effort throughout the research workflow, including identifying clinical questions and gaps in existing knowledge, planning studies, developing protocols, collecting and analyzing data, and preparing manuscripts. This narrative review examines the challenges encountered in registry-based studies and discusses how artificial intelligence (AI) may help address them, based on evidence from the broader biomedical literature, with particular reference to our work involving the Japan Stroke Data Bank. AI, particularly large language models, which have advanced rapidly in recent years, has the potential to support literature searches, research question generation, and protocol development, although inaccurate outputs and fabricated references remain important concerns. Natural language processing may facilitate the extraction of structured information from electronic health records and reduce the burden of manual data collection. Machine learning approaches can identify complex relationships in large, high-dimensional datasets and may improve prediction, while large language models may assist with the selection of statistical methods, the generation of analytical code, and the interpretation of results. AI may also support manuscript preparation through language editing, drafting, and the creation of tables and figures. In the future, AI may make it technically feasible to automate much of the registry research workflow. Nevertheless, human oversight remains essential to verify accuracy, protect confidential information, and ensure transparency and accountability for research decisions and outputs. AI is reshaping traditional research processes and may facilitate the generation of novel research findings. However, AI should augment rather than replace the scientific and clinical judgment of researchers.
zh_abstract: [Journal of neuroendovascular therapy] 基于登记的研究提供真实世界证据，可支持临床决策、改善医疗质量并增进对疾病的理解。然而，开展基于登记的研究在整个研究流程中需要大量时间和精力，包括识别临床问题与现有知识空白、规划研究、制定方案、收集和分析数据以及准备稿件。本叙述性综述考察基于登记的研究中遇到的挑战，并基于更广泛生物医学文献中的证据讨论人工智能（AI）如何帮助应对这些挑战，特别参考我们涉及日本卒中数据库（Japan Stroke Data Bank）的工作。AI，尤其是近年来快速发展的大语言模型，有潜力支持文献检索、研究问题生成和方案制定，但不准确的输出和捏造的参考文献仍是重要关切。自然语言处理可能促进从电子健康记录中提取结构化信息，并减轻人工数据收集负担。机器学习方法可以识别大型高维数据集中的复杂关系，并可能改善预测，而大语言模型可能协助选择统计方法、生成分析代码和解释结果。AI还可能通过语言编辑、起草以及创建表格和图形来支持稿件准备。未来，AI可能使将大部分登记研究流程自动化在技术上可行。尽管如此，人工监督仍至关重要，以核实准确性、保护机密信息，并确保研究决策和输出的透明性与问责性。AI正在重塑传统研究流程，并可能促进新研究发现的形成。然而，AI应增强而非取代研究者的科学和临床判断。

abstract: Background Laboratory medicine underpins clinical decision-making across nearly every care setting. Clinical laboratory errors and delays can compromise diagnostic reliability and patient care. However, laboratory quality and operational data are commonly reviewed through separate manual workflows, limiting timely recognition of emerging problems across complementary data sources. Methods We developed and evaluated LabARIA (Laboratory Agentic Reasoning and Integrative Analytics), a multi-agent AI system for coordinated surveillance of specimen workflows, analytical quality control, and laboratory operations. We conducted a single-center retrospective system development and evaluation at NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital/Weill Cornell Medical Center using laboratory data collected from May 1 through June 18, 2026, including 177,480 specimen-panel records, 75,103 internal quality-control (IQC) measurements, 633 proficiency-testing challenges, and 422 recalibration or maintenance actions. Forecasting agents were evaluated using patient-result streams with controlled perturbations, and synthetic staffing and inventory data. We assessed specimen rejection, cancellation, and turnaround-time patterns; warning recall and lead time before documented laboratory actions; assay-specific patient-based real-time quality control (PBRTQC) performance; and exploratory operational forecasting discrimination. Findings LabARIA characterized specimen and workflow patterns across clinical units and time periods, including hemolysis-related potassium rejections in the intensive care unit during early morning hours (49 of 367 tests [13.3%]). For analytical quality monitoring, the IQC agent generated warnings before 407 of 422 recorded QC actions (recall, 0.964 [95% CI, 0.942-0.978]), with a median lead time of 5.40 days (95% CI, 3.75-6.07). PBRTQC agent selected different monitoring strategies across 35 analytes. In a separate analysis, adding PBRTQC increased action recall from 0.964 to 0.993 (95% CI, 0.979-0.998). A dashboard presented tiered alerts for human review, and an accompanying chatbot supported interactive exploration of the summaries. For the operational forecasting module, areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve for 7-day inventory and staffing risk forecasting were 0.800 (95% CI, 0.696-0.881) and 0.877 (95% CI, 0.778-0.950), respectively. zh_abstract: 【背景】检验医学支撑着几乎所有照护场景中的临床决策。临床实验室差错和延迟可能损害诊断可靠性和患者照护。然而，实验室质量和运营数据通常通过彼此分离的人工工作流程进行审查，限制了对互补数据来源中新出现问题的及时识别。【方法】我们开发并评估了LabARIA（Laboratory Agentic Reasoning and Integrative Analytics），这是一个多智能体AI系统，用于协调监测标本工作流程、分析质量控制和实验室运营。我们在NewYork-Presbyterian Hospital/Weill Cornell Medical Center开展了一项单中心回顾性系统开发与评估，使用2026年5月1日至6月18日收集的实验室数据，包括177,480条标本检测组合记录、75,103次内部质量控制（IQC）测量、633项能力验证挑战以及422次重新校准或维护操作。预测智能体使用带有受控扰动的患者结果流以及合成人员配置和库存数据进行评估。我们评估了标本拒收、取消和周转时间模式；在有记录的实验室操作之前，警告的召回率和提前时间；检测项目特异的基于患者的实时质量控制（PBRTQC）性能；以及探索性运营预测区分度。【结果】LabARIA刻画了跨临床单元和时间段的标本与工作流程模式，包括清晨时段重症监护病房中溶血相关钾检测拒收（367次检测中的49次[13.3%]）。对于分析质量监测，IQC智能体在422次有记录的质量控制操作中的407次之前生成警告（召回率0.964 [95% CI, 0.942-0.978]），中位提前时间为5.40天（95% CI, 3.75-6.07）。PBRTQC智能体在35种分析物中选择了不同的监测策略。在一项单独分析中，加入PBRTQC使操作召回率从0.964提高到0.993（95% CI, 0.979-0.998）。一个仪表板呈现分级警报供人工审查，配套聊天机器人支持对摘要的交互式探索。对于运营预测模块，7天库存和人员配置风险预测的受试者工作特征曲线下面积分别为0.800（95% CI, 0.696-0.881）和0.877（95% CI, 0.778-0.950）。【解读】LabARIA证明了跨异质……协调实验室质量监测的可行性。

title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
zh_title: 因果约束与不确定性感知的心肺风险预测
summary: 预印本提出CE-Agent两阶段框架，将流行病学证据转为权重约束，结合胸部CT表型做心肺风险预测。

abstract: Routine chest computed tomography (CT) captures pulmonary, cardiac, and vascular phenotypes that jointly stratify lung cancer and cardiovascular disease, the two leading causes of death in lung-screening populations. Yet clinical risk calculators evaluate each disease in isolation and omit CT findings, whereas unconstrained machine learning overfits small hospital cohorts, learns treatment- and illness-confounded risk directions, and conceals uncertainty when patient records are incomplete. Here we present the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage framework that compiles peer-reviewed epidemiological evidence into explicit constraints on risk-factor weights before any outcome is seen, while estimating local baseline risk and newly added CT phenotypes from cohort data. At deployment, closed-form uncertainty propagation accounts for missing clinical or CT inputs within milliseconds per patient, running over two orders of magnitude faster than Monte Carlo sampling and returning calibrated risk intervals that direct chart review and selective imaging to borderline patients. Across 53,452 lung-screening participants from 33 US hospitals and 6,814 multi-ethnic adults, CE-Agent outperforms cardiovascular calculators in lung screening, exceeds the Pooled Cohort Equations on hard atherosclerotic events while correcting their 1.7-fold risk overestimation, and generalizes from a single hospital or CT scanner to external sites while lowering required sample sizes up to fivefold. Applied unchanged to lung cancer, CE-Agent matches established screening models with accurate calibration even when restricted to risk-factor directions alone, and pairing both predictions improves joint cardiopulmonary triage from a single screening visit.
zh_abstract: 常规胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）可捕获肺部、心脏和血管表型，这些表型共同对肺癌和心血管疾病进行分层，而这两者是肺部筛查人群中的两大主要死因。然而，临床风险计算器孤立评估每种疾病并遗漏CT发现，而无约束的机器学习会过拟合小型医院队列、学习受到治疗和疾病混杂的风险方向，并在患者记录不完整时隐藏不确定性。在此，我们提出Causal Envelope Agent（CE-Agent），这是一个两阶段框架，在观察到任何结局之前，将经同行评议的流行病学证据编译为对风险因素权重的显式约束，同时从队列数据估计本地基线风险和新加入的CT表型。在部署时，闭式不确定性传播可在每名患者数毫秒内考虑缺失的临床或CT输入，运行速度比蒙特卡洛采样快两个数量级以上，并返回校准风险区间，将病历审查和选择性影像检查导向临界患者。在来自33家美国医院的53,452名肺部筛查参与者和6,814名多种族成人中，CE-Agent在肺部筛查中优于心血管计算器，在硬性动脉粥样硬化事件上超过汇总队列方程（Pooled Cohort Equations），同时纠正其1.7倍的风险高估，并从单一医院或CT扫描仪推广到外部站点，同时将所需样本量降低最多五倍。原样应用于肺癌时，CE-Agent即使仅限制于风险因素方向，也能以准确校准匹配既有筛查模型；将两种预测配对可改善单次筛查就诊中的心肺联合分诊。

title: Network scaling in swarm learning across real hospitals of different sizes: a KPI-driven analysis on the eICU Collaborative Research Database

abstract: BackgroundDistributed learning lets hospitals train prediction models jointly without exchanging patient records, but how the benefits of a swarm network change as it grows, and which hospitals gain most, have so far been studied with artificial partitions of single-center databases. We examined network scaling on real hospitals that differ in size, volume and sepsis prevalence. MethodsWe applied the seven-KPI swarm-learning evaluation framework (Swarm Gain, Local Gain, Relative Local Gain, Model Stability Index, Jains index, Data Utility Index and label entropy) to progressive network scaling on the eICU Collaborative Research Database. From 25 hospitals (71,887 ICU stays; sepsis prevalence 16.6%), six hospitals stratified by bed size (two small, two medium, two large; 14,776 stays) formed networks of two, four and six hospitals in all six category-joining orders; four further hospitals served as substitutes in robustness checks. Swarm learning was simulated with the client-controlled workflow of NVIDIA FLARE (federated averaging, 30 rounds, five random seeds). The task was whole-stay sepsis classification from discretized vital-sign, laboratory and medication features with a 1,313-parameter feedforward network, with AUROC as the metric. ResultsNetwork AUROC increased with every addition in every ordering, from 0.734 (small-first), 0.755 (medium-first) and 0.781 (large-first) at two hospitals to 0.804 (SD 0.002) at six. Swarm Gain exceeded 1 at all nine unique transitions (mean 1.042 for 2[->] 4 and 1.020 for 4[->] 6 hospitals). Every hospital had Local Gain below 1; relative improvement over local training ranged from 4.1% for the strongest hospital (local AUROC 0.773) to 29.5% for the weakest (0.621), averaging 25.5% for small and 5.9% for large hospitals. Adding large hospitals gave existing members the largest gain (mean Relative Local Gain +6.2%); adding small hospitals never reduced it. Seed-to-seed variability fell from a coefficient of variation of 2.2% at two hospitals to 0.2% at six. Feature distributions were near-identical across hospitals (Data Utility Index 0.005-0.013), whereas the change in label entropy tracked Swarm Gain (r = 0.74). Substituting alternative medium or large hospitals left network AUROC between 0.790 and 0.805. ConclusionsOn real multi-hospital data, swarm participation improved every hospitals model, most for hospitals with the weakest local models, with no transition in which an addition harmed the network. title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
zh_title: 从AI远程监护到具身智能体机器人：范围综述
summary: 范围综述梳理AI远程患者监护向智能体化与机器人具身演进，指出成熟智能体照护尚未出现。
key_points: 多数系统仍由人主导，决策-行动闭环多停留在原型
医疗机器人把AI建议转为语音、动作与升级处置
具身性、临床整合、人类监督与治理为设计前提
reason: 范围综述无新数据，结论为领域尚未成熟，综述档上限内取低
abstract: AI-enabled remote patient monitoring is evolving beyond passive data collection toward agentic AI systems that interpret patient states, coordinate care, and initiate action across domestic and clinical settings. This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged: Most systems remain human led, while stronger decision-action coupling and embodied AI remain largely confined to prototypes and pilots. Healthcare robotics makes the transition from monitoring to action especially visible by translating AI-generated recommendations and decisions into speech, movement, prompting, physical assistance, escalation, and care coordination, making embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance fundamental design requirements. Further progress requires safe and interoperable care architectures in which intelligent components operate through clinically validated and accountable workflows. We propose agentic robotics as a future direction for supervised systems embedded in the care ecosystem, connecting AI agents and robots with clinicians, caregivers, and patients through auditable workflows that can be interrupted and remain subject to human oversight and explicit AI governance.
zh_abstract: AI赋能的远程患者监测正在超越被动数据收集，向能够解读患者状态、协调照护并在家庭和临床环境中启动行动的代理式AI系统演进。这项结构化范围综述发现，成熟的代理式照护尚未出现：大多数系统仍由人类主导，而更强的决策-行动耦合和具身AI在很大程度上仍局限于原型和试点。医疗保健机器人通过将AI生成的建议和决策转化为语音、运动、提示、身体辅助、升级处置和照护协调，使从监测到行动的转变尤其明显，从而使具身性、临床整合、人类监督和治理成为基本设计要求。进一步进展需要安全且可互操作的照护架构，在其中智能组件通过经临床验证且可问责的工作流程运行。我们提出代理式机器人技术作为未来方向，用于嵌入照护生态系统的受监督系统，通过可审计、可中断且仍受人类监督和明确AI治理约束的工作流程，将AI代理和机器人与临床医生、照护者和患者连接起来。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Alexandria University; conditions: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Type 2 diabetes needs daily self-management, but most of it happens outside the clinic, where patients get little continuous support. Earlier studies of mobile applications and chatbots were mostly short, and few tested whether benefits last after use stops. This randomized controlled trial will test an Arabic-language mobile application with an artificial intelligence chatbot for adults with type 2 diabetes attending outpatient diabetes clinics in Egypt. The application offers diabetes education, reminders, glucose and activity logging, goal setting, prompts that adapt when use declines, a diabetes distress check, and nurse oversight. A total of 120 adults will be randomly assigned equally to usual care plus the application for 8 weeks, or to usual care with an educational leaflet. Outcome assessors will not know group assignment. The main outcome is self-efficacy. Other outcomes are self-care behaviors, medication adherence, disease knowledge, random blood glucose, diabetes distress, and application use, measured at the start, at 8 weeks, and 6 and 12 weeks after the intervention ends. About 20 intervention participants will then be interviewed about their experiences and what helps or hinders continued use, and these findings will be combined with the trial results.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Alexandria University；疾病：2型糖尿病；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：120；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 2型糖尿病需要每日自我管理，但其中大部分发生在诊所之外，患者获得的持续支持很少。先前关于移动应用程序和聊天机器人的研究大多较短，且很少检验停止使用后获益是否持续。这项随机对照试验将测试一款带有AI聊天机器人的阿拉伯语移动应用程序，对象是在埃及糖尿病门诊就诊的2型糖尿病成人。该应用程序提供糖尿病教育、提醒、血糖和活动记录、目标设定、在使用下降时调整的提示、糖尿病痛苦检查以及护士监督。总共120名成人将被随机等额分配到常规照护加该应用程序8周，或常规照护加教育传单。结局评估者将不知道分组。主要结局是自我效能。其他结局是自我照护行为、用药依从性、疾病知识、随机血糖、糖尿病痛苦和应用程序使用情况，在开始时、第8周以及干预结束后第6周和第12周测量。随后将访谈约20名干预组参与者，了解其体验以及哪些因素帮助或阻碍持续使用，这些发现将与试验结果结合。

title: A thorough review on Deep Learning approaches to 2D-to-3D Registration in Medical Imaging
zh_title: 医学影像二维到三维配准的深度学习综述
summary: arXiv 预印本综述系统梳理深度学习用于 2D-to-3D 医学影像配准的流程设计、架构创新与域适应策略。
key_points: 面向术中导航等场景的 2D-3D 配准问题

reason: 预印本综述，无新实验或数据，仅方法梳理，属增量档
abstract: 2D-to-3D image registration is a key component for several medical imaging purposes such as intraoperative guidance, enabling the alignment between preoperative 3D volumes and real-time 2D images. While conventional optimisation-based methods often struggle with non-convex objectives, sensitivity to initialisation, and high computational demands, deep learning (DL) has emerged as a promising alternative, offering improved alignment robustness and the potential for real-time performance. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of DL frameworks developed to address the challenges inherent in 2D-to-3D registration. We first outline how core concepts of DL are adapted to the registration problem. We then examine recent methodological advancements from multiple perspectives, including pipeline design, architectural innovations, and domain adaptation strategies. Particular attention is given to quantitative metrics, highlighting how performance is defined and measured across studies. Across the 41 included studies, we find that direct regression is the most common pipeline (23 studies, against 18 iterative ones), that hybrid CNN-attention architectures are gaining ground, and that research remains heavily concentrated on X-ray-to-CT registration. We conclude by identifying the absence of per-case uncertainty estimation and the strong neglect of temporal or sequential modelling as the two methodological gaps most consequential for clinical readiness, and discuss state-space models as a way to add temporal memory within intraoperative latency budgets. Further opportunities lie in more principled domain adaptation and in the integration of foundation models for representation learning.
zh_abstract: 2D到3D图像配准是若干医学成像用途（如术中引导）的关键组成部分，可实现术前3D体数据与实时2D图像之间的对齐。虽然传统的基于优化的方法常常难以应对非凸目标、对初始化敏感以及高计算需求，但深度学习（DL）已成为一种有前景的替代方案，提供更好的对齐稳健性和实时性能潜力。本综述对为应对2D到3D配准固有挑战而开发的DL框架进行了全面分析。我们首先概述DL的核心概念如何适配配准问题。随后，我们从多个视角考察近期方法学进展，包括流程设计、架构创新和域适应策略。特别关注定量指标，强调各研究如何定义和测量性能。在纳入的41项研究中，我们发现直接回归是最常见的流程（23项研究，对比18项迭代方法），混合CNN-注意力架构正在获得更多应用，且研究仍高度集中于X射线到CT配准。我们最后指出，缺乏逐病例不确定性估计以及对时间或序列建模的严重忽视，是对临床就绪度影响最大的两个方法学缺口，并讨论状态空间模型作为一种在术中延迟预算内加入时间记忆的方法。进一步的机会在于更原则化的域适应，以及整合基础模型进行表示学习。

summary: 预印本提出按六类风险语言与严重度评分、由三模型评审团判定的患者端医疗问答评测框架，并比较六个7–9B模型。
abstract: Patient-facing medical question answering with large language models (LLMs) is moving from research demonstrations to production deployments, yet evaluation remains anchored on factual correctness. Factuality is necessary but not sufficient: a response can be factually grounded and still issue a directive that, if acted on, would harm the patient. We introduce a risk-sensitive evaluation framework that scores responses by the presence and severity of six categories of risk-bearing language (treatment directives, contraindications, dosage expressions, urgency-triage cues, high-alert medication mentions, and overconfident assertions), anchored on published clinical harm taxonomies. Severity is classified by a three-judge LLM ensemble. summary: （据注册信息）土耳其马尔马拉大学注册观察性研究，拟用口内照片与三维扫描构建儿童龋齿、牙菌斑检测及风险预测AI系统。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Marmara University; conditions: Dental Caries, Caries Risk, Dental Plaque; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 250; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to develop and evaluate an artificial intelligence (AI)-based system that can detect dental caries and dental plaque in children using intraoral digital scans and photographs, and use these findings to estimate each child's risk of developing dental caries. Children aged 4-13 years who attend Marmara University Faculty of Dentistry, Department of Pediatric Dentistry for routine dental care will be invited to participate. Participants will receive a clinical dental examination. Dental caries will be evaluated using standard clinical criteria, and dental plaque will be assessed using a plaque index. Intraoral photographs and three-dimensional digital scans of the teeth will also be obtained. Parents will complete a questionnaire about their child's toothbrushing habits, sugar consumption, fluoride use, dental visits, and selected sociodemographic factors. The collected digital images and scans will be used to train and test an AI model designed to automatically identify and measure areas of dental caries and plaque. The AI findings will then be combined with clinical examination results and oral health-related information to classify children as having low, moderate, or high caries risk. Based on the assigned caries risk level, individualized preventive recommendations such as oral hygiene instruction, dietary counseling, fluoride applications, professional plaque control, and follow-up visits will be provided. Participants will be followed according to their risk level and digital scans and clinical assessments will be repeated to evaluate changes in caries, plaque, and caries risk over time. The study is expected to provide information on whether AI-assisted digital imaging can support more objective, standardized and personalized caries risk assessment and preventive dental care in children.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：Marmara University；疾病/状况：龋齿、龋齿风险、牙菌斑；类型：观察性研究；入组人数：250；状态：尚未招募] 本研究旨在开发并评估一种基于人工智能（AI）的系统，该系统可利用口内数字扫描和照片检测儿童龋齿和牙菌斑，并利用这些发现估计每名儿童发生龋齿的风险。将邀请在Marmara University牙学院儿童牙科系接受常规牙科诊疗的4-13岁儿童参与。参与者将接受临床牙科检查。龋齿将使用标准临床标准进行评估，牙菌斑将使用菌斑指数进行评估。还将获取口内照片和牙齿三维数字扫描。家长将填写一份关于其子女刷牙习惯、糖摄入、氟化物使用、牙科就诊以及选定社会人口学因素的问卷。所收集的数字图像和扫描将用于训练和测试一个AI模型，该模型旨在自动识别和测量龋齿和牙菌斑区域。随后，AI发现将与临床检查结果和口腔健康相关信息相结合，将儿童分类为低、中或高龋齿风险。根据所分配的龋齿风险水平，将提供个体化预防建议，如口腔卫生指导、饮食咨询、氟化物应用、专业菌斑控制和随访就诊。参与者将根据其风险水平接受随访，并将重复数字扫描和临床评估，以评价龋齿、牙菌斑和龋齿风险随时间的变化。该研究预期将提供信息，说明AI辅助数字成像是否能够支持儿童更客观、标准化和个体化的龋齿风险评估及预防性牙科照护。

title: Measurement fidelity and external validation of automated breast DCE-MRI segmentation
zh_title: 乳腺DCE-MRI自动分割的测量保真度与外部验证
summary: 构建增强感知3D MedNeXt分割框架，以测量保真度为主要终点开展多队列与外部验证。
key_points: 内部测试与DUKE共521例配对病例
肿瘤体积中位误差9.7%，ICC 0.97
外部源留出分层Dice中位0.823
reason: 多队列外部验证并以测量保真度为主要终点，属重要档
abstract: Automated breast dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) segmentation could facilitate quantitative tumor measurement, but geometric overlap alone does not establish the fidelity of mask-derived measurements. We developed an enhancement-aware three-dimensional MedNeXt framework with gated skip fusion and boundary supervision and evaluated it in a retrospective multi-cohort design spanning locked internal testing, source-held-out assessment, retrospective external validation, and radiologist review. Measurement fidelity was the primary endpoint. Across 521 paired internal-test and DUKE cases, median errors were 9.7% for tumor volume, 1.8 mm for 3D maximum surface diameter, and 10.2% for operational enhancement-defined volume, with corresponding ICCs of 0.97, 0.80, and 0.97. Median Dice was 0.831 internally and 0.823 in the DUKE source-held-out stratum, and was 0.812 and 0.806 in the BC-MRI-SEG and public BreastDCEDL_AMBL retrospective external-validation cohorts, respectively, using the frozen checkpoint without external-label tuning. No major correction was required for 78 of 80 masks in the blinded two-reader review. In 276 paired response-analysis cases, AUROC was 0.732 with automatic geometry and 0.757 with expert geometry (difference, −0.025; 95% CI, −0.095 to 0.045); discrimination non-inferiority was not demonstrated. These findings support automated segmentation as a starting point for radiologist-supervised retrospective quantitative research within the evaluated cohorts, while distinguishing measurement fidelity from downstream predictive equivalence.
zh_abstract: 自动乳腺动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）分割可促进肿瘤定量测量，但仅几何重叠并不能确立掩膜衍生测量的保真度。我们开发了一个增强感知的三维 MedNeXt 框架，具有门控跳跃融合和边界监督，并在回顾性多队列设计中对其进行评估，涵盖锁定内部测试、源数据留出评估、回顾性外部验证和放射科医师审查。测量保真度是主要终点。在521例配对的内部测试和DUKE病例中，中位误差为肿瘤体积9.7%、三维最大表面直径1.8 mm、操作性增强定义体积10.2%，相应ICC分别为0.97、0.80和0.97。中位Dice在内部为0.831，在DUKE源数据留出层为0.823；在使用冻结检查点且未进行外部标签调优的情况下，在BC-MRI-SEG和公开BreastDCEDL_AMBL回顾性外部验证队列中分别为0.812和0.806。在盲法双读者审查中，80个掩膜中有78个无需重大修正。在276例配对反应分析病例中，自动几何的AUROC为0.732，专家几何为0.757（差异，−0.025；95% CI，−0.095至0.045）；未证明判别非劣效性。这些发现支持自动分割作为在所评估队列内由放射科医师监督的回顾性定量研究的起点，同时区分测量保真度与下游预测等效性。

title: Multicenter benchmarking of large language models for bladder cancer management recommendations from mpMRI reports
zh_title: 大模型生成膀胱癌mpMRI报告管理建议的多中心评测
summary: 按TRIPOD-LLM，用三家医院590份膀胱癌mpMRI报告回顾性评测9个大模型生成指南一致性建议的表现。
key_points: 三院590份报告，两种输入条件
21240条医生1-5分评分
输入语言与评分关联因模型而异
reason: 同行评审+三家医院外部验证，但为回顾性且以医生评分为终点，故取重要档下限
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can interpret radiology reports, but their ability to generate guideline-concordant recommendations from bladder cancer multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) reports remains uncertain. Following TRIPOD-LLM, we retrospectively evaluated nine API-accessed LLMs using 590 mpMRI reports from three hospitals under two input conditions: original Chinese reports and clinician-translated, quality-controlled English reports. Two physicians independently rated each model-generated recommendation on a 1–5 ordinal scale. We analyzed 21,240 ratings using patient-level random-intercept cumulative link mixed models, with paired Wilcoxon tests as secondary exploratory analyses. The association between input condition and physician rating differed across LLMs (likelihood-ratio chi-square = 683.05, df = 8, P < 0.001). Compared with original Chinese input, clinician-translated English input was associated with higher ratings for chatgpt-o3-pro (OR 2.79, 95% CI 2.29–3.41), deepseek-v4-flash (OR 1.46, 95% CI 1.19–1.81), claude-opus-4-7 (OR 3.07, 95% CI 2.47–3.82), and gpt-5.5 (OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.53–2.32), but with lower ratings for claude-sonnet-4-5 (OR 0.29, 95% CI 0.23–0.36; all Holm-adjusted P < 0.001). Four LLMs showed no clear input-condition difference. Center-specific contrasts also depended on input condition and were materially unchanged after adjustment for age, sex, pathological T stage, tumor grade, tumor number, and maximum lesion diameter. Inter-rater agreement was substantial (quadratic weighted kappa range, 0.621–0.743). Readability did not track physician-rated recommendation quality. These findings argue against clinician-translated English as a universal optimization strategy and support model-specific validation of input conditions before clinical deployment. LLM-generated recommendations from mpMRI reports are best positioned as clinician-supervised, imaging-based decision support rather than standalone treatment advice.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能够解读放射学报告，但其从膀胱癌多参数MRI（mpMRI）报告生成符合指南建议的能力仍不确定。遵循TRIPOD-LLM，我们回顾性评估了九个通过API访问的LLMs，使用来自三家医院的590份mpMRI报告，在两种输入条件下：原始中文报告和经临床医生翻译、质量控制的英文报告。两名医生在1–5序数量表上独立对每个模型生成的建议进行评分。我们使用患者水平随机截距累积链接混合模型分析了21,240个评分，并以配对Wilcoxon检验作为次要探索性分析。输入条件与医生评分之间的关联在不同LLMs间存在差异（似然比卡方=683.05，df=8，P<0.001）。与原始中文输入相比，经临床医生翻译的英文输入与chatgpt-o3-pro（OR 2.79，95% CI 2.29–3.41）、deepseek-v4-flash（OR 1.46，95% CI 1.19–1.81）、claude-opus-4-7（OR 3.07，95% CI 2.47–3.82）和gpt-5.5（OR 1.88，95% CI 1.53–2.32）的更高评分相关，但与claude-sonnet-4-5的更低评分相关（OR 0.29，95% CI 0.23–0.36；所有Holm校正P<0.001）。四个LLMs未显示明确的输入条件差异。中心特异性对比也取决于输入条件，并且在调整年龄、性别、病理T分期、肿瘤分级、肿瘤数量和最大病灶直径后基本未改变。评分者间一致性相当高（二次加权kappa范围，0.621–0.743）。可读性并未与医生评定的建议质量相对应。这些发现反对将临床医生翻译的英文作为通用优化策略，并支持在临床部署前对输入条件进行模型特异性验证。来自mpMRI报告的LLM生成建议最适合定位为临床医生监督下的、基于影像的决策支持，而非独立的治疗建议。

title: Enhanced skin tone and blood estimation through AI-enabled upscaling of discrete reflectance spectra
zh_title: AI光谱上采样提升皮肤肤色与血液估计
summary: 该同行评审研究用全连接神经网络从稀疏漫反射光谱上采样，无创估计黑色素与血容量指标。
key_points: 在体模、猪皮与人体活体三类样本上验证算法
可变血液与黑色素体模中R²>0.90
猪皮黑色素估计与组织学密度评分r=0.95
reason: 多类样本验证含离体与在体，但样本规模未述，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective quantification of epidermal melanin content and dermal blood volume is crucial for equitable applications in dermatology and in the evaluation and engineering of optical devices, such as pulse oximeters, where variable amounts of melanin may introduce inaccuracies. Here, we demonstrate a method leveraging diffuse reflectance spectroscopy and a machine-learning framework using fully connected neural networks (FCNNs) to non-invasively estimate melanin and blood indices from sparse data through spectral upscaling. We validated the algorithm on custom phantoms, porcine skin, and in vivo human participants. In phantoms with variable blood and melanin (0–20%), the model achieved high accuracy (R2 > 0.90) to absolute concentrations. In porcine skin, estimated melanin strongly correlated with histology-derived density scores (Pearson r = 0.95). Across six regions of the human hand, the FCNN accurately estimated pigmentation from sparse wavelengths, even during hand-raise challenges that induce confounding blood volume changes. After upscaling, sparse-wavelength estimates strongly correlated with a model using over 450 wavelengths (Pearson r = 0.96), reducing data requirements ~ 150-fold without compromising accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of high-spectral information for disentangling melanin and blood contributions in reflectance spectra and the capacity of machine-learning to restore predictive performance from sparse inputs. These findings demonstrate that artificial-intelligence -driven spectral upscaling can enhance objective skin tone quantification in wearable optical devices.
zh_abstract: 对表皮黑色素含量和真皮血容量进行客观定量，对于皮肤病学中的公平应用以及光学设备（如脉搏血氧仪）的评估和工程化至关重要，因为不同量的黑色素可能引入不准确性。在此，我们展示一种方法，利用漫反射光谱（diffuse reflectance spectroscopy）和一种使用全连接神经网络（fully connected neural networks, FCNNs）的机器学习框架，通过光谱上采样（spectral upscaling）从稀疏数据中无创估计黑色素和血液指数。我们在定制体模（custom phantoms）、猪皮肤和在体人类参与者中验证了该算法。在血液和黑色素可变（0–20%）的体模中，模型对绝对浓度达到高准确度（R2 > 0.90）。在猪皮肤中，估计的黑色素与组织学衍生的密度评分强相关（Pearson r = 0.95）。在人手六个区域中，FCNN从稀疏波长准确估计色素沉着，即使在诱发混杂血容量变化的抬手挑战（hand-raise challenges）期间也是如此。上采样后，稀疏波长估计与使用超过450个波长的模型强相关（Pearson r = 0.96），在不损害准确性的情况下将数据需求减少约150倍。这些发现突出了高光谱信息在反射光谱中区分黑色素和血液贡献的重要性，以及机器学习从稀疏输入恢复预测性能的能力。这些发现表明，人工智能驱动（artificial-intelligence-driven）的光谱上采样可增强可穿戴光学设备中客观肤色的量化。

title: Learning health system frameworks and the integration of artificial intelligence and data science in United States health care: a scoping review
zh_title: 学习型健康系统框架与AI整合：范围综述
summary: 梳理美国54项学习型健康系统框架研究与30项AI/数据科学研究，考察AI如何嵌入此类持续学习体系。
key_points: 纳入54项框架研究，其中44%为概念性改造
另纳入30项AI与数据科学研究
归纳数据基础设施、治理等五大组件
reason: 范围综述，系统检索与双人筛选规范，但无外部验证与结局数据，属综述上限档
abstract: Learning Health Systems (LHSs) use routinely collected data to generate evidence that informs practice through continuous learning cycles. Artificial intelligence (AI) and data science may strengthen this model, but how LHS frameworks and AI applications relate remains unclear. We mapped LHS frameworks and their components and examined how AI and data science are integrated. Searches identified U.S.-based, English-language studies published January 2007–August 2025; two reviewers independently screened and extracted data, resolving disagreements by consensus. We included 54 framework studies (24 [44%] conceptual adaptations; 30 [56%] real-world implementations) and 30 AI/data science studies. Five components recurred across the frameworks: data infrastructure and interoperability, governance and stakeholder engagement, learning and improvement cycles, evidence generation and translation, and equity and ethics. Relative to framework studies, AI studies less often addressed governance and stakeholder engagement (17% vs 35%) or equity (13% vs 22%), emphasizing computational over organizational functions. Most AI studies (27/30) focused on the data-to-knowledge phase; only three extended to knowledge-to-practice, and none described practice-to-data feedback with post-deployment outcomes informing model updating. AI applications capture only part of the LHS vision, concentrating on knowledge generation with less attention to the organizational and feedback mechanisms needed to translate insights into practice and sustain learning.
zh_abstract: 学习型卫生系统（Learning Health Systems, LHSs）利用常规收集的数据生成证据，通过持续学习循环为实践提供信息。人工智能（AI）和数据科学可能强化这一模式，但LHS框架与AI应用如何关联仍不清楚。我们梳理了LHS框架及其组成部分，并考察AI和数据科学如何被整合。检索识别出2007年1月至2025年8月发表的、基于美国的英语研究；两名评审员独立筛选和提取数据，分歧通过共识解决。我们纳入54项框架研究（24项[44%]为概念性改编；30项[56%]为真实世界实施）和30项AI/数据科学研究。框架中反复出现五个组成部分：数据基础设施与互操作性、治理与利益相关者参与、学习与改进循环、证据生成与转化、公平与伦理。相对于框架研究，AI研究较少涉及治理与利益相关者参与（17% vs 35%）或公平（13% vs 22%），更强调计算功能而非组织功能。大多数AI研究（27/30）集中于数据到知识阶段；仅3项延伸到知识到实践，且无一项描述实践到数据的反馈，即利用部署后结局为模型更新提供信息。AI应用仅捕捉了LHS愿景的一部分，集中于知识生成，对将洞见转化为实践并维持学习所需的组织和反馈机制关注较少。

title: Artificial intelligence methods for HER2 status assessment: a systematic review and diagnostic meta-analysis.

also.source: PubMed · Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
PubMed · Current topics in medicinal chemistry

zh_title: AI评估HER2状态的系统综述与诊断meta分析
summary: 该系统综述按PRISMA 2020评估AI判读HER2状态，纳入51项研究，其中14项进入诊断准确性合并分析。
key_points: 纳入51项研究，14项进入诊断meta分析
AI方法从传统机器学习逐步演进
采用QUADAS-2工具评价研究质量
reason: 系统综述+meta分析纳入研究较多，但仅合并诊断准确性、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is an important predictive and prognostic biomarker that guides targeted therapy, particularly in breast and gastric cancers. Conventional HER2 assessment using immunohistochemistry (IHC) and fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) is limited by inter-observer variability, heterogeneous expression, and diagnostic complexity. This systematic review and diagnostic meta-analysis followed the PRISMA 2020 guidelines to evaluate Artificial Intelligence-based HER2 assessment. Fifty-one studies were included in the qualitative synthesis and 14 in the diagnostic meta-analysis. Bibliometric analysis, methodological taxonomy, comparative evaluation, and pooled diagnostic performance were assessed, with study quality evaluated using QUADAS-2. AI methodologies have rapidly evolved from conventional machine learning and radiomics to deep learning, Vision Transformers, explainable AI, and multimodal frameworks, with histopathology and Magnetic Resonance Imaging. being the most frequently used modalities. Research activity increased markedly between 2023 and 2025. Pooled sensitivity was 87.8%, specificity was 83.5%, and Summary Receiver Operating Characteristic Area Under the Curve (SROC AUC) was 0.852 (95% CI: 0.801-0.881), indicating promising overall diagnostic performance. Deeks' funnel plot asymmetry test showed no significant evidence of publication bias (p = 0.14). However, heterogeneity warrants cautious interpretation of the pooled estimates. Heterogeneous datasets, limited external validation, and inconsistent evaluation methods remain important barriers to clinical implementation. Future research should emphasize multicenter prospective validation, explainable and multimodal AI, foundation models, federated learning, and evaluation in underexplored malignancies, including gallbladder cancer.
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] 人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）是指导靶向治疗的重要预测和预后生物标志物，尤其在乳腺癌和胃癌中。使用免疫组织化学（IHC）和荧光原位杂交（FISH）的传统HER2评估受观察者间变异、表达异质性和诊断复杂性限制。本系统综述和诊断性meta分析遵循PRISMA 2020指南，以评估基于人工智能的HER2评估。51项研究纳入定性综合，14项纳入诊断性meta分析。评估了文献计量分析、方法学分类、比较评价和合并诊断性能，并使用QUADAS-2评价研究质量。AI方法已从传统机器学习和放射组学迅速发展到深度学习、Vision Transformers、可解释AI和多模态框架，其中组织病理学和磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging）是最常用的模态。2023年至2025年间研究活动显著增加。合并敏感性为87.8%，特异性为83.5%，汇总受试者工作特征曲线下面积（SROC AUC）为0.852（95% CI：0.801-0.881），表明总体诊断性能有前景。Deeks漏斗图不对称性检验未显示显著的发表偏倚证据（p = 0.14）。然而，异质性要求对合并估计值进行谨慎解释。数据集异质、外部验证有限以及评价方法不一致仍是临床实施的重要障碍。未来研究应强调多中心前瞻性验证、可解释和多模态AI、基础模型、联邦学习，以及在包括胆囊癌在内的研究不足恶性肿瘤中的评估。
