title: Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning for Uncertainty-Robust Multi-Label Chest X-ray Classification
zh_title: 可靠性感知临床关系学习的胸片多标签分类
summary: 预印本提出ReCaRL图辅助框架，用可靠性加权与置信门控处理胸片多标签噪声标注，并做内外部区分评估。
key_points: 以训练标签关联构图，加权门控更新预测
用观测掩码处理不确定标注
与扁平、加权、图与层级惩罚基线对比
reason: 含外部区分评估且对比基线充分，但为预印本且细节待同行评审
abstract: Background: Automated multi-label classification of chest radiographs is complicated by overlapping imaging findings, noisy report-derived labels, and changes in disease co-occurrence across clinical settings. Existing clinical-hierarchy methods can encode label relationships, but a rigid hierarchy may conflate categorical membership with empirical association and propagate annotation errors. Methods: We investigated Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning (ReCaRL), a graph-assisted framework for multi-label chest radiograph classification. An image encoder produces initial finding scores, while a graph constructed from training-label associations provides reliability-weighted, confidence-gated updates. Uncertain annotations are handled with observation masks. The evaluation compares flat, weighted, graph-based, and hierarchy-penalty baselines, with internal and external discrimination and calibration assessments. Results: In the internal evaluation, ReCaRL achieved macro AUROC 0.821 and macro AUPRC 0.437, compared with 0.812 and 0.423 for the masked/weighted baseline. Mean AUROC across five common findings was 0.865 versus 0.858. External testing yielded AUROC 0.799 and AUPRC 0.409. Post-hoc calibration reduced the internal Brier score from 0.113 to 0.102 and the external expected calibration error from 0.082 to 0.061, without changing AUROC or AUPRC. Conclusions: Reliability-aware graph propagation and confidence gating were associated with modest improvements in multi-label chest radiograph classification relative to the matched masked/weighted baseline. Post-hoc calibration improved probability reliability in the reported evaluations. The findings do not establish a benefit in prospective clinical decision-making.
zh_abstract: 【背景】胸部X线片的多标签自动分类因影像表现重叠、报告来源标签有噪声以及不同临床环境中疾病共现情况变化而变得复杂。现有临床层级方法可以编码标签关系，但僵化的层级可能将类别归属与经验性关联混为一谈，并传播标注错误。【方法】我们研究了可靠性感知临床关系学习（Reliability-Aware Clinical Relation Learning，ReCaRL），一种用于多标签胸片分类的图辅助框架。图像编码器生成初始发现评分，而由训练标签关联构建的图提供可靠性加权、置信度门控的更新。不确定标注通过观测掩码处理。评估比较了平坦、加权、基于图和层级惩罚的基线，并进行内部和外部判别与校准评估。【结果】在内部评估中，ReCaRL达到宏AUROC 0.821和宏AUPRC 0.437，而掩码/加权基线为0.812和0.423。五种常见发现的平均AUROC为0.865对0.858。外部测试得到AUROC 0.799和AUPRC 0.409。事后校准将内部Brier评分从0.113降至0.102，并将外部期望校准误差从0.082降至0.061，而未改变AUROC或AUPRC。【结论】相对于匹配的掩码/加权基线，可靠性感知图传播和置信度门控与多标签胸片分类的适度改善相关。事后校准在报告的评估中改善了概率可靠性。这些发现不能确立在前瞻性临床决策中的获益。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; conditions: Emergency and Critical Care, Chest Radiography, Diagnostic Error, Thoracic Abnormalities; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE1; enrollment: 70000; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Chest radiography is widely used in emergency departments, resuscitation rooms, intensive care units, and other acute-care settings. Clinically important abnormalities may be missed because findings are subtle, uncommon, obscured by overlapping anatomy, or encountered under high workload. This pragmatic randomized trial evaluates whether EvoXRare, an artificial intelligence system that provides a draft chest radiograph report and high-risk alerts for uncommon or clinically important abnormalities, reduces clinically important diagnostic misses compared with routine physician interpretation alone. Approximately 70,000 adults will be randomized 1:1 across 15-20 hospitals in China. The primary endpoint is the patient-level rate of clinically important abnormalities present on the reference standard but not reported in the initial clinical interpretation. Key secondary outcomes include detection of rare or easily missed findings, time to recognition of critical abnormalities, report turnaround time, false-positive alerts, additional imaging, recall/communication events, and selected short-term clinical outcomes.

abstract: Racial and ethnic minority patients receive less pain treatment than non-Hispanic White patients, and large language models (LLMs) used as medical AI could reproduce that bias. Prior audits tested a few proprietary models, stated race explicitly and rarely measured the models' own response instability. In exploratory, non-preregistered analyses, Study 1 had four open-weight LLMs assess six acute-pain vignettes in every combination of four races and two sexes, with identity stated or cued only by a name (two names per group), comparing each identity with a White male reference on the same case and sampling seed. In Study 2, 24 configurations of 17 models, including OpenAI's GPT-4.1 mini and gpt-oss, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5, Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek and Qwen, with reasoning on and off and at two precisions, answered the same vignettes and the 50 clinician-written Q-Pain cases. In this single-prompt, JSON-constrained task, no difference survived correction in Study 1, none of 1,386 comparisons survived the false discovery rate in Study 2, and every pain-severity difference was equivalent to zero within one point on a 0-10 scale (within a quarter point for 237 of 238 Q-Pain comparisons). Opioid decisions were bounded less precisely (Study 1 could not exclude differences of about 20 percentage points), so they show no detected difference, not proof of none. The few differences surviving correction within a model favoured Black patients. Models differed far more from one another and across their own settings than between patients (the reference patient received the high opioid dose in 6% to 93% of responses), although serving software, provider and prompt format also differed. Fairness audits of clinical AI should use several names per group, pair comparisons on the seed, report the noise floor and test each deployed configuration.
zh_abstract: 种族和族裔少数群体患者接受的疼痛治疗少于非西班牙裔白人患者，而用作医学AI的大语言模型（LLMs）可能重现这种偏倚。此前的审计测试了少数专有模型，明确说明种族，且很少测量模型自身的回答不稳定性。在探索性、非预先注册的分析中，研究1让四个开放权重LLMs评估六个急性疼痛情景案例，覆盖四个种族和两个性别的每一种组合，身份被明确说明或仅通过姓名提示（每组两个姓名），将每个身份与同一病例和采样种子上的白人男性参照进行比较。在研究2中，17个模型的24种配置，包括 OpenAI 的 GPT-4.1 mini 和 gpt-oss、Anthropic 的 Claude Haiku 4.5、Google 的 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Meta 的 Llama、DeepSeek 和 Qwen，在推理开启和关闭以及两种精度下，回答了相同的情景案例和50个临床医生编写的 Q-Pain 病例。在这个单一提示、JSON约束任务中，研究1中没有差异在校正后仍然存在，研究2的1,386项比较中没有任何一项在错误发现率校正后仍然存在，并且每一个疼痛严重程度差异在0-10量表的一个点以内均等效于零（238项Q-Pain比较中有237项在四分之一点以内）。阿片类药物决策的界限较不精确（研究1无法排除约20个百分点的差异），因此它们显示未检测到差异，而非证明不存在差异。模型内经过校正后仍存在的少数差异偏向黑人患者。模型之间以及模型自身不同设置之间的差异远大于患者之间的差异（参考患者在6%至93%的回答中接受了高剂量阿片类药物），尽管服务软件、提供商和提示格式也有所不同。临床AI的公平性审计应每组使用多个姓名、在种子上配对比较、报告噪声底限，并测试每个部署配置。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University Hospital, Antwerp; conditions: Late Onset Neonatal Sepsis, Necrotizing Enterocolitis of Newborn; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 500; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to evaluate the Intellicens software, an artificial intelligence (AI)-based early warning system designed to help doctors and nurses detect serious complications in premature babies at an early stage. These complications include bloodstream infections (sepsis) and necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC), a serious condition affecting the intestines. The study will involve babies born before 32 weeks of pregnancy who are admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). The Intellicens Neo model analyses routinely collected medical data, such as heart rate, to identify patterns that may indicate an increased risk of sepsis or NEC and generate an early warning for healthcare professionals. The treating doctor remains responsible for deciding whether further examinations or treatment are needed. The software has previously been tested using data from babies who had already been discharged from hospital, with promising results. This study will evaluate how well the software performs in real-life clinical practice during the hospital stay.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：安特卫普大学医院；疾病：晚发型新生儿脓毒症、新生儿坏死性小肠结肠炎；类型：干预性；阶段：NA；入组人数：500；状态：尚未招募] 本研究旨在评估 Intellicens 软件，这是一种基于人工智能（AI）的早期预警系统，旨在帮助医生和护士早期发现早产儿的严重并发症。这些并发症包括血流感染（脓毒症）和坏死性小肠结肠炎（NEC），后者是一种影响肠道的严重疾病。本研究将纳入妊娠32周前出生并入住新生儿重症监护病房（NICU）的婴儿。Intellicens Neo 模型分析常规收集的医疗数据（如心率），以识别可能提示脓毒症或NEC风险增加的模式，并向医疗专业人员生成早期预警。主治医生仍负责决定是否需要进一步检查或治疗。该软件此前已使用已出院婴儿的数据进行测试，结果令人鼓舞。本研究将评估该软件在住院期间真实临床实践中的表现。

title: The role of artificial intelligence in urological malignancies: an overview of systematic reviews.

reason: 系统综述总览属二次证据汇总，摘要未给出具体效能数据，属综述档
abstract: [The Canadian journal of urology] Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform clinical medicine by enhancing diagnostic precision, prognostic accuracy, and personalized decision making. In urological oncology, AI technologies are increasingly integrated across diagnostic, prognostic, and therapeutic pathways. This overview of systematic reviews aims to synthesise the current evidence on the performance and clinical utility of AI applications in urological malignancies. A systematic search was conducted of major bibliographic databases from 1974 to October 2024 to identify systematic reviews (SRs) evaluating AI-based models in urological cancers. We followed the Cochrane methodology of Overviews of Reviews. Outcomes of interest included diagnostic accuracy metrics (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC-ROC], sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy) and predictive performance for treatment-relatedoutcomes. A total of 67 SRs encompassing 1139 primary studies were included. RoB was assessed as low in 21 reviews, high in 41, and unclear in 5. Forty-five SRs evaluated AI in prostate cancer (PCa). AI models demonstrated high accuracy (88-93%) in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions, and outperformed human interpretation alone in predicting clinically significant PCa (AUC: 0.933 vs. AUC: 0.82-0.87). Performance in Gleason score classification was also very strong (AUC: 0.72-0.99, Accuracy: 70.8-93.0%). Sixteen SRs assessed AI in Renal carcinoma (RCa), reporting accurate subtype classification and tumor grade prediction, with some models exceeding 90% accuracy. Sixteen SRs focused on Bladder Cancer (BCa), showing improved detection of muscle-invasive disease and recurrence risk prediction compared with the conventional approach. Key limitations included heterogeneity in validation strategies, overlap of primary studies across reviews, and potential oversampling due to synthetic or augmented data. AI-based models consistently demonstrate improved diagnostic and predictive performance across urological malignancies and hold promise for enhancing clinical decision-making and patient outcomes. At present, AI tools should be regarded as decision-support systems that complement, rather than replace, clinical expertise. Future research should emphasize prospective validation, standardized outcome definitions, and evaluation of real-world clinical impact. Robust and harmonized evaluation frameworks are also essential to address challenges related to data quality
zh_abstract: [《The Canadian Journal of Urology》] 人工智能（AI）有潜力通过提高诊断精确性、预后准确性和个性化决策来变革临床医学。在泌尿肿瘤学中，AI技术正日益整合到诊断、预后和治疗路径中。本系统综述的概述旨在综合当前关于AI应用在泌尿系统恶性肿瘤中的性能和临床效用的证据。我们对主要书目数据库进行了系统检索，时间范围为1974年至2024年10月，以识别评估泌尿系统癌症中AI模型的系统综述（SRs）。我们遵循Cochrane Reviews概述方法学。关注结局包括诊断准确性指标（受试者工作特征曲线下面积[AUC-ROC]、灵敏度、特异度和准确率）以及治疗相关结局的预测性能。共纳入67篇SRs，涵盖1139项原始研究。21篇综述的偏倚风险（RoB）评估为低，41篇为高，5篇不明确。45篇SRs评估了AI在前列腺癌（PCa）中的应用。AI模型在区分良性与恶性病变方面表现出高准确率（88-93%），并在预测临床显著PCa方面优于单独人类判读（AUC：0.933 vs AUC：0.82-0.87）。Gleason评分分类性能也非常强（AUC：0.72-0.99，准确率：70.8-93.0%）。16篇SRs评估了AI在肾癌（RCa）中的应用，报告了准确的亚型分类和肿瘤分级预测，部分模型准确率超过90%。16篇SRs聚焦于膀胱癌（BCa），显示与常规方法相比，在肌层浸润性疾病检测和复发风险预测方面有所改善。关键局限性包括验证策略的异质性、综述间原始研究重叠，以及由于合成或增强数据导致的潜在过采样。基于AI的模型在泌尿系统恶性肿瘤中一致表现出改善的诊断和预测性能，并有望增强临床决策和患者结局。目前，AI工具应被视为决策支持系统，补充而非替代临床专业知识。未来研究应强调前瞻性验证、标准化结局定义和真实世界临床影响评估。稳健且协调一致的评估框架对于应对数据质量相关挑战也至关重要。

abstract: [Frontiers in nephrology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied across nephrology, with potential applications spanning disease prediction, diagnosis, treatment optimisation, and clinical decision support. However, reported model performance varies substantially across clinical domains, and high predictive performance does not necessarily demonstrate clinical utility or readiness for deployment. This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on the applications of AI in nephrology and critically evaluates the methodological maturity, validation, interpretability, fairness, and translational readiness of AI systems across major nephrology domains. A structured literature search of PubMed was conducted using terms related to AI and nephrology, with the primary eligibility period restricted to studies published from 2020 to 2025. The search strategy incorporated artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, natural language processing, large language models, generative AI, computer vision, reinforcement learning, federated learning, and related terms, together with nephrology and kidney-disease terms. Title/abstract and full-text screening were performed independently by the first and second authors, with disagreements resolved by the third author. Two foundational pre-2020 studies identified through citation chaining were retained because of their importance to the subsequent development of AI applications in nephrology. Evidence was synthesized qualitatively according to study design, validation, predictive performance, interpretability, fairness, prospective evaluation, and translational readiness. AI applications were identified across acute kidney injury, chronic kidney disease, nephropathology, kidney transplantation, haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, large language models, reinforcement learning, and federated learning. Across these domains, many models demonstrated promising discrimination, but evidence maturity varied considerably. External validation was present for some applications, whereas prospective evaluation and evidence of clinical utility remained limited. The literature also highlighted challenges related to calibration, generalizability, interpretability, algorithmic fairness, data governance, and integration into clinical workflows. Large language models and federated learning represent emerging areas, but nephrology-specific evidence remains comparatively limited. AI has substantial potential to support pre

abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Valvular heart disease (VHD) affects a substantial proportion of the population and remains a major cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality worldwide. Despite advances in surgical and transcatheter therapies, important challenges persist. VHD remains underdiagnosed, assessment of disease severity is often variable, and the optimal timing of intervention continues to evolve. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool across the spectrum of VHD care. AI-based electrocardiogram analysis can identify both existing and future VHD, while AI-guided point-of-care ultrasound extends screening to nonspecialist settings. Across multimodality imaging, machine learning (ML) and deep learning algorithms enable automated, reproducible assessment of VHD. In echocardiography, AI supports grading of disease severity across the main valvular lesions, including Doppler interpretation and automated report generation. AI-enhanced cardiac magnetic resonance facilitates automated assessment of ventricular remodeling and myocardial fibrosis, while AI-assisted cardiac computed tomography improves procedural planning for transcatheter interventions. In parallel, ML has identified distinct patient phenotypes in multiple valvular lesions with differing clinical trajectories and responses to intervention. This review summarizes current applications of AI in detection, multimodality imaging, and potential clinical decision support for VHD and discusses opportunities and challenges for integration into routine practice.
zh_abstract: [Methodist DeBakey Cardiovascular Journal] 瓣膜性心脏病（valvular heart disease, VHD）影响相当大一部分人群，并且仍然是全球心血管发病和死亡的主要原因。尽管外科和经导管治疗取得进展，重要挑战仍然存在。VHD仍诊断不足，疾病严重程度的评估常存在差异，最佳干预时机仍在演变。人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）已成为VHD全程管理中一个有前景的工具。基于AI的心电图分析可识别现有和未来发生的VHD，而AI引导的床旁超声将筛查扩展到非专科环境。在多模态成像中，机器学习（machine learning, ML）和深度学习算法能够实现VHD的自动化、可重复评估。在超声心动图中，AI支持主要瓣膜病变的疾病严重程度分级，包括多普勒解读和自动报告生成。AI增强的心脏磁共振促进心室重构和心肌纤维化的自动化评估，而AI辅助的心脏计算机断层扫描改善经导管干预的手术规划。同时，ML已在多种瓣膜病变中识别出具有不同临床轨迹和干预反应的不同患者表型。本综述总结了AI在VHD检测、多模态成像和潜在临床决策支持中的当前应用，并讨论了将其整合到常规实践中的机会和挑战。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Qilu Hospital of Shandong University; conditions: Biliopancreatic Diseases; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 420; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study aims to develop and prospectively validate an automated reporting system to generate structured preliminary biliopancreatic EUS reports using information collected before and during EUS examinations. System development will be completed before prospective validation, and patients included in system development will be separate from those enrolled in prospective validation. The prospective multicenter validation will enroll 420 adults undergoing EUS for suspected or confirmed biliopancreatic disease. Each patient will contribute only the first eligible EUS examination. The primary endpoint is the difference in clinical acceptance rates between system-generated preliminary reports and independently prepared manual preliminary reports. Non-inferiority will be assessed using a predefined margin. A nested endosonographer-reporting substudy will also compare completion time and quality between final reports prepared by endosonographers with and without assistance of a system-generated preliminary report. The study will assess the ability of automated reporting to support accurate and efficient EUS reporting while routine clinical care remains unchanged.

title: BenchmarkHub: an open-source platform for reproducible evaluation of large language models in healthcare

abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) are solely judged by their scores on biomedical benchmarks, yet these scores are rarely reproducible since the prompts, inference settings and model builds are seldom reported. We developed BenchmarkHub, an open-source platform for auditable evaluation of language and vision-language models for biomedical research. Methods: BenchmarkHub is a Python web application (Django 5.2, SQLite) released under the MIT licence and available at https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub. The application can be accessed through a browser interface, a set of command-line tools and a REST API, so interactive exploration and scripted pipelines produce identical, comparable records. The platform samples questions with fixed seeds, runs models directly or as tool-using agents in a code sandbox, grades answers with deterministic rules and stores every prompt, reply and tool call. The interface provides a leaderboard to rank performance of the models, allowing model comparison without any preexisting programming knowledge. Findings: We used BenchmarkHub to evaluate 12 open-weight models in five experiments on 15 biomedical benchmarks (11 text, two multimodal and two computational biology) and two general benchmarks. The pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% (95% CI 43.0-49.3) to 80.9% (78.3-83.3). Re-grading the responses with simple answer-extraction rules lowered a model's accuracy by up to 33.1 percentage points, leading to a reorder of the leaderboard. Published scores were found for 23 out of the 143 benchmark/model combinations tested. The accuracy measured by BenchmarkHub was lower than in the published results in 19 out of the 23 available comparisons. The effect of four prompting protocols (1: default prompt; 2: asking the model to answer the letter only; 3: chain-of-thought prompting; 4: three-shot prompting) changed MedQA accuracy by up to 11.3 points but was not significant after multiple-testing correction with 150 questions. We also tested the impact of ablation on benchmarking using the MMMU benchmark dataset. Removing images lowered the accuracy by 18.0 and 19.3 points respectively for the two strongest models. Finally, the accuracy of agentic benchmarks using a sandboxed interpreter increased on computational biology tasks by 36-63 points. Interpretation: Benchmarking is essential to assess the impact and validity of LLMs for medical applications. BenchmarkHub allows a fair and rigorous comparison of models across esta
zh_abstract: 【背景】大语言模型（LLMs）仅根据其在生物医学基准上的得分来评判，但由于提示、推理设置和模型构建版本很少报告，这些得分很少可复现。我们开发了 BenchmarkHub，一个用于生物医学研究中语言模型和视觉-语言模型可审计评估的开源平台。【方法】BenchmarkHub 是一个 Python Web 应用（Django 5.2，SQLite），根据 MIT 许可证发布，可在 https://github.com/juanjuanignacio/benchmarkhub 获取。该应用可通过浏览器界面、一组命令行工具和 REST API 访问，因此交互式探索和脚本化流水线会产生相同、可比较的记录。该平台使用固定种子采样问题，直接运行模型或在代码沙箱中作为使用工具的代理运行模型，使用确定性规则对答案评分，并存储每个提示、回复和工具调用。该界面提供排行榜对模型性能进行排名，使无需任何既有编程知识即可比较模型。【结果】我们使用 BenchmarkHub 在五项实验中评估了12个开放权重模型，涵盖15个生物医学基准（11个文本、两个多模态和两个计算生物学）和两个通用基准。合并准确率范围为46.1%（95% CI 43.0-49.3）至80.9%（78.3-83.3）。使用简单的答案提取规则重新评分回答，使某模型的准确率最多降低33.1个百分点，导致排行榜重新排序。在测试的143个基准/模型组合中，找到了23个已发表得分。在23项可用比较中，有19项 BenchmarkHub 测得的准确率低于已发表结果。四种提示方案（1：默认提示；2：要求模型仅回答字母；3：思维链提示；4：三样本提示）的影响使 MedQA 准确率最多变化11.3点，但在150个问题的多重检验校正后不显著。我们还使用 MMMU 基准数据集测试了消融对基准测试的影响。移除图像使两个最强模型的准确率分别降低18.0和19.3点。最后，使用沙箱化解释器的代理式基准在计算生物学任务上的准确率提高了36-63点。【解释】基准测试对于评估 LLMs 在医学应用中的影响和有效性至关重要。BenchmarkHub 允许跨 esta 对模型进行公平而严格的比较

title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation

abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) enhance X-ray report generation, but often neglect clinical context, overlook workflow integration, and lack explainability, which hinders clinical adoption due to interpretability and reliability concerns. This paper addresses the dual challenges of performance and expert explainability in automated X-ray report generation for clinical AI applications. Our proposed approach, TransXplainRRG, utilises an off-the-shelf Swin Transformer model along with a transformer-based text encoder that incorporates patient medical history to generate a radiology report. Further, we explore an expert-guided `inside-out' approach and extract only abnormal findings for radiology report refinement. Thus, this study bridges the gap between high-performance automation and interpretability critical for clinical practice by combining state-of-the-art transformer-based vision encoders, text encoders, and LLMs. TransXplainRRG is trained and tested on the large-scale MIMIC-CXR dataset and further evaluated on the unseen IU X-Ray dataset to demonstrate its generalizability and robustness. We employed the GREEN metric as a complementary measure of clinical consistency, achieving scores of 0.327 on MIMIC-CXR and 0.605 on IU X-Ray, both higher than those achieved by MAIRA-2 under the same evaluation setting. It also performed competitively across standard evaluation metrics, frequently matching or surpassing state-of-the-art models. Additionally, we introduce qualitative evaluation metrics developed from radiologists' viewpoints and conduct a preliminary radiologist evaluation on 100 generated reports to assess their clinical relevance. Quantitative and qualitative analyses further demonstrate the potential of our TransXplainRRG framework for reliable and explainable radiology report generation.
zh_abstract: 大型视觉-语言模型（Large Vision-Language Models, LVLM）的最新进展增强了X线报告生成，但常常忽视临床背景、忽略工作流程整合，并缺乏可解释性，这由于可解释性和可靠性问题而阻碍临床采用。本文针对临床AI应用中自动X线报告生成的双重挑战：性能与专家可解释性。我们提出的方法TransXplainRRG利用现成的Swin Transformer模型以及基于Transformer的文本编码器，该编码器整合患者病史以生成放射学报告。进一步，我们探索一种专家引导的“由内而外”（inside-out）方法，并仅提取异常表现用于放射学报告优化。因此，本研究通过结合最先进的基于Transformer的视觉编码器、文本编码器和LLMs，弥合了高性能自动化与临床实践所需可解释性之间的差距。TransXplainRRG在大规模MIMIC-CXR数据集上训练和测试，并在未见过的IU X-Ray数据集上进一步评估，以展示其泛化性和稳健性。我们采用GREEN指标作为临床一致性的补充度量，在MIMIC-CXR上获得0.327分，在IU X-Ray上获得0.605分，均高于MAIRA-2在相同评估设置下取得的分数。它在标准评估指标上也具有竞争力，经常匹配或超过最先进模型。此外，我们引入了从放射科医生视角开发的定性评估指标，并对100份生成报告进行初步放射科医生评估，以评估其临床相关性。定量和定性分析进一步证明了我们的TransXplainRRG框架在可靠且可解释的放射学报告生成方面的潜力。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Samsung Medical Center; conditions: Medical Education, Head Injury, Minor; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 20; status: COMPLETED] This randomized pilot study evaluated whether training with a GPT-4-based virtual patient chat platform (Med2Lab) helps physicians learn the Pediatric Emergency Care Applied Research Network (PECARN) head CT rules, compared with conventional self-study. Physicians with less than 5 years of clinical experience received a short lecture on the PECARN rules and were randomly assigned to 1 hour of self-study with printed materials or 1 hour of history-taking practice with six GPT-4 virtual patients representing pediatric head trauma cases. Knowledge of the PECARN rules, clinical decision-making, history-taking and communication skills, satisfaction with the training, and usability of the platform were assessed.

abstract: Training-time explanation regularization is often evaluated by whether saliency maps become more concentrated within annotated regions. We argue that this criterion alone is insufficient: transformation consistency, lesion localization, and faithfulness to the classifier are distinct properties and should be evaluated separately, particularly in medical imaging. We examine this distinction through a case study of Contrastive Grad-CAM Consistency (CGC) in three-class brain tumor MRI classification. Using a single-channel ResNet-50 with five-fold patient-grouped cross-validation, we compare a cross-entropy baseline with CGC. CGC changes overall Pointing Game (PG) from $27.24\%$ to $36.02\%$ and Relevance Mass Accuracy (RMA) from $11.17\%$ to $18.01\%$, while classification accuracy changes from $93.63\%$ to $94.87\%$. title: Trust the Edge, Doubt the Arrow: Auditing Validation Signals for Text-Mined Clinical Causal Knowledge Graphs

abstract: Clinical causal retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly use knowledge graphs (KGs) mined from notes, yet extracted assertions remain candidates that require audit for patient-level EHR support and direction. We construct a directed candidate graph from 328,839 MIMIC-IV discharge summaries using LLM extraction and UMLS normalization, and evaluate three signals against SemMedDB: within-admission co-occurrence lift, cross-admission diagnosis-coding temporal precedence, and literature corroboration. Lift filters unsupported co-mentions and provides useful EHR support, but not causal proof. Coding order is a weak direction signal: among the 686 candidates where it commits, it reaches 54.2% agreement with SemMedDB, below the extractor's 69.4% on the same subset. Literature corroboration supplies independent direction evidence but covers only 30.4% of candidate relations. A MIMIC-II

abstract: Academic, psychosocial, financial, environmental, and interpersonal factors are widely recognized as important contributors to the overall wellbeing of students. This study aimed to identify factors associated with the psychological wellbeing of university undergraduates and compare the performance of machine learning models for binary and multiclass classification of wellbeing status using self-reported survey data from undergraduates at the University of Peradeniya, Sri Lanka. The findings may facilitate the early identification of students with lower wellbeing and inform targeted interventions to foster a healthier and more supportive academic environment. Cross-sectional questionnaire data from 2,913 undergraduates were analyzed to classify psychological wellbeing using overall happiness scores. Scores were grouped into binary (1-5 and 6-9) and multiclass (1-4, 5-6, and 7-9) categories. Data preprocessing included missing value imputation, one-hot encoding, and feature scaling where appropriate. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), XGBoost (XGB), and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) models were trained using repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation and evaluated using macro F1-score, ROC-AUC, and classification reports. SHAP analysis was employed to interpret feature contributions and enhance model interpretability. XGB achieved the highest macro-F1 score (70.5%) for binary classification, with a test accuracy of 72.5%. The model correctly classified 63.6% and 80% of participants in the lower and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. For multiclass classification, RF achieved the highest macro-F1 score (54.6%), with a test accuracy of 56.5%. The model correctly classified 48%, 57%, and 60% of participants in the lower, intermediate, and higher psychological wellbeing groups, respectively. SHAP analysis identified academic coping, health and wellbeing, financial circumstances, and interpersonal relationships as key predictors of psychological wellbeing across both models. These findings demonstrate the potential of machine learning to classify psychological wellbeing groups using self-reported data, supporting early identification of students at risk of poor wellbeing and informing targeted university-level mental health interventions.
zh_abstract: 学业、心理社会、经济、环境和人际因素被广泛认为是学生整体福祉的重要贡献因素。本研究旨在识别与大学本科生心理幸福感相关的因素，并比较机器学习模型在使用斯里兰卡佩拉德尼亚大学本科生自我报告调查数据对幸福感状态进行二分类和多分类时的性能。这些发现可能有助于早期识别幸福感较低的学生，并为有针对性的干预提供依据，以营造更健康、更具支持性的学术环境。分析来自2,913名本科生的横断面问卷数据，使用总体幸福感得分对心理幸福感进行分类。得分被分为二分类（1-5和6-9）和多分类（1-4、5-6和7-9）类别。数据预处理包括缺失值插补、独热编码，以及在适当时进行特征缩放。使用重复分层10折交叉验证训练支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（RF）、XGBoost（XGB）和多层感知机（MLP）模型，并使用宏F1分数、ROC-AUC和分类报告进行评价。采用SHAP分析解释特征贡献并增强模型可解释性。XGB在二分类中取得最高宏F1分数（70.5%），测试准确率为72.5%。该模型分别正确分类了较低和较高心理幸福感组中63.6%和80%的参与者。对于多分类，RF取得最高宏F1分数（54.6%），测试准确率为56.5%。该模型分别正确分类了较低、中等和较高心理幸福感组中48%、57%和60%的参与者。SHAP分析识别出学业应对、健康与福祉、财务状况和人际关系是两种模型中心理幸福感的关键预测因素。这些发现证明了机器学习使用自我报告数据对心理幸福感组进行分类的潜力，支持早期识别有较差幸福感风险的学生，并为大学层面有针对性的心理健康干预提供信息。

title: Learning uncertainty fields for joint brain stroke diagnosis and intrinsic lesion localization in CT and MRI
zh_title: 模糊不确定性场联合脑卒中诊断与病灶定位
summary: DFE-Net 以可学习模糊隶属场表征空间不确定性，在多中心 CT 与 MRI 队列上联合分类卒中并定位病灶。
key_points: 多中心CT队列6650例、8873幅图像
CT AUC 0.974、F1 0.897；MRI AUC 0.978
CT病灶定位对照专家标注Dice 0.70
reason: 多中心大样本影像队列并有独立MRI队列验证，属重要档；回顾性且未报临床结局
abstract: Early stroke changes can be difficult to detect and localize on neuroimaging, particularly when lesion boundaries are indistinct. We developed the Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network (DFE-Net), which uses learnable fuzzy membership fields to represent spatial uncertainty and jointly classify stroke and localize lesions. We evaluated the model on a multicentre computed tomography (CT) cohort comprising 6650 patients and 8873 images and a separate magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) cohort comprising 67 patients and 615 images. Training and testing were performed separately within each modality. DFE-Net achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.974 and an F1 score of 0.897 on CT, and corresponding values of 0.978 and 0.879 on MRI. In the CT cohort, lesion localization against expert annotations yielded a Dice score of 0.70. MRI localization was assessed using gradient-derived pseudo-targets because expert lesion masks were unavailable. Expected calibration error was ~0.022 in both cohorts, and the model contained 0.20 million parameters. These results support joint diagnosis and spatial localization with a compact model, while prospective validation and expert-annotated MRI evaluation remain necessary.
zh_abstract: 早期卒中改变在神经影像上可能难以检测和定位，尤其是当病灶边界不清晰时。我们开发了动态模糊编码器网络（Dynamic Fuzzy Encoder Network，DFE-Net），其使用可学习的模糊隶属度场来表示空间不确定性，并联合进行卒中分类和病灶定位。我们在一个包含6650例患者和8873幅图像的多中心计算机断层扫描（computed tomography，CT）队列，以及一个包含67例患者和615幅图像的独立磁共振成像（magnetic resonance imaging，MRI）队列上评估了该模型。训练和测试均在每种模态内分别进行。DFE-Net在CT上达到受试者工作特征曲线下面积0.974和F1分数0.897，在MRI上相应值为0.978和0.879。在CT队列中，与专家标注相比，病灶定位的Dice分数为0.70。由于没有专家病灶掩膜，MRI定位使用梯度衍生的伪目标进行评估。两个队列中的期望校准误差均约为0.022，模型包含20万个参数。这些结果支持使用紧凑模型进行联合诊断和空间定位，但仍需前瞻性验证和专家标注的MRI评估。

title: Challenges for human oversight in detecting system malfunctions in AI-assisted medical diagnostics
zh_title: AI诊断故障时的人类监督挑战
summary: 随机对照研究让48名医生使用可靠性逐步下降的心脏听诊AI，发现医生诊断表现随AI可靠性同步下降，即使被强制先独立判断。
key_points: 48名医生随机对照，AI可靠性递减
医生诊断准确率随AI故障而下降
医生信心下降快于对AI的信任下降
reason: 随机对照人机协作研究、议题重要，但样本仅48名医生，属值得看档
abstract: Increasingly, physicians must oversee AI systems to detect system malfunctions. We studied 48 physicians in a randomized controlled study using an increasingly malfunctioning AI for cardiac auscultation. Diagnostic performance declined alongside AI reliability, even when physicians were cognitively forced to make an initial classification, and when human performance exceeded AI reliability. Physicians’ confidence declined faster than their trust in AI. Results call for specification of oversight goals and processes ensuring patient safety.
zh_abstract: 越来越多的医生必须监督AI系统以检测系统故障。我们在一项随机对照研究中研究了48名医生，使用一个故障日益增多的AI进行心脏听诊。诊断性能随AI可靠性下降而下降，即使医生在认知上被强制要求做出初步分类，并且即使人类表现超过AI可靠性时也是如此。医生的信心下降得比他们对AI的信任更快。结果要求明确监督目标和流程，以确保患者安全。

title: Beyond skin deep: physiologic oral pigmentation as an overlooked validation gap in AI-assisted oral cancer screening
zh_title: 口腔癌AI筛查中色素沉着的验证缺口
summary: 评论指出口腔癌AI筛查工具（如MeMoSA）几乎仅在亚洲人群验证，提出生理性口腔色素沉着可能导致误分类，呼吁按色素分层验证。
key_points: MeMoSA等工具几乎仅亚洲人群验证
生理性色素沉着按种族而异且非病理
呼吁部署前开展色素分层验证
reason: 同行评审观点文章，提出公平性验证缺口，但无新数据，按综述观点档上限取5
abstract: AI-assisted oral cancer screening tools, exemplified by MeMoSA, have been validated almost exclusively in Asian populations. We propose a testable hypothesis: physiologic oral pigmentation, which varies by race independent of pathology, may cause classifiers to misclassify normal variation as suspicious or miss camouflaged lesions. Following precedent from pulse oximetry and dermatology AI, we call for pigmentation-stratified validation before deployment in racially diverse settings such as the United States.
zh_abstract: 以MeMoSA为代表的人工智能辅助口腔癌筛查工具几乎仅在亚洲人群中得到验证。我们提出一个可检验的假设：生理性口腔色素沉着会因种族而异，且与病理无关，可能导致分类器将正常变异误判为可疑，或漏诊被色素沉着掩盖的病变。参照脉搏血氧仪和皮肤病学人工智能领域的先例，我们呼吁在种族多样化环境（如美国）部署前，开展按色素沉着分层的验证。

title: [Comment] Mortality prediction using cardiac magnetic resonance: artificial intelligence versus clinicians–Quo vadis?
zh_title: 述评：心脏磁共振死亡率预测，AI与临床医生孰优
summary: Lancet Digital Health述评，围绕用心脏磁共振做死亡率预测时AI与临床医生的比较展开讨论。
key_points: 主题为CMR死亡率预测的AI与医生对比
指出CMR成本高、操作者短缺等限制
属述评，仅读摘要与描述
reason: 同行评审述评，议题有价值但非原创研究，按述评档上限内取5分
abstract: With a rise in the incidence of cardiovascular disease in ageing populations worldwide, physicians will face a substantial increase in demand for feasible and accurate diagnostics. Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) is a highly accurate, non-ionising imaging technique for quantitative assessment of cardiac function and geometry and for detection of cardiovascular diseases. However, CMR lacks the high throughput, low cost, and portability of echocardiography. Another widespread clinical obstacle to CMR is the shortage of qualified and trained operators.
zh_abstract: 随着全球人口老龄化中心血管疾病发病率上升，医生将面临对可行且准确诊断工具需求的大幅增加。心脏磁共振（cardiac magnetic resonance, CMR）是一种高度准确、无电离辐射的成像技术，用于定量评估心脏功能和几何结构以及检测心血管疾病。然而，CMR缺乏超声心动图的高通量、低成本和便携性。CMR另一个广泛的临床障碍是合格且受过培训的操作人员短缺。

title: Large Language Model-Assisted Discharge Instructions for Diabetic Kidney Disease: Comparative Evaluation Study.
zh_title: 大模型辅助生成糖尿病肾病出院指导的对比评估
summary: 纳入101例住院DKD患者，比较低年资住院医师独立撰写与借助DeepSeek-V3.2生成出院指导的质量差异。
key_points: 101例糖尿病肾病患者出院指导
住院医师组 vs DeepSeek-V3.2辅助组对比
按CKD分期分析获益是否不同
reason: 同行评审的对比评估，样本仅101例、单中心、无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Discharge instructions are an important component of the transition from hospital to home for patients with diabetic kidney disease (DKD), whose care often involves multiple comorbidities, medications, and stage-specific management needs. However, producing complete, accurate, clear, and personalized instructions can be challenging for junior physicians. This study aimed to evaluate whether large language model (LLM) assistance improves the quality of DKD discharge instructions produced by junior physicians and whether its benefits vary according to chronic kidney disease (CKD) stage. The study included 101 hospitalized patients with DKD. Discharge instructions for each patient were initially drafted by a group of junior residents (resident group); subsequently, another group of residents at the same level, with the assistance of DeepSeek-V3.2 (AI-assisted group), generated a separate set of discharge instructions for the same 101 patients, resulting in a total of 202 documents. Four clinical experts, including 2 nephrologists and 2 endocrinologists, independently scored both versions of the discharge instructions using a 5-point Likert scale across 5 dimensions: completeness, accuracy, safety, clarity, and personalization. Interrater reliability was assessed using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC). Interrater reliability was excellent in both the resident group (ICC=0.817, 95% CI 0.763-0.864; P .05). The proportion of cases achieving a ≥1-point improvement in overall quality was 99% (100/101; 95% CI 94.6%-100.0%). LLM assistance improved the completeness, clarity, and personalization of DKD discharge instructions generated by junior physicians, with advantages greatest in complex cases. A human-AI collaborative model is a promising approach to reduce documentation burden.
zh_abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] 出院指导是糖尿病肾脏病（DKD）患者从医院过渡到家庭的重要环节，这类患者的照护通常涉及多种合并症、多种药物以及针对疾病分期的管理需求。然而，对于低年资医生而言，生成完整、准确、清晰且个体化的出院指导可能具有挑战性。本研究旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）辅助是否能提高低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导质量，以及其获益是否因慢性肾脏病（CKD）分期而异。研究纳入101例住院DKD患者。每例患者的出院指导最初由一组低年资住院医师起草（住院医师组）；随后，另一组同等水平的住院医师在DeepSeek-V3.2辅助下（AI辅助组）为同一101例患者生成另一套出院指导，共产生202份文档。4名临床专家（包括2名肾内科医生和2名内分泌科医生）独立使用5点Likert量表对两版出院指导的5个维度进行评分：完整性、准确性、安全性、清晰性和个体化。评分者间信度采用组内相关系数（ICC）评估。两组评分者间信度均极佳（住院医师组ICC=0.817，95% CI 0.763-0.864；P .05）。总体质量改善达到≥1分的病例比例为99%（100/101；95% CI 94.6%-100.0%）。LLM辅助改善了低年资医生生成的DKD出院指导的完整性、清晰性和个体化程度，且在复杂病例中优势最大。人机协作模式是减轻文书负担的一种有前景的方法。

title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
zh_title: 预训练语言语义用于结构化EHR预测
summary: 预印本提出tEHR，用自然语言描述EHR事件并以Mistral-7B做继续预训练与LoRA微调，在MIMIC-IV与CPRD多任务验证。
key_points: 以文本描述EHR事件替代数据集特异编码
EHR适配继续预训练加LoRA任务微调
MIMIC-IV四任务与CPRD胰腺癌预测外部评测
reason: 有跨数据集外部评测与新方法，但为未经同行评审预印本
abstract: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event. As a result, relationships between concepts must largely be learned from EHR co-occurrence, without directly exploiting any prior semantic knowledge. We investigate how pretrained causal language models can be adapted for longitudinal EHR prediction by developing tEHR. Here, we represent events with their natural language description and use this text stream to apply EHR-adaptive continued pretraining, followed by task-specific discriminative fine-tuning using LoRA, utilising the LLM as a longitudinal patient-encoder. We evaluate this approach across four prediction tasks on the MIMIC-IV dataset and pancreatic cancer prediction on the CPRD dataset at 1 to 12 month horizons, with tEHR using the Mistral-7B-v0.3 backbone achieving the strongest overall performance. Ablations show that performance declines when clinical descriptions are removed or misaligned, when numerical values are omitted, and when either stage of adaptation is removed, while explicit elapsed-time descriptions provide little additional benefit. Analysis of the learned patient representations further reveals clinically coherent structure associated with distinct patterns of disease risk and clinical history.
zh_abstract: 结构化电子健康记录（EHR）模型通常将每个临床概念视为数据集特定的标记（token），丢弃与该事件相关的自然语言语义。因此，概念之间的关系在很大程度上必须从EHR共现中学习，而未直接利用任何先验语义知识。我们通过开发tEHR，研究如何将预训练的因果语言模型适配用于纵向EHR预测。在此，我们用事件的自然语言描述来表示事件，并使用该文本流进行EHR自适应持续预训练，随后使用LoRA进行任务特定的判别式微调，将LLM用作纵向患者编码器。我们在MIMIC-IV数据集上的四项预测任务以及CPRD数据集上的胰腺癌预测（1至12个月预测时程）中评估该方法，其中采用Mistral-7B-v0.3骨干的tEHR取得最强的总体性能。消融实验显示，当临床描述被移除或错位、当数值被省略，以及当任一适配阶段被移除时，性能均下降；而明确经过时间的描述几乎没有额外获益。对学习到的患者表示的分析进一步揭示了与不同疾病风险和临床病史模式相关的临床一致结构。

title: [Editorial] Coasting on artificial intelligence safety
zh_title: 社论：AI智能体安全事件与治理缺口
summary: 《柳叶刀·数字健康》社论列举过去一年公开报道的AI智能体入侵技术平台、统计门户及篡改个人数据的系统安全事件，呼吁重视AI智能体安全。
key_points: 公开报道含AI智能体入侵医疗相关系统
有人担忧生存性威胁，有人视为营销炒作
社论称AI智能体正快速演化，或超出人类管控
reason: 社论观点类，无数据与研究设计，属常规观点文章档
abstract: Colluding on unsanctioned message boards and infiltrating a technology platform. Hacking the statistics portal of a health care scheme. Accessing and modifying personal data and business invoices. These are just a few examples from the past year of publicly reported systems breaches by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Such reports have heightened some people's concerns that AI poses an existential threat, with others dismissing such concerns as marketing hype. What is not debatable is that AI agents are rapidly evolving, potentially beyond human containment.
zh_abstract: 在未经批准的信息板上串通勾结并渗透技术平台。入侵某医疗保健计划的统计门户网站。访问并修改个人数据和商业发票。这些只是过去一年公开报道的人工智能（AI）智能体系统入侵事件的少数例子。此类报道加剧了一些人的担忧，即AI构成生存性威胁，而另一些人则将这些担忧斥为营销炒作。无可争议的是，AI智能体正在快速演进，可能超出人类的控制范围。

title: Curiosity-0826-4B: Generative Medical Event Sequence Modeling Across Pediatric and Adult Populations
zh_title: 生成式医疗事件序列基础模型Curiosity-0826-4B
summary: 基于 Epic Cosmos 训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型更新版，可零样本预测临床事件并扩展至儿科人群。
key_points: 实验室值预测MAE较前版降低18–46%
儿童哮喘新诊断AUROC 0.742–0.785
镰状细胞危象AUROC 0.820–0.847，低于成人0.915
reason: 大规模EHR基础模型有基线对比与儿科扩展，但为预印本、评估有限
abstract: We introduce Curiosity-0826-4B, an updated version of the generative medical event foundation model trained on Epic Cosmos that simulates patient timelines to produce zero-shot clinical predictions. Curiosity-0826-4B incorporates a broader patient population and richer clinical event representations, while generally matching or exceeding Curiosity-0226-1B, the largest model in the previous Curiosity-0226 series, on evaluated tasks supported by both models. Laboratory value prediction improved, with MAE 18--46% lower than that of Curiosity-0226-1B. We evaluated prediction of disease events across pediatric cohorts aged 2--17 years. AUROCs for new asthma diagnosis (0.742--0.785) and asthma exacerbation (0.829--0.852) were comparable to those in the adult reference cohort, while AUROCs for sickle cell crisis (0.820--0.847) were lower than in adults (0.915). Explicit representation of documented death enabled new mortality prediction tasks among adults across hospice, inpatient, and ambulatory settings (AUROC 0.821--0.942). Scaling-law analysis guided compute-optimal initial pretraining followed by continued pretraining with context extension. The resulting Curiosity-0826-4B model has more parameters (4.3B versus 1B) and a longer context window (16K versus 8K). It processes 56% fewer training tokens and requires 2.2 times the training floating point operations (FLOPs) compared with its predecessor. By extending a common zero-shot prediction strategy to pediatric patients and additional outcomes, Curiosity-0826-4B broadens opportunities to develop clinical and operational applications without training separate task-specific models. Further validation should assess local calibration, performance across patient subgroups and event frequencies, timeline completion rates, and generalization to new settings, alongside prospective evaluation of clinical and operational utility.
zh_abstract: 我们介绍了Curiosity-0826-4B，这是在Epic Cosmos上训练的生成式医疗事件基础模型的更新版本，其模拟患者时间线以生成零样本临床预测。Curiosity-0826-4B纳入了更广泛的患者人群和更丰富的临床事件表示，同时在两个模型均支持的受评估任务上，总体达到或超过Curiosity-0226-1B——上一代Curiosity-0226系列中最大的模型。实验室数值预测得到改善，MAE较Curiosity-0226-1B低18–46%。我们在2–17岁的儿科队列中评估了疾病事件的预测。新发哮喘诊断（0.742–0.785）和哮喘加重（0.829–0.852）的AUROC与成人参考队列相当，而镰状细胞危象的AUROC（0.820–0.847）低于成人（0.915）。对已记录死亡的显式表示使得能够在临终关怀、住院和门诊环境中的成人中开展新的死亡预测任务（AUROC 0.821–0.942）。缩放定律分析指导了计算最优的初始预训练，随后进行带有上下文扩展的持续预训练。所得的Curiosity-0826-4B模型具有更多参数（4.3B对1B）和更长的上下文窗口（16K对8K）。与其前代模型相比，它处理的训练token少56%，所需训练浮点运算次数（FLOPs）为2.2倍。通过将一种常见的零样本预测策略扩展到儿科患者和更多结局，Curiosity-0826-4B拓宽了在不训练单独任务特定模型的情况下开发临床和运营应用的机会。进一步验证应评估本地校准、跨患者亚组和事件频率的性能、时间线完成率以及对新环境的泛化能力，同时开展对临床和运营效用的前瞻性评估。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Pulmonary Hypertension: Advancements, Opportunities, and Challenges.
zh_title: 肺动脉高压中的人工智能：进展、机遇与挑战
summary: 综述梳理人工智能在肺动脉高压筛查、诊断、分型、风险分层与预后预测中的应用与挑战。
key_points: 涵盖心电、影像与电子病历等多模态数据
应用覆盖筛查、分型、风险分层与预后
为综述性总结，未提供原始研究数据
reason: 有信息量的领域综述，按规则综述最高6分，无新数据
abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a progressive cardiopulmonary disorder associated with high morbidity and mortality. Delayed diagnosis, heterogeneous disease phenotypes, and variable treatment responses remain major clinical challenges. Artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning and deep learning, has emerged as a promising tool for improving PH management. AI-based models have demonstrated promising performance in screening, diagnosis, classification, risk stratification, and prognosis prediction using multimodal data such as electrocardiography, chest radiography, computed tomography, cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, echocardiography, and electronic health records. Furthermore, AI may support individualized risk assessment, treatment-response prediction, early identification of right ventricular deterioration, and longitudinal remote monitoring. Emerging technologies, including explainable AI, federated learning, large language models, and digital twins, may further advance precision medicine in PH. Despite these advances, data quality, interpretability, privacy, and clinical implementation of AI remain challenges. This review summarizes current applications, opportunities, and challenges of AI in PH and discusses future directions for AI-assisted precision healthcare.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 肺动脉高压（pulmonary hypertension，PH）是一种进行性心肺疾病，与高发病率和死亡率相关。诊断延迟、疾病表型异质性和治疗反应差异仍是主要临床挑战。人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI），包括机器学习和深度学习，已成为改善PH管理的有前景工具。基于AI的模型在利用心电图、胸部X线摄影、计算机断层扫描、心脏磁共振成像、超声心动图和电子健康记录等多模态数据进行筛查、诊断、分类、风险分层和预后预测方面已表现出有希望的性能。此外，AI可能支持个体化风险评估、治疗反应预测、右心室恶化的早期识别和纵向远程监测。包括可解释AI、联邦学习、大语言模型和数字孪生在内的新兴技术，可能进一步推进PH的精准医学。尽管有这些进展，数据质量、可解释性、隐私和AI的临床实施仍然是挑战。本综述总结了AI在PH中的当前应用、机遇和挑战，并讨论了AI辅助精准医疗的未来方向。

title: Do Rule-Derived Labels Improve Prediction When Reported Labels Are Limited? A Two-Site Machine Learning Study
zh_title: 规则弱标签能否提升有限标注下的预测
summary: 预印本在两家医疗系统的大肠埃希菌尿培养数据上做标签预算实验，评估规则衍生弱标签对耐药预测的价值。
key_points: 两站点EHR数据、多个报告标签预算比例
任务为头孢类药敏非敏感预测
比较仅报告标签与加入规则弱标签
reason: 双站点方法学研究、设计规范，但为预印本且属探索性实验
abstract: **Background.** Rule derived (weak) labels can enlarge a training set when reported labels are scarce. Their value depends on label quality, on how the extra records shift the training distribution, and on whether the comparison accounts for reported labels set aside for tuning or calibration. **Methods.** We ran an exploratory label-budget experiment on *Escherichia coli* urine cultures from two de-identified electronic health record datasets: Stanford ARMD and UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW. The task was to predict reported non-susceptibility to cefepime, cefoxitin and ceftazidime (Stanford) and to cefepime and ceftazidime (UT Southwestern). Reported-label budgets of 10%, 25%, 50% and 100% of development patients were drawn over five patient-disjoint outer splits. Logistic regression and histogram gradient boosting were trained with reported labels only, or with added rule-derived labels using equal weights, a tuning-selected weight, class-proportion adjustment or prior-probability correction. These were compared with an all-budget reported-only baseline that used every budgeted reported label for training. Stanford used the inferred labels released with the dataset and a feature set including resistance history. UT Southwestern used researcher-derived labels from Stanford rule text, which were not validated for that site, and an age-only primary model. Brier-score differences were assessed with paired patient-cluster bootstrap intervals. **Results.** All rule-derived labels were susceptible. Equal-weight augmentation lowered mean predicted risk well below observed prevalence (for example, Stanford cefepime at the 10% budget: 0.35% versus 4.85%) and had a higher Brier score than the all-budget baseline in every drug, model and budget summary. The tuning-selected weight did not consistently improve on the all-budget baseline. Its median Brier difference was positive in 38 of 40 drug, model and budget summaries. Its paired intervals lay above zero in 100 of 296 Stanford analyses and 31 of 198 UT Southwestern analyses, and below zero in 3 and 5. The tuning set often selected a weight of zero (146 of 296 and 153 of 198 analyses). At UT Southwestern, the age-only models showed little discrimination (median AUROC 0.49 to 0.54), so those comparisons mainly reflect calibration. **Conclusions.** Under these designs, rule-derived labels did not consistently improve probability prediction over a reported-only model that used the whole reported-label budget for training.
zh_abstract: 【背景】当已报告标签稀缺时，规则衍生（弱）标签可以扩大训练集。其价值取决于标签质量、额外记录如何改变训练分布，以及比较是否考虑了留作调参或校准的已报告标签。【方法】我们在两个去标识化电子健康记录数据集——Stanford ARMD 和 UT Southwestern ARMD-UTSW——的大肠埃希菌（Escherichia coli）尿培养上开展了一项探索性标签预算实验。任务是预测对头孢吡肟、头孢西丁和头孢他啶（Stanford）以及对头孢吡肟和头孢他啶（UT Southwestern）的已报告非敏感性。在五个患者不重叠的外部分割上，抽取占开发集患者10%、25%、50%和100%的已报告标签预算。逻辑回归和直方图梯度提升分别仅使用已报告标签训练，或加入规则衍生标签并以等权重、调参选定的权重、类别比例调整或先验概率校正进行训练。这些模型与全预算仅报告标签基线（使用全部预算内已报告标签进行训练）进行比较。Stanford使用数据集随附发布的推断标签以及包含耐药史的特征集。UT Southwestern使用研究者根据Stanford规则文本衍生的标签（未在该中心验证）以及仅年龄的主模型。Brier评分差异采用配对患者聚类bootstrap区间评估。【结果】所有规则衍生标签均为敏感。等权重扩增使平均预测风险远低于观察到的患病率（例如Stanford头孢吡肟在10%预算时：0.35% 对 4.85%），并且在每种药物、模型和预算汇总中，其Brier评分均高于全预算基线。调参选定的权重并未持续优于全预算基线。在40项药物、模型和预算汇总中，有38项的中位Brier差异为正。其配对区间在296项Stanford分析中有100项位于零以上，在198项UT Southwestern分析中有31项位于零以上，分别有3项和5项位于零以下。调参集经常选择权重为零（296项分析中有146项，198项分析中有153项）。在UT Southwestern，仅年龄模型区分度很低（中位AUROC 0.49至0.54），因此这些比较主要反映校准。【结论】在这些设计下，与使用全部已报告标签预算进行训练的仅报告标签模型相比，规则衍生标签并未持续改善概率预测。

title: Enrollees and Early Lessons from an Agentic Healthcare Platform with Physicians in the Loop
zh_title: 医师监督的智能体医疗平台：入组者特征与早期经验
summary: 描述3223名医师监督智能体平台的入组者特征，并与全国调查基准比较疾病负担与就医碎片化。
key_points: 中位年龄51岁，62%为男性
各年龄段慢病患病率高于全国调查4–7个百分点
功能性疾病用户触发更多医生升级与人工处理
reason: 智能体平台使用者画像有信息量，但为描述性预印本、无结局评估
abstract: Agentic healthcare platforms that combine large language models with physician oversight are growing quickly, but little is known about who uses them. We characterized 3,223 enrollees of Lotus AI, a free, physician-supervised agentic platform, who completed onboarding, messaged the agent, and had a linked health record between February and July 2026, and compared them with national benchmarks. Median age was 51 years and 62% were male. Chronic condition prevalence exceeded 2024 National Health Interview Survey estimates in every age band by 4 to 7 percentage points; 18% had a functional or symptom-defined disorder; among the 30% with four or more ambulatory visits in the prior year, care was spread across nearly five providers, with 44% meeting a threshold for high fragmentation. Users with functional disorders generated 1.8 times as many physician escalations and 2.6 times as many laboratory orders as other users, but no more prescriptions. This profile differs from the younger, predominantly female populations reported for direct-to-consumer telemedicine. It moves chronic disease management, functional disorder pathways, and care coordination from aspirations to design requirements, and we argue that deployed AI care platforms should characterize their populations against national benchmarks early.
zh_abstract: 将大语言模型与医生监督相结合的代理式医疗平台正在快速增长，但对其使用者知之甚少。我们对Lotus AI的3,223名入组者进行了特征描述，并与国家基准进行比较；Lotus AI是一个免费的、由医生监督的代理式平台，这些入组者在2026年2月至7月期间完成了入组引导、向代理发送过消息并拥有关联健康记录。中位年龄为51岁，62%为男性。每个年龄段的慢性病患病率均比2024年国家健康访谈调查（National Health Interview Survey）估计值高4至7个百分点；18%患有功能性或症状定义的障碍；在既往一年有四次或以上门诊就诊的30%人群中，照护分散在近五名提供者之间，44%达到高度碎片化阈值。患有功能性障碍的用户产生的医生升级次数是其他用户的1.8倍，实验室检查医嘱是2.6倍，但处方并不更多。这一特征与直接面向消费者的远程医疗所报告的更年轻、以女性为主的人群不同。这将慢性病管理、功能性障碍诊疗路径和照护协调从愿景转变为设计要求，我们认为，已部署的AI照护平台应尽早依据国家基准描述其人群特征。

title: AToP: An Explainability Framework for Transformer-Based EHR Predictions Using Attribution-Guided Temporal Pattern Mining
zh_title: AToP：基于归因引导时序模式挖掘的EHR可解释框架
summary: 在MIMIC-IV v3.1（218,196例）训练的Transformer再入院模型上，将逐token积分梯度转为结构化时序模式解释。
key_points: AUROC 0.77、PR-AUC 0.34
掩蔽、逆序与token忠实性检验验证
与KernelSHAP对比归因效果
reason: 预印本新方法，大样本但仅内部验证、预测性能一般，属值得一看档
abstract: Objective: To develop and evaluate AToP (Attribution to Temporal Patterns), a post-hoc explainability framework that converts per-token Integrated Gradients (IG) from a Transformer into structured temporal pattern narratives. Materials and Methods: AToP was applied to a single-stream Transformer trained on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (218,196 patients; 12.6% unplanned 30-day readmission). It mines frequent episodes from salient-token subsequences in the training cohort, aggregates attribution among patients whose records contain each token or pattern, and collapses near-duplicates by patient overlap. Validation used masking, reversed-order analysis, token-level faithfulness tests, and KernelSHAP comparison. Results: The Transformer achieved AUROC 0.77 and PR-AUC 0.34. Population-weighted attribution emphasized high-prevalence codes with small per-patient impact. Carrier-conditional attribution, the mean among patients with the token, surfaced rare high-attribution psychiatric markers including psychosis, self-harm overdose, suicidal ideation (SI), and severe major depressive disorder (MDD). Pattern-level attribution identified within-visit co-occurrences and cross-visit trajectories not captured by token rankings. Risk-increasing patterns included psychiatric sequences ({MDD, SI} [->] SI) and oncologic progressions (cancer anemia [->] ascites). Obstetric and chest pain evaluation patterns were associated with lower predicted readmission. Discussion: The framework provides two complementary views of model predictions: carrier-conditional aggregation highlights rare, highly attributed clinical features, while temporal pattern analysis identifies within-visit combinations and cross-visit trajectories missed by token-level rankings. Masking and visit-order reversal provided evidence of correspondence with model behavior, but pattern attributions do not represent unique effects or establish clinical validity. Conclusion: AToP turns a Transformer's attributions into visit-anchored temporal pattern narratives, showing which events, in which order, contribute to its readmission predictions.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并评估 AToP（Attribution to Temporal Patterns），一个事后可解释性框架，可将 Transformer 中逐 token 的积分梯度（Integrated Gradients, IG）转换为结构化的时间模式叙述。【材料与方法】AToP 应用于一个在 MIMIC-IV v3.1（218,196 名患者；12.6% 非计划 30 天再入院）上训练的单流 Transformer。它从训练队列中显著 token 的子序列中挖掘频繁事件片段，在记录中包含每个 token 或模式的病人中汇总归因，并按患者重叠度合并近重复项。验证采用掩蔽、逆序分析、token 级忠实性检验以及与 KernelSHAP 的比较。【结果】该 Transformer 达到 AUROC 0.77 和 PR-AUC 0.34。人群加权归因强调了高患病率编码，但其对每位患者的影响较小。携带者条件归因，即在具有该 token 的患者中的均值，显现出罕见的高归因精神科标志物，包括精神病性障碍、自伤性过量、自杀意念（suicidal ideation, SI）和重度抑郁症（major depressive disorder, MDD）。模式级归因识别出 token 排名未捕捉到的就诊内共现和跨就诊轨迹。风险增加模式包括精神科序列（{MDD, SI} [->] SI）和肿瘤进展（癌症贫血 [->] 腹水）。产科和胸痛评估模式与较低的预测再入院风险相关。【讨论】该框架提供了模型预测的两种互补视角：携带者条件聚合突出罕见、高归因的临床特征，而时间模式分析识别出 token 级排名遗漏的就诊内组合和跨就诊轨迹。掩蔽和就诊顺序反转提供了与模型行为相对应的证据，但模式归因并不代表独特效应，也未确立临床有效性。【结论】AToP 将 Transformer 的归因转化为以就诊为锚点的时间模式叙述，展示哪些事件以何种顺序对其再入院预测有所贡献。

title: Constructing and Validating Memorisation Audits for EHR Foundation Models
zh_title: EHR基础模型记忆化审计框架的构建与验证
summary: 在MIMIC-IV训练的GPT-2式EHR模型上，用重建、敏感属性披露和患者级canary检验评估记忆化程度。
key_points: 固定窗口重建与敏感属性披露测试
随机患者级canary仅轻微提升标签恢复
训练集与留出集披露差异较小
reason: 预印本，方法清晰含阳性对照，为隐私审计提供证据但无外部数据集验证
abstract: Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models may disclose training information at inference, yet clinical predictability makes patient-specific memorisation difficult to distinguish from generalisation. We evaluate fixed-window token reconstruction, sensitive-attribute disclosure, and random patient-level canaries in GPT-2-style models trained on MIMIC-IV, across early, best-validation, and final checkpoints. Reconstruction improves with additional context, but training--held-out differences remain small. Trajectory-unique prompts containing limited clinical information produce no excess sensitive disclosure for training patients. In a matched model with random binary patient-level canaries, training-patient label-recovery AUROC increases from 0.512 to 0.549 while held-out recovery remains at chance. An overfit 1,000-patient positive control achieves near-perfect recovery, confirming sensitivity to strong memorisation. These results reveal weak cohort-level memorisation but no reliable patient-level disclosure under the evaluated attacks. They motivate clinically grounded inference-time audits that can detect patient-specific memorisation in existing models without retraining with canaries.
zh_abstract: 自回归电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型可能在推理时泄露训练信息，但临床可预测性使患者特异性记忆难以与泛化区分。我们在基于MIMIC-IV训练的GPT-2风格模型中，评估固定窗口token重建、敏感属性泄露和随机患者级金丝雀，涵盖早期、最佳验证和最终检查点。重建随上下文增加而改善，但训练集与留出集之间的差异仍然很小。包含有限临床信息的轨迹独有提示未对训练患者产生额外的敏感信息泄露。在带有随机二元患者级金丝雀的匹配模型中，训练患者的标签恢复AUROC从0.512升至0.549，而留出集恢复仍处于随机水平。一个过拟合的1,000例患者阳性对照实现了近乎完美的恢复，确认了对强记忆的敏感性。这些结果揭示了弱队列级记忆，但在所评估的攻击下没有可靠的患者级泄露。它们支持开展有临床依据的推理时审计，从而无需用金丝雀重新训练即可检测现有模型中的患者特异性记忆。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Care After Hospital Discharge for People With Decompensated Cirrhosis
zh_title: 失代偿期肝硬化出院后AI辅助管理随机试验
summary: 新注册的多中心随机试验，计划纳入180例，评估在常规照护上增加AI辅助主动管理能否减少90天内非计划住院。
key_points: 三中心、180例、随机分组
主要终点为90天非计划住院
尚未开始招募，无结果
reason: 前瞻随机设计为加分项，但仅注册无结果、干预描述简略，属增量档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital; conditions: Decompensated Liver Cirrhosis; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 180; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will compare two ways of supporting adults with cirrhosis after they leave hospital. Cirrhosis is severe scarring of the liver. Eligible participants will have been hospitalized for liver-related complications and will be ready for discharge. The main question is whether adding an artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted management service to usual care reduces unplanned hospital care caused by worsening liver disease during the next 90 days. The study plans to enroll 180 adults at three centers. Participants will be assigned by chance, with an equal chance of receiving usual care alone or usual care plus AI-assisted proactive management. Participants receiving the additional service, or their authorized caregivers, will complete a brief daily health report taking about 3-5 minutes and may report symptoms when they occur. The system helps organize reports and identify information requiring attention. Nurses check the information, and physicians make clinical decisions. The system does not independently diagnose illness, prescribe treatment, or change medication. Both groups will continue their usual medical care and have study follow-up contacts on days 7, 30, 60, and 90. The study will compare unplanned emergency visits, hospital observation, acute same-day treatment, and readmissions related to worsening liver disease. Safety and the burden of using and delivering the service will also be assessed. Participants with urgent symptoms should seek emergency care without waiting for a response from the study platform.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：北京清华长庚医院；疾病：失代偿性肝硬化；类型：INTERVENTIONAL；分期：NA；入组人数：180；状态：NOT_YET_RECRUITING] 本研究将比较两种在肝硬化成人患者出院后为其提供支持的方式。肝硬化是严重的肝脏瘢痕化。符合条件的参与者将因肝脏相关并发症住院，并已达到出院条件。主要问题是：在常规照护基础上增加人工智能（AI）辅助管理服务，是否能减少未来90天内因肝病恶化导致的非计划住院照护。研究计划在三个中心入组180名成人。参与者将被随机分配，接受单纯常规照护或常规照护加AI辅助主动管理的几率相等。接受额外服务的参与者或其授权照护者将完成一份简短的每日健康报告，耗时约3-5分钟，并可在症状出现时报告症状。系统帮助整理报告并识别需要关注的信息。护士核查信息，医生做出临床决策。系统不独立诊断疾病、不开具治疗处方，也不更改用药。两组均继续其常规医疗照护，并在第7、30、60和90天进行研究随访联系。研究将比较与肝病恶化相关的非计划急诊就诊、医院观察、急性当日治疗和再入院情况。还将评估安全性以及使用和提供该服务的负担。出现紧急症状的参与者应寻求急诊照护，不应等待研究平台的回复。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven precision management of Helicobacter pylori: an integrated framework from endoscopy and multi-omics to vaccine design and digital care.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology

reason: 概念性综述框架，无新数据或验证，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology] Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) infection, affecting half of the world's population, is the principal cause of peptic ulcer disease and gastric cancer, yet its clinical management is increasingly undermined by the rapidly escalating global burden of antibiotic resistance, the suboptimal accuracy of conventional diagnostic methods, and the declining efficacy of empirical therapeutic regimens. Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping this landscape, but existing research remains fragmented across single modalities. We propose a conceptual five-module framework that integrates AI approaches across the H. pylori care continuum: (1) global disease burden and the evolutionary dynamics of H. pylori drug resistance; (2) the application of multimodal AI, from convolutional neural networks to vision-language foundation models, for endoscopic early screening, pathological identification, and functional assessment; (3) the harnessing of machine learning (ML) on genomic and electronic health record data to decipher resistance mechanisms and generate personalized eradication regimens; (4) AI-driven vaccine target discovery and generative design, spanning reverse vaccinology to de novo immunogen creation; and (5) a digital closed-loop patient management platform that leverages new media and reinforcement learning to enhance adherence and eradication rates. We further delineate the core challenges of data bias, cross-scenario generalization, and the critical absence of prospective randomized evidence, and propose a future direction anchored in multimodal foundation models, federated learning, and continuous AI quality improvement. Rather than an established clinical pathway, this framework is proposed as a conceptual blueprint that, once prospectively validated, could upgrade AI-enabled H. pylori care from isolated image recognition toward an end-to-end "perception-reasoning-intervention" system, offering a blueprint for precision prevention and control.
zh_abstract: 【Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology】幽门螺杆菌（Helicobacter pylori，H. pylori）感染影响全球一半人口，是消化性溃疡病和胃癌的主要原因，然而其临床管理日益受到以下因素的削弱：快速上升的全球抗生素耐药负担、传统诊断方法准确性欠佳，以及经验性治疗方案疗效下降。人工智能（AI）正在迅速重塑这一格局，但现有研究仍分散于单一模态。我们提出一个概念性的五模块框架，将AI方法整合到H. pylori全程照护中：（1）全球疾病负担与H. pylori耐药性的演化动态；（2）多模态AI的应用，从卷积神经网络到视觉-语言基础模型，用于内镜早期筛查、病理识别和功能评估；（3）利用机器学习（ML）处理基因组和电子健康记录数据，以解析耐药机制并生成个体化根除方案；（4）AI驱动的疫苗靶点发现和生成式设计，涵盖反向疫苗学到从头创建免疫原；（5）一个数字闭环患者管理平台，利用新媒体和强化学习提高依从性和根除率。我们进一步阐明数据偏倚、跨场景泛化和前瞻性随机证据严重缺乏等核心挑战，并提出以多模态基础模型、联邦学习和持续AI质量改进为锚点的未来方向。该框架并非已确立的临床路径，而是作为一个概念性蓝图提出；一旦经过前瞻性验证，它可将AI赋能的H. pylori照护从孤立的图像识别升级为端到端的“感知-推理-干预”系统，为精准预防和控制提供蓝图。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes are rapidly becoming normalized in clinical practice, yet governance frameworks focus on accuracy, privacy, consent, and medicolegal status. Risks to clinician capabilities have received less attention. Speak before the reveal is a proposed method in which clinicians verbalize critical cognitive steps, such as synthesis and plan, before note generation. Recent work distinguishes deskilling in senior clinicians, never-skilling from premature offload in trainees and mis-skilling, the internalization of AI errors and inappropriate use as sound practice. This Perspective builds on emerging evidence that reasoning before seeing AI output may protect unaided reasoning. Training implementation, evaluation, adherence challenges, validation methodology, and governance strategies for training bodies, health services, and scribe vendors are discussed. Speak before the reveal is a low-cost, testable approach to maintaining clinical reasoning for individuals or organizations. Successful AI scribe adoption requires preserving clinicians' ability to work without AI support.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 环境人工智能（AI）记录助手（ambient AI scribes）正迅速在临床实践中常态化，然而治理框架却聚焦于准确性、隐私、知情同意和医疗法律地位。对临床医生能力构成的风险受到的关注较少。“先口述后揭示”（Speak before the reveal）是一种提出的方法，即临床医生在生成病历记录之前，口述关键的认知步骤，例如综合分析和计划。近期研究区分了资深临床医生的去技能化（deskilling）、受训者因过早卸载认知任务而从未习得技能（never-skilling），以及错误技能化（mis-skilling）——即将AI错误内化并把不当使用视为可靠实践。本观点文章基于新兴证据，即看到AI输出之前进行推理可能保护无辅助推理能力。文中讨论了培训实施、评估、依从性挑战、验证方法学，以及针对培训机构、卫生服务机构和记录助手供应商的治理策略。“先口述后揭示”是一种低成本、可检验的方法，可帮助个人或组织维持临床推理能力。成功采用AI记录助手需要保留临床医生在没有AI支持时工作的能力。

abstract: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. They demonstrate how the collective clinical experience of health systems can be used to develop medical AI with specialized expertise and broad clinical capabilities.
zh_abstract: 医学影像对于诊断疾病、指导治疗和长期监测患者至关重要。尽管人工智能推动了图像解读，但现有医学模型通常处理受限任务，而通用专有模型无法获取达到医学专业水平所需的私有临床影像。开发能够解读复杂检查并在临床决策背景下交流其发现的模型仍是一项重大挑战。在此，我们展示Neuro-VL——一个在来自常规临床照护的近100万项神经影像检查上训练的视觉-语言模型——能够解读完整影像检查，并就其发现进行自然语言对话。在内部和国际数据集上，Neuro-VL在诊断、定位和描述异常以及生成全面放射学报告方面优于前沿通用模型和专业医学模型。该模型还比较系列检查以评估疾病进展，并且比来自OpenAI和Google的领先前沿模型更可靠地抵御误导性临床假设。这些结果将卫生系统的学习从个体预测扩展到交互式图像解读和纵向疾病监测。它们表明，卫生系统的集体临床经验可用于开发具有专业专长和广泛临床能力的医学AI。

abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. In particular, in one set of experiments, a language model was able to match standard gradient-descent training using 6times fewer training subjects, through reasoning alone and without any gradient descent step. Networks written by Claude Opus 5.5 also scored higher than classic hand-crafted EEG pipelines (alpha band power, and common spatial patterns with linear discriminant analysis) when built from the same 5 subjects. We also highlight some of the limitations, which include the inability of language models to improve already well-trained classification models, and their incapacity to reliably recognize, from the weights alone, the task a network was trained on. Overall, our results indicate that weight-space programming can be useful for small networks, such as those deployed on edge devices and wearables, but the concept still requires further investigation before it can be used in practice.
zh_abstract: 权重空间编程使语言模型能够读取训练后神经网络的权重并对其进行编辑。这为通过推理而非梯度下降进行“训练”打开了大门。既往工作已证明其在游戏博弈网络以及修复语言模型特定故障方面的功能与前景，甚至已扩展到扩散模型。在本工作中，我们展示其适用于在生物信号数据（具体为EEG和ECG数据）上训练的模型。我们表明，前沿模型不仅能够在未被告知这些故障是什么的情况下调试植入基于生物信号模型中的特定故障，甚至能够仅给定架构、任务和最少量的训练受试者，就从零开始写出网络的所有权重。特别地，在一组实验中，一个语言模型仅通过推理且没有任何梯度下降步骤，使用少6倍的训练受试者就能匹配标准梯度下降训练。由Claude Opus 5.5写出的网络在基于相同5名受试者构建时，也比经典手工EEG流程（α波段功率，以及共空间模式结合线性判别分析）得分更高。我们还强调了一些局限性，包括语言模型无法改进已经训练良好的分类模型，以及它们无法仅凭权重可靠识别网络所训练的任务。总体而言，我们的结果表明，权重空间编程对小型网络（例如部署在边缘设备和可穿戴设备上的网络）可能有用，但该概念在可用于实践之前仍需进一步研究。

abstract: Traditionally, the clinician–scientist has played a key role in translating fundamental discoveries into clinical practice across multiple medical disciplines. As medicine enters the era of artificial intelligence (AI), a similar role is needed to bridge the gap between technological development and meaningful clinical implementation—a role we term the clinician–AI scientist. In this Viewpoint, we examine the distinctive role, challenges, and development strategies of this potentially new career pathway for clinicians.

title: From task-specific networks to foundation models in diabetes care: a critical review of opportunities, evaluation gaps, and safety frontiers.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence in diabetes care has historically relied on task-specific supervised learning, such as bespoke networks for retinopathy grading, kidney disease prediction, and glucose forecasting. The emergence of foundation models (FMs: large models pretrained on broad data, typically with self-supervision, and adapted to many downstream tasks) is displacing this paradigm across diabetes-relevant modalities: ophthalmic models such as RETFound, pretrained on 1.6 million retinal photographs, have been reported to outperform task-specific networks on retinopathy grading and systemic disease prediction, especially when labeled data are scarce; transformer-based time-series models are replacing long short-term memory (LSTM) pipelines for continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) forecasting; clinical large language models (LLMs) such as Med-PaLM and GPT-4 attain expert-level scores on medical question-answering benchmarks; and generative models supply synthetic CGM and electronic health record (EHR) data. This review provides a critical, modality-organized synthesis of this transition. We (i) formalize a three-era taxonomy: rule-based risk scores (era I), task-specific deep learning (era II, 2016-2020), and foundation models (era III, from 2021), and map the diabetes literature onto it; (ii) survey foundation-model architectures, pretraining objectives, and adaptation strategies across retinal imaging, CGM, longitudinal EHR, and multimodal data; (iii) expose an evaluation crisis: benchmark contamination of LLM medical evaluations, a near-universal absence in the literature we reviewed of external and prospective validation for retinal and CGM foundation models, miscalibration under dataset shift, and, to our knowledge and within the reviewed literature (January 2016-December 2025; negative findings are time-sensitive), the absence of any randomized evaluation of a foundation model in a diabetes workflow; and (iv) analyze safety risks: hallucinated insulin-dosing advice, automation bias, inherited algorithmic inequity, and privacy exposure during adaptation. We conclude that the decisive open problem is no longer representation learning but grounded, calibrated, causally informed deployment, requiring contamination-resistant evaluation, prospective trials, and hybrid architectures coupling foundation-model representations with treatment-effect estimation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 糖尿病护理中的人工智能历来依赖任务特定的监督学习，例如用于视网膜病变分级、肾脏疾病预测和血糖预测的定制网络。基础模型（FMs：在广泛数据上预训练、通常采用自监督、并适配于许多下游任务的大型模型）的出现正在糖尿病相关各模态中取代这一范式：例如，在160万张视网膜照片上预训练的RETFound等眼科模型，据报道在视网膜病变分级和系统性疾病预测方面优于任务特定网络，尤其是在标注数据稀缺时；基于Transformer的时间序列模型正在取代用于连续葡萄糖监测（CGM）预测的长短期记忆（LSTM）流程；Med-PaLM和GPT-4等临床大语言模型（LLMs）在医学问答基准上达到专家级分数；生成模型提供合成CGM和电子健康记录（EHR）数据。本综述对这一转变进行了批判性的、按模态组织的综合。我们（i）形式化了一个三时代分类法：基于规则的风险评分（时代I）、任务特定的深度学习（时代II，2016—2020年）和基础模型（时代III，自2021年起），并将糖尿病文献映射到该分类法上；（ii）综述视网膜影像、CGM、纵向EHR和多模态数据中的基础模型架构、预训练目标和适配策略；（iii）揭示一场评估危机：LLM医学评估存在基准污染；在我们综述的文献中，几乎普遍缺乏对视网膜和CGM基础模型的外部验证与前瞻性验证；数据集偏移下存在校准不良；并且据我们所知，在综述文献范围内（2016年1月—2025年12月；阴性发现具有时间敏感性），尚无任何在糖尿病工作流程中对基础模型进行的随机化评估；（iv）分析安全风险：幻觉性胰岛素给药建议、自动化偏差、继承的算法不平等以及适配过程中的隐私暴露。我们得出结论：决定性的未解决问题不再是表示学习，而是有现实依据、经过校准且纳入因果信息的部署，这要求抗污染评估、前瞻性试验，以及将基础模型表征与治疗效果估计耦合的混合架构。

abstract: [Journal de mycologie medicale] Dermatophytosis is one of the most common superficial fungal infections worldwide. However, its diagnosis and management remain challenging because its clinical manifestations often overlap with those of other dermatoses, conventional mycological tests have inherent limitations, the disease is prone to recurrence, and antifungal resistance has received increasing attention. This review summarizes current applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in dermatophytosis, with a focus on the use of machine learning and deep learning in clinical photographs, non-invasive skin imaging, and laboratory diagnostics, while also discussing their roles in treatment support, follow-up assessment, patient education, and adherence management. In addition, with the accumulation of molecular diagnostic, mass spectrometric, and epidemiological data, AI may also provide auxiliary support for extended applications such as resistance risk recognition. Current evidence suggests that AI can improve the efficiency, consistency, and objectivity of dermatophytosis diagnosis and provide quantitative support for treatment response assessment and long-term follow-up. With further improvement in research quality and the accumulation of clinical application experience, AI is expected to become increasingly integrated into dermatophytosis management workflows.
zh_abstract: [Journal de mycologie medicale] 皮肤癣菌病是全球最常见的浅部真菌感染之一。然而，其诊断和管理仍具有挑战性，因为其临床表现常与其他皮肤病重叠，传统真菌学检查存在固有局限性，该病易复发，且抗真菌耐药性日益受到关注。本综述总结人工智能（AI）在皮肤癣菌病中的当前应用，重点介绍机器学习和深度学习在临床照片、无创皮肤成像和实验室诊断中的应用，同时讨论其在治疗支持、随访评估、患者教育和依从性管理中的作用。此外，随着分子诊断、质谱和流行病学数据的积累，AI还可能为耐药风险识别等扩展应用提供辅助支持。当前证据表明，AI可提高皮肤癣菌病诊断的效率、一致性和客观性，并为治疗反应评估和长期随访提供定量支持。随着研究质量的进一步提高和临床应用经验的积累，AI有望日益融入皮肤癣菌病管理流程。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chimei Medical Center; conditions: Nursing Care Planning; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: COMPLETED] This study evaluates whether assistance from a large language model (LLM), a type of artificial intelligence that generates text, improves the quality of nursing care plans and reduces the time needed to complete them. The study included 120 registered nurses working in internal medicine wards, surgical wards, and intensive care units at a medical center in southern Taiwan. Nurses were randomly assigned to one of two groups: * Independent planning: Nurses prepared, reviewed, and submitted a care plan without LLM assistance. * LLM-assisted planning: Nurses entered prompts to obtain an LLM-generated draft, then reviewed and revised the draft before submitting their final care plan. Each nurse completed only the assigned workflow during a single study session. Participants completed a brief baseline questionnaire and prepared nursing problems, goals, and interventions for a standardized simulated clinical case. Tasks were performed in a secure hospital test environment without real patient data. Expert nurse raters who were not informed of group assignments independently evaluated the final care plans. The nursing care decision quality assessment has a maximum total score of 30 points, comprising decision-content quality (25 points) and decision-language quality (5 points). The system recorded task completion time. Researchers compare the two groups' final care-plan quality scores and task completion times.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：奇美医疗中心（Chimei Medical Center）；疾病/状况：护理照护计划；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：120；状态：已完成（COMPLETED）] 本研究评估来自大型语言模型（LLM）——一种生成文本的人工智能——的辅助是否能提高护理照护计划的质量并减少完成这些计划所需的时间。研究纳入台湾南部一家医疗中心内科病房、外科病房和重症监护病房工作的120名注册护士。护士被随机分配至两组之一：• 独立计划：护士在无LLM辅助的情况下准备、审阅并提交护理计划。• LLM辅助计划：护士输入提示以获得LLM生成的草稿，然后在提交最终护理计划前审阅并修订草稿。每名护士在单次研究环节中仅完成所分配的工作流程。参与者完成一份简短基线问卷，并针对一个标准化模拟临床病例准备护理问题、目标和干预措施。任务在安全的医院测试环境中执行，不使用真实患者数据。未被告知分组情况的专家护士评分者独立评估最终护理计划。护理照护决策质量评估最高总分为30分，包括决策内容质量（25分）和决策语言质量（5分）。系统记录任务完成时间。研究人员比较两组的最终护理计划质量评分和任务完成时间。

abstract: Liver disease remains a major global health concern, highlighting the need for reliable and accessible early detection methods. Although recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and quantum machine learning (QML) have introduced promising diagnostic tools, many approaches suffer from limited interpretability and inflated performance caused by data leakage or overly simplistic evaluation protocols. These constraints reduce their reliability in real-world clinical practice. This paper proposes KQML-Liver, a hybrid framework that integrates QML with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance predictive performance and interpretability. The architecture combines parameterized quantum circuits for expressive feature representation with KAN-based functional mappings that capture nonlinear relationships in an interpretable manner. Evaluated on the Indian Liver Patient Dataset (ILPD) under a rigorous preprocessing protocol preventing data leakage, the proposed model achieves 82% classification accuracy and 100% recall, detecting all positive cases, outperforming existing baselines while providing improved transparency in clinical predictions. These results suggest that hybrid KAN-quantum architectures offer a promising direction for interpretable AI-assisted medical diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 肝病仍然是全球重大健康问题，凸显了对可靠且可及的早期检测方法的需求。尽管机器学习、深度学习和量子机器学习（QML）的最新进展带来了有前景的诊断工具，但许多方法存在可解释性有限以及由数据泄漏或过于简化的评估方案导致的性能虚高问题。这些限制降低了它们在实际临床实践中的可靠性。本文提出KQML-Liver，一种将QML与Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）集成以提升预测性能和可解释性的混合框架。该架构将用于表达性特征表示的参数化量子电路与能够以可解释方式捕捉非线性关系的基于KAN的函数映射相结合。在严格防止数据泄漏的预处理方案下，于Indian Liver Patient Dataset（ILPD）上评估，所提出模型达到82%的分类准确率和100%的召回率，检测出所有阳性病例，优于现有基线，同时在临床预测中提供更高透明度。这些结果表明，KAN-量子混合架构为可解释的AI辅助医学诊断提供了一个有前景的方向。
